function K.fn(name)
    local v
    pcall(function() v = getfenv(0)[name] end)
    if type(v) ~= "function" then pcall(function() v = getfenv()[name] end) end
    return type(v) == "function" and v or nil
end

local getthreadidentity_ = K.fn("getthreadidentity") or K.fn("getidentity")
local setthreadidentity_ = K.fn("setthreadidentity") or K.fn("setidentity")
local sethiddenproperty_ = K.fn("sethiddenproperty")
local gethui_ = K.fn("gethui")
local function identity(n)
    if not setthreadidentity_ then return function() end end
    local old = getthreadidentity_ and getthreadidentity_() or nil
    pcall(setthreadidentity_, n)
    return function() if old then pcall(setthreadidentity_, old) end end
end
K.identity = identity
local function hudParent()
    local ok, h = pcall(function() return gethui_ and gethui_() end)
    if ok and h then return h end
    return game:GetService("CoreGui")
end
K.hudParent = hudParent

function K.track(c) K.connections[#K.connections + 1] = c return c end
function K.onUnload(f) K.cleanups[#K.cleanups + 1] = f end

--==========================================================================
--  Signal / Trove (Kicia's own small versions)
--==========================================================================
local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal
function Signal.new() return setmetatable({ _handlers = {} }, Signal) end
function Signal:Connect(fn)
    local h = { fn = fn, connected = true }
    table.insert(self._handlers, h)
    local sig = self
    return {
        Connected = true,
        Disconnect = function(c)
            if not h.connected then return end
            h.connected = false
            c.Connected = false
            local i = table.find(sig._handlers, h)
            if i then table.remove(sig._handlers, i) end
        end,
    }
end
function Signal:Once(fn)
    local c
    c = self:Connect(function(...) c:Disconnect() fn(...) end)
    return c
end
function Signal:Fire(...)
    local list = table.clone(self._handlers)
    for _, h in ipairs(list) do
        if h.connected then task.spawn(h.fn, ...) end
    end
end
function Signal:FireSync(...)
    for _, h in ipairs(table.clone(self._handlers)) do
        if h.connected then h.fn(...) end
    end
end
function Signal:Destroy() table.clear(self._handlers) end
K.Signal = Signal

local Trove = {}
Trove.__index = Trove
function Trove.new(name) return setmetatable({ _name = name, _items = {} }, Trove) end
local function cleanItem(o)
    local t = typeof(o)
    if t == "RBXScriptConnection" then o:Disconnect()
    elseif t == "Instance" then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
    elseif t == "thread" then pcall(task.cancel, o)
    elseif type(o) == "function" then pcall(o)
    elseif type(o) == "table" then
        --  some objects (Kicia's signal connections) error on unknown fields
        local function member(k)
            local ok, v = pcall(function() return o[k] end)
            return ok and type(v) == "function" and v or nil
        end
        local cancel, getStatus = member("cancel"), member("getStatus")
        if cancel and getStatus then pcall(cancel, o) return end
        local destroy = member("Destroy")
        if destroy then pcall(destroy, o) return end
        local disconnect = member("Disconnect")
        if disconnect then pcall(disconnect, o) end
    end
end
function Trove:Add(o) table.insert(self._items, o) return o end
function Trove:Connect(sig, fn) return self:Add(sig:Connect(fn)) end
function Trove:Extend() return self:Add(Trove.new(self._name)) end
function Trove:Remove(o, keep)
    local i = table.find(self._items, o)
    if i then
        table.remove(self._items, i)
        if not keep then cleanItem(o) end
    end
end
--  Promise held until it settles; cancelled if the trove is cleaned first.
function Trove:AddPromise(promise)
    if tostring(promise:getStatus()) == "Started" then
        self:Add(promise)
        promise:finally(function()
            if not self._cleaning then self:Remove(promise, true) end
        end)
    end
    return promise
end
--  Sub-trove that cleans itself up when `instance` is destroyed.
function Trove:AttachExtend(instance)
    local sub = self:Extend()
    sub:Connect(instance.Destroying, function() self:Remove(sub) end)
    return sub
end
function Trove:Clean()
    local items = self._items
    self._items = {}
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #items, 1, -1 do cleanItem(items[i]) end
    self._cleaning = false
end
Trove.Destroy = Trove.Clean
K.Trove = Trove

--  The rest of the loader's locals (clonefunction'd so hooks on them can't see us).
local function clonefn(f)
    local c = K.fn("clonefunction")
    if c and f then
        local ok, r = pcall(c, f)
        if ok and r then return r end
    end
    return f
end

--  w: viewport / pointer / key / path helpers
do
    local UIS = UserInputService
    local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
    local function camera() return workspace.CurrentCamera end
    local W = {}
    function W.appendPath(path, key)
        local p = table.clone(path)
        table.insert(p, key)
        return p
    end
    function W.currentViewportSize()
        local c = camera()
        return c and c.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
    end
    function W.connectCurrentCameraViewport(trove, cb)
        local inner = trove:Extend()
        local function bind()
            inner:Clean()
            local c = camera()
            if c == nil then return end
            inner:Connect(c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), function() cb(c.ViewportSize) end)
            cb(c.ViewportSize)
        end
        trove:Connect(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), bind)
        bind()
    end
    function W.absoluteToLayerOffset(layer, pos)
        return pos - layer.AbsolutePosition
    end
    function W.clampOffsetToViewport(x, y, size)
        local vp = W.currentViewportSize()
        return math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(0, vp.X - size.X)), math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(0, vp.Y - size.Y))
    end
    function W.clampGuiToViewport(gui)
        local vp = W.currentViewportSize()
        local ap, as = gui.AbsolutePosition, gui.AbsoluteSize
        local dx = math.clamp(ap.X, 0, math.max(0, vp.X - as.X)) - ap.X
        local dy = math.clamp(ap.Y, 0, math.max(0, vp.Y - as.Y)) - ap.Y
        if dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0 then
            local p = gui.Position
            gui.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset + dx, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + dy)
        end
    end
    function W.snapPosition(u)
        return UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, math.round(u.X.Offset), u.Y.Scale, math.round(u.Y.Offset))
    end
    function W.onScreenKeyboardTop()
        local ok, visible = pcall(function() return UIS.OnScreenKeyboardVisible end)
        if not ok or not visible then return nil end
        local ok2, pos = pcall(function() return UIS.OnScreenKeyboardPosition end)
        return ok2 and pos and pos.Y or nil
    end
    function W.connectOnScreenKeyboard(trove, cb)
        pcall(function() trove:Connect(UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OnScreenKeyboardVisible"), cb) end)
        pcall(function() trove:Connect(UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OnScreenKeyboardPosition"), cb) end)
    end
    function W.getPointerPosition()
        return UIS:GetMouseLocation()
    end
    function W.matchesPointerDrag(input, started, movement)
        if started ~= nil and started.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return input == started end
        return input.UserInputType == movement
    end
    function W.round(v, step)
        if step == nil or step == 0 then return v end
        return math.round(v / step) * step
    end
    W.KeyNames = {
        [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = "MB1", [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = "MB2",
        [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3] = "MB3", [Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] = "LShift",
        [Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] = "RShift", [Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] = "LCtrl",
        [Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] = "RCtrl", [Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt] = "LAlt", [Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt] = "RAlt",
    }
    function W.serializeKey(key)
        if typeof(key) ~= "EnumItem" then return nil end
        return tostring(key.EnumType) .. "." .. key.Name
    end
    function W.deserializeKey(s)
        if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
        local kind, name = s:match("^(%w+)%.(%w+)$")
        if kind == nil then return nil end
        local ok, v = pcall(function() return Enum[kind][name] end)
        return ok and v or nil
    end
    function W.findScrollingAncestor(inst)
        local p = inst and inst.Parent
        while p ~= nil do
            if p:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return p end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    function W.isEffectivelyVisible(gui)
        local p = gui
        while p ~= nil and p ~= game do
            if p:IsA("GuiObject") and not p.Visible then return false end
            if p:IsA("LayerCollector") then return p.Enabled end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    function W.ensureStorageDirectories(dir)
        local isf, mkf = K.fn("isfolder"), K.fn("makefolder")
        if not (isf and mkf) or type(dir) ~= "string" then return end
        local function make(path)
            local acc
            for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
                acc = acc and (acc .. "/" .. part) or part
                pcall(function() if not isf(acc) then mkf(acc) end end)
            end
        end
        make(dir)
        make(dir .. "/configs")
    end
    tbl17.w = function() return W end
end

--  P: two-way link between a control and a settings path. Sliders ask for
--  Debounce so dragging writes once per short burst instead of every frame.
do
    local P = {}
    function P.bind(trove, config, control, path, opts)
        local debounce = opts ~= nil and opts.Debounce == true
        local writeBack = opts ~= nil and opts.WriteBack or nil
        control:Set(config:Get(path), true)
        trove:Connect(config:Changed(path), function(v) control:Set(v, true) end)
        local pending, scheduled = nil, false
        local function write(v)
            if writeBack then writeBack(v) else config:Set(path, v) end
        end
        trove:Connect(control.Changed, function(v)
            if not debounce then write(v) return end
            pending = v
            if scheduled then return end
            scheduled = true
            task.delay(0.05, function()
                scheduled = false
                write(pending)
            end)
        end)
    end
    tbl17.P = function() return P end
end

--  c5: the critically damped Spring (Position, Velocity, Target, Speed, Damper).
do
    local Spring = {}
    local function posVel(self, now)
        local p0, v0, p1, d, s = self._p0, self._v0, self._target, self._damper, self._speed
        local t = s * (now - self._t0)
        local d2 = d * d
        local h, si, co
        if d2 < 1 then
            h = math.sqrt(1 - d2)
            local ep = math.exp(-d * t) / h
            co, si = ep * math.cos(h * t), ep * math.sin(h * t)
        elseif d2 == 1 then
            h = 1
            local ep = math.exp(-d * t) / h
            co, si = ep, ep * t
        else
            h = math.sqrt(d2 - 1)
            local u, v = math.exp((-d + h) * t) / (2 * h), math.exp((-d - h) * t) / (2 * h)
            co, si = u + v, u - v
        end
        local a0, a1 = h * co + d * si, 1 - (h * co + d * si)
        local a2 = si / s
        local b0, b1, b2 = -s * si, s * si, h * co - d * si
        return a0 * p0 + a1 * p1 + a2 * v0, b0 * p0 + b1 * p1 + b2 * v0
    end
    function Spring.new(initial, clock)
        initial = initial or 0
        clock = clock or os.clock
        return setmetatable({ _clock = clock, _t0 = clock(), _p0 = initial, _v0 = 0 * initial, _target = initial,
            _damper = 1, _speed = 1 }, Spring)
    end
    function Spring:Impulse(v) self.Velocity = self.Velocity + v end
    function Spring:SetTarget(value, doNotAnimate)
        if doNotAnimate then
            self._p0, self._v0, self._target, self._t0 = value, 0 * value, value, self._clock()
        else
            self.Target = value
        end
    end
    function Spring:TimeSkip(delta)
        local now = self._clock()
        local p, v = posVel(self, now + delta)
        self._p0, self._v0, self._t0 = p, v, now
    end
    Spring.__index = function(self, k)
        if Spring[k] then return Spring[k] end
        if k == "Value" or k == "Position" or k == "p" then local p = posVel(self, self._clock()) return p
        elseif k == "Velocity" or k == "v" then local _, v = posVel(self, self._clock()) return v
        elseif k == "Target" or k == "t" then return self._target
        elseif k == "Damper" or k == "d" then return self._damper
        elseif k == "Speed" or k == "s" then return self._speed
        elseif k == "Clock" then return self._clock end
        return nil
    end
    Spring.__newindex = function(self, k, v)
        local now = self._clock()
        if k == "Value" or k == "Position" or k == "p" then
            local _, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0 = v, vel
        elseif k == "Velocity" or k == "v" then
            local pos = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0 = pos, v
        elseif k == "Target" or k == "t" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._target = pos, vel, v
        elseif k == "Damper" or k == "d" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._damper = pos, vel, v
        elseif k == "Speed" or k == "s" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._speed = pos, vel, v < 0 and 0 or v
        elseif k == "Clock" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._clock, self._t0, self._p0, self._v0 = v, v(), pos, vel
            return
        else
            rawset(self, k, v)
            return
        end
        self._t0 = now
    end
    tbl17.c5 = function() return Spring end
end

--  hH: weather emitter specs and lightning / thunder constants. Kicia's own
--  values are not in the dump; these fit every field the weather module reads
--  and use particle textures that ship with Roblox.

--  eZ: Kicia's online user service (sessions with user.kicia.cc). Offline here:
--  nothing is sent anywhere, connecting is refused.
tbl17.eZ = function()
    local Offline = {}
    Offline.__index = Offline
    function Offline.new()
        local Signal = tbl17.g()
        local self = setmetatable({ Connected = Signal.new(), ShowActiveChanged = Signal.new(),
            PeerPayloadReceived = Signal.new(), PeerRemoved = Signal.new(), ShowActivated = Signal.new(),
            _playerByHash = {} }, Offline)
        self._leaving = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self.PeerRemoved:Fire(p) end)
        return self
    end
    function Offline:ShouldShowActive() return false end
    function Offline:IsConnected() return false end
    function Offline:Send() return tbl17.a().err("UserServer", "offline", "the online user service is disabled") end
    function Offline:FindPlayerByHash() return nil end
    function Offline:Connect() return tbl17.ay().reject("the online user service is disabled") end
    function Offline:Destroy()
        self.Connected:Destroy()
        self.ShowActiveChanged:Destroy()
        self.PeerPayloadReceived:Destroy()
        self.PeerRemoved:Destroy()
        self.ShowActivated:Destroy()
        self._leaving:Disconnect()
    end
    return Offline
end

    for _, child in frame4:GetChildren() do

            -- parent tab button: match against any TextLabel child
            local matched = (query == "")
            if not matched then
                for _, lbl in child:GetChildren() do
                    if lbl:IsA("TextLabel") and string.lower(lbl.Text):find(query, 1, true) then
                        matched = true; break
                    end
                end
            end
            child.Visible = matched
        elseif child:IsA("Frame") then
            -- childHolder / separator: show if any inner TextButton label matches
            local anyMatch = (query == "")
            if not anyMatch then
                for _, row in child:GetChildren() do
                    if row:IsA("TextButton") then
                        for _, lbl in row:GetChildren() do
                            if lbl:IsA("TextLabel") and string.lower(lbl.Text):find(query, 1, true) then
                                anyMatch = true; break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if anyMatch then break end
                end
            end
            child.Visible = anyMatch
        end
    end
end)

-- Graviton snowfall (clipped inside the window)
do
	local snowCanvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	snowCanvas.Name = "GravitonSnowCanvas"
	snowCanvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	snowCanvas.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	snowCanvas.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	snowCanvas.BorderSizePixel = 0
	snowCanvas.ZIndex = 2
	snowCanvas.ClipsDescendants = true
	snowCanvas.Parent = frame
	local SNOW_COUNT = 55
	local flakes = {}
	local function makeFlake(randomY)
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 185, 255)
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		local sz = math.random(2, 5)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
		f.BackgroundTransparency = math.random(15, 45) / 100
		f.ZIndex = 2
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		corner.Parent = f
		local x = math.random(0, 1000) / 1000
		local y = randomY and (math.random(0, 100) / 100) or (math.random(-10, 0) / 100)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
		f.Parent = snowCanvas
		return {
			frame = f,
			x = x, y = y,
			speed = math.random(20, 55) / 1000,
			drift = math.random(-2, 2) / 1000,
		}
	end
	for i = 1, SNOW_COUNT do
		table.insert(flakes, makeFlake(true))
	end
	local rs = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService"))
	local snowConn
	snowConn = rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not snowCanvas.Parent then snowConn:Disconnect() return end
		for _, fl in ipairs(flakes) do
			fl.y = fl.y + fl.speed * dt
			fl.x = fl.x + fl.drift * dt
			if fl.x < -0.02 then fl.x = 1.02
			elseif fl.x > 1.02 then fl.x = -0.02 end
			if fl.y > 1.05 then
				fl.y = -0.03
				fl.x = math.random(0, 1000) / 1000
			end
			fl.frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(fl.x, fl.y)
		end
	end)
	v124:Add({ Destroy = function() snowConn:Disconnect() end })
end

do -- dh
local function fn35()
local v120 = tbl17.bG()
local v121 = tbl17.c4()
local v128 = tbl17.k()
local v119 = tbl17.cq()
local v117 = tbl17.co()
local v133 = tbl17.dg()

local data = v120.Data
local LP = player
local mousemoverel_ = K.fn("mousemoverel")
local _isMobile = cloneref(UserInputService).TouchEnabled

local function _getPlayerChars()
    local out = {}
    -- read aimbot target-filter config from reactive store each call so
    -- changes (including config loads) take effect without a restart
    local abTeamCheck = data.Aimbot.TeamCheck ~= false
    local abEnemyOnly = data.Aimbot.EnemiesOnly ~= false
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
            -- team check: skip players on the same team as us
            if abTeamCheck and LP.Team ~= nil and plr.Team == LP.Team then continue end
            -- enemies only: skip neutral players (not assigned to any team)
            if abEnemyOnly and plr.Neutral then continue end
            local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                table.insert(out, plr.Character)
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

local function _screenPos(part)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local sp, vis = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    return vis, Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
end

local function _getAimCenter()
    if _isMobile then
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    end
    return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
end

local function _getTarget(fovRadius, visOnly)
    local mp = _getAimCenter()
    local best, bestD = nil, fovRadius
    for _, char in ipairs(_getPlayerChars()) do
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then continue end
        local vis, sp2 = _screenPos(hrp)
        if not vis then continue end
        if visOnly and not vis then continue end
        local d = (sp2 - mp).Magnitude
        if d < bestD then best, bestD = char, d end
    end
    return best
end

local index2 = {}
index2.__index = index2

index2.new = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
    local trove = v128.new("aimbot_v2")
    local tbl18 = {
        _trove = trove,
        _active = false,
        _targetScreenPosition = nil,
    }
    setmetatable(tbl18, index2)
    trove:Add(v121:ObserveEnabledKeybind({ "Aimbot" }, function(active)
        tbl18._active = active
    end))
    return tbl18
end

index2.GetTargetScreenPosition = function(arg)
    return arg._targetScreenPosition
end

index2.Update = function(arg, dt)
    local aimbot = data.Aimbot
    if not arg._active then
        arg._targetScreenPosition = nil
        v117.release("Aimbot")
        return
    end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    -- read all v2 settings from reactive store
    local fovRadius  = (aimbot.Fov and aimbot.Fov.Radius) or 120
    local visOnly    = (aimbot.TargetConditions and aimbot.TargetConditions.Visible) or false
    local aaSpeedV   = (type(aimbot.Smoothing)    == "number" and aimbot.Smoothing)    or 100
    local aaLerpV    = (type(aimbot.Lerp)         == "number" and aimbot.Lerp)         or 2
    local aaSensV    = (type(aimbot.Sensitivity)  == "number" and aimbot.Sensitivity)  or 10  -- slider 1-20 direct
    local aaYOff     = (type(aimbot.AimHeight)    == "number" and aimbot.AimHeight)    or 0
    local aaWalls    = (aimbot.CheckWalls    ~= false)
    local aaDelayV   = (aimbot.DelayPosition ~= false)
    local aaClosV    = (aimbot.ClosestPart   == true)

    local char = _getTarget(fovRadius, visOnly)
    if not char then
        arg._targetScreenPosition = nil
        v117.release("Aimbot")
        return
    end

    -- pick aim part
    local mp   = _getAimCenter()
    local part = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if aaClosV then
        local closest, closestD = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                local vis2, sp2 = _screenPos(p)
                if vis2 then
                    local d2 = (sp2 - mp).Magnitude
                    if d2 < closestD then closest, closestD = p, d2 end
                end
            end
        end
        if closest then part = closest end
    end
    if not part then
        arg._targetScreenPosition = nil
        v117.release("Aimbot")
        return
    end

    local vis, sp = _screenPos(part)
    arg._targetScreenPosition = vis and sp or nil

    -- prediction
    local targetPos = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, aaYOff, 0)
    if aaDelayV then
        targetPos = targetPos + part.AssemblyLinearVelocity * math.clamp(aaSpeedV / 1000, 0, 0.2)
    end

    -- wall check
    if aaWalls then
        local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
        local dir    = targetPos - camPos
        local rp2    = RaycastParams.new()
        rp2.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local myChar = LP.Character
        rp2.FilterDescendantsInstances = myChar and {myChar, char} or {char}
        if workspace:Raycast(camPos, dir * 0.99, rp2) then
            v117.release("Aimbot")
            return
        end
    end

    local facing = cam.CFrame.LookVector
    local newDir = (targetPos - cam.CFrame.Position).Unit
    if newDir == Vector3.zero then
        v117.release("Aimbot")
        return
    end

    local function wrapA(a)
        while a > math.pi  do a = a - 2 * math.pi end
        while a < -math.pi do a = a + 2 * math.pi end
        return a
    end
    local diffYaw   = wrapA(math.atan2(facing.X, facing.Z) - math.atan2(newDir.X, newDir.Z))
    local diffPitch = math.asin(math.clamp(facing.Y, -1, 1)) - math.asin(math.clamp(newDir.Y, -1, 1))
    -- normalized easing: Lerp/5 (not /10) so mid-range values stay responsive, K=150 for feel
    -- Smoothing 1-100, Lerp 1-10, Sensitivity 1-20
    local lerpT = math.min((aaSpeedV / 100) * (aaLerpV / 5) * (aaSensV / 20) * (dt or (1/60)) * 175, 1)

    v117.claim("Aimbot", 0)
    if _isMobile then
        local yawRot   = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), diffYaw   * lerpT)
        local pitchRot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(cam.CFrame.RightVector, diffPitch * lerpT)
        cam.CFrame     = pitchRot * yawRot * cam.CFrame
    else
        if not mousemoverel_ then v117.release("Aimbot") return end
        local moveConst = Vector2.new(math.rad(0.5), 0.77 * math.rad(0.5))
        local ok, sens  = pcall(function() return UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings").MouseSensitivity end)
        if not ok or not sens or sens == 0 then sens = 1 end
        local angle = Vector2.new(diffYaw, diffPitch) / (moveConst * sens) * lerpT
        pcall(mousemoverel_, angle.X, angle.Y)
    end
end

index2.Destroy = function(arg)
    v117.release("Aimbot")
    arg._trove:Destroy()
end

return index2
end

local function fn35()
tbl17.c_()
return function(l,I,W)local N=W.Parent;local P,a=l:Check(I,W,N);if P then return true,I;end;P=W.Position-I;local e=P.Magnitude;local c,E=P/e,W.Size.Magnitude/2;local P,p=math.min(9.9,e-E),false;if a~=nil and P>0 and a.Distance<P then e=I+c*P;if l:Check(e,W,N)then return false,e;end;p=true;end;e=Vector3.yAxis;E=c:Cross(if math.abs(c:Dot(e))>0.99 then Vector3.xAxis else e).Unit;a,e=E:Cross(c).Unit,p and 6 or 7;for p=0,e-1,1 do P=math.tau*p/e;c=I+(E*math.cos(P)+a*math.sin(P))*9.9;if l:Check(c,W,N)then return false,c;end;end;return false,nil;end
end

do -- gV
local function fn35()
local v120 = tbl17.bG()
local v121 = tbl17.c4()
local v126 = tbl17.k()
local v117 = tbl17.co()
local v133 = tbl17.dg()

local data = v120.Data
local LP = player
local hookfunction_ = K.fn("hookfunction")
local newcclosure_ = K.fn("newcclosure")

local function _getPlayerChars()
    local out = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
            local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                table.insert(out, plr.Character)
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

local function _screenPos(part)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local sp, vis = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    return vis, Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
end

local function _getAimCenter()
    if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    end
    return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
end

local function _getTarget(fovRadius, visOnly)
    local mp = _getAimCenter()
    local best, bestD = nil, fovRadius
    for _, char in ipairs(_getPlayerChars()) do
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then continue end
        local vis, sp2 = _screenPos(hrp)
        if not vis then continue end
        if visOnly and not vis then continue end
        local d = (sp2 - mp).Magnitude
        if d < bestD then best, bestD = char, d end
    end
    return best
end

local function _getUseItemRemote()
    return ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("UseItem", true)
end

local _startShootCache = nil
local function _getStartShootEnum()
    if _startShootCache then return _startShootCache end
    local RSMods = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
    if RSMods then
        local ok, lib = pcall(require, RSMods:FindFirstChild("EnumLibrary"))
        if ok and lib then
            local ok2, v = pcall(function() return lib:ToEnum("StartShooting") end)
            if ok2 and v then _startShootCache = v end
        end
    end
    return _startShootCache
end

local index2 = {}
index2.__index = index2

index2.new = function(arg, arg2, arg3, inputBinding, textIndicatorList)
    local silentAim = v126.new("silent_aim_v2")
    local tbl18 = {
        _trove = silentAim,
        _inputBinding = inputBinding,
        _textIndicatorList = textIndicatorList,
        _active = false,
        _currentTarget = nil,
        _currentHitbox = nil,
        _targetScreenPosition = nil,
        _hookDone = false,
        _oldFire = nil,
    }
    setmetatable(tbl18, index2)

    silentAim:Add(v121:ObserveEnabledKeybind({ "SilentAim" }, function(active)
        tbl18._active = active
        if inputBinding then
            pcall(function() inputBinding:SetEnabled(false) end)
        end
    end))

    -- disable the Kicia-level input intercept: v2 uses hookfunction instead
    if inputBinding then
        pcall(function() inputBinding:SetEnabled(false) end)
        pcall(function() inputBinding:SetHandler(function() end) end)
    end

    -- install FireServer hook (v2 approach)
    task.spawn(function()
        local rem
        for _ = 1, 300 do
            rem = _getUseItemRemote()
            if rem then break end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        if not rem or not hookfunction_ or not newcclosure_ then return end
        if tbl18._hookDone then return end
        tbl18._oldFire = hookfunction_(rem.FireServer, newcclosure_(function(self, obj, action, camdata, ...)
            if tbl18._active then
                local saData = data.SilentAim
                local startShot = _getStartShootEnum()
                local isShot = startShot and (
                    action == startShot or
                    (type(action) == "string" and string.byte(action, 1) == 0x22)
                )
                if isShot then
                    local chance = saData.ActivationChance or 100
                    if math.random(0, 100) <= chance then
                        local fovR = (saData.Fov and saData.Fov.Radius) or 120
                        local visOnly = (saData.TargetConditions and saData.TargetConditions.Visible) or false
                        local target = _getTarget(fovR, visOnly)
                        if target then
                            local hsV    = (type(saData.HeadshotChance) == "number" and saData.HeadshotChance) or 65
                            local bodyV  = (type(saData.BodyChance)      == "number" and saData.BodyChance)      or 35
                            local hitbox
                            local roll = math.random(0, 100)
                            if roll <= hsV then
                                hitbox = target:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead")
                                    or target:FindFirstChild("HitboxHeadSmall")
                                    or target:FindFirstChild("Head")
                            elseif roll <= hsV + bodyV then
                                hitbox = target:FindFirstChild("HitboxBody")
                                    or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            end
                            if hitbox then
                                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                                -- wall check
                                if saData.CheckWalls ~= false then
                                    local rp2 = RaycastParams.new()
                                    rp2.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                                    local myChar = LP.Character
                                    rp2.FilterDescendantsInstances = myChar and {myChar, target} or {target}
                                    local hit2 = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position,
                                        (hitbox.Position - cam.CFrame.Position) * 0.99, rp2)
                                    if hit2 then
                                        return tbl18._oldFire(self, obj, action, camdata, ...)
                                    end
                                end
                                local function encodeCF(cf)
                                    local rx, ry, rz = cf:ToOrientation()
                                    return {
                                        ["\x00"] = cf.X, ["\x01"] = cf.Y, ["\x02"] = cf.Z,
                                        ["\x03"] = rx,   ["\x04"] = ry,   ["\x05"] = rz,
                                    }
                                end
                                if type(camdata) == "table" and camdata["\x01"] then
                                    local inner = camdata["\x01"]
                                    inner["\x01"] = encodeCF(CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, hitbox.Position))
                                    inner["\x02"] = hitbox
                                    inner["\x03"] = nil
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return tbl18._oldFire(self, obj, action, camdata, ...)
        end))
        tbl18._hookDone = true
    end)

    return tbl18
end

index2.GetTargetScreenPosition = function(arg)
    return arg._targetScreenPosition
end

index2.Update = function(arg, dt)
    local saData = data.SilentAim
    if not arg._active then
        arg._targetScreenPosition = nil
        return
    end
    local fovR = (saData.Fov and saData.Fov.Radius) or 120
    local visOnly = (saData.TargetConditions and saData.TargetConditions.Visible) or false
    local target = _getTarget(fovR, visOnly)
    if not target then
        arg._targetScreenPosition = nil
        return
    end
    local head = target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if head then
        local vis, sp = _screenPos(head)
        arg._targetScreenPosition = vis and sp or nil
    end
end

index2.Destroy = function(arg)
    if arg._hookDone and arg._oldFire then
        local rem = _getUseItemRemote()
        if rem and hookfunction_ then
            pcall(hookfunction_, rem.FireServer, arg._oldFire)
        end
    end
    arg._trove:Destroy()
end

return index2
end

tbl17.cache.gV = gv
end

end

index2._FireStrike = function(arg)
local currentCamera = v120.CurrentCamera
if currentCamera == nil then
return
end
local lightning = v117.Data.Weather.Lightning
local height = lightning.Height
local position = currentCamera.CFrame.Position
local tau = math.tau
local n = math.random() * tau
local distance = lightning.Distance
local n33 = math.min(v116.LightningRadiusMin, distance)
local n34 = n33 + math.random() * (distance - n33)
local n35 = position.X + math.cos(n) * n34
local n36 = position.Z + math.sin(n) * n34
local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local character = v121.LocalPlayer and v121.LocalPlayer.Character

if character then
raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
end

local n37 = position.Y - v116.LightningGroundDrop
local hit = v120:Raycast(Vector3.new(n35, position.Y + height, n36), Vector3.new(0, -v116.LightningRayLength, 0), raycastParams)

if hit then
n37 = hit.Position.Y
end

local vector = Vector3.new(n35, n37, n36)
local vector2 = Vector3.new
local lightningJitter = v116.LightningJitter
local n38 = n35 + (math.random() - 0.5) * lightningJitter
local lightningJitter2 = v116.LightningJitter

local tbl18 = {
Color = lightning.Color,
Thickness = lightning.Thickness,
MaxRadius = lightning.Jaggedness,
Branches = lightning.Branches,
FlashBrightness = lightning.Flash,
Sparks = {
Enabled = lightning.Sparks.Enabled,
Color = lightning.Sparks.Color,
Count = lightning.Sparks.Count,
Thickness = lightning.Sparks.Thickness,
Distance = lightning.Sparks.Distance,
Speed = lightning.Sparks.Speed,
Jaggedness = lightning.Sparks.Jaggedness,
},
Explosion = {
Enabled = lightning.Explosion.Enabled,
Size = lightning.Explosion.Size,
Bolts = lightning.Explosion.Bolts,
Color = lightning.Explosion.Color,
},
}

arg._lightning:Strike(vector2(n38, n37 + height, n36 + (math.random() - 0.5) * lightningJitter2), vector, tbl18)

if lightning.Sound.Enabled then
local v122 = fn38(lightning.Sound.SoundId)

if v122 ~= nil then
local volume = lightning.Sound.Volume
local delay = lightning.Sound.Delay
arg:_PlayThunder(math.sqrt((n35 - position.X) ^ 2 + (n36 - position.Z) ^ 2), volume, delay, v122)
end
end
end

index2._PlayThunder = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, soundId)
local n = arg4 and arg2 / v116.ThunderSpeed or 0
local volume = arg3 * math.max(v116.ThunderVolumeFloor, 1 - arg2 / v116.ThunderFalloff)
local n33 = v116.ThunderPitchMax - v116.ThunderPitchMin
local playbackSpeed = v116.ThunderPitchMin + math.random() * n33

if activeTrove == nil then

end

sound.SoundId = soundId

sound.PlayOnRemove = v86[34]

end))
end

local v122 = math.rad(weather.Wind.Angle)

local n33 = math.cos(v122) * strength

    local hideTime   = type(cfg.HideTime)   == "number" and cfg.HideTime   or 0.25
    local attackTime = type(cfg.AttackTime) == "number" and cfg.AttackTime or 0.1
    -- initialise phase state
    if not arg._vsPhaseEnd then
        arg._vsPhaseEnd = now + hideTime
        arg._vsHiding   = true
    end
    if now >= arg._vsPhaseEnd then
        arg._vsHiding = not arg._vsHiding
        arg._vsPhaseEnd = now + (arg._vsHiding and hideTime or attackTime)
    end
    if arg._vsHiding then
        -- pick a safe void zone via CollectionService, fall back to Y=-5000
        local hideCF
        local ok, CS = pcall(game.GetService, game, "CollectionService")
        if ok and CS then
            local parts = CS:GetTagged("OutOfBoundsPart")
            local myPos = clientCFrame.Position
            local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
            for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
                local kd = part:GetAttribute("KillDelay")
                if kd ~= nil and kd ~= 0 then
                    local d = (part.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                    if d < bestD then best, bestD = part, d end
                end
            end
            if best then hideCF = CFrame.new(best.Position) end
        end
        if not hideCF then hideCF = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0) end
        characterController:SetServerCFrame(hideCF)
        return  -- stay hidden; don't fire
    end
    -- attack phase: fall through to normal ragebot logic
end
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- ── HarionVoid backend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Alternates between extreme-skyward void (unhittable) and a computed attack
-- position directly behind the target's root, facing their head. Falls through
-- to the normal _Plan / WeaponAction chain during the attack phase so the shot
-- fires via the existing ragebot pipeline. _EvadePlan returns the stored
-- attack CFrame with ShouldSkipDefense so _ApplyPlan does not re-derive it.
if mode == "HarionVoid" then
    local now = os.clock()
    local hvcfg = (v115.Data.Ragebot and v115.Data.Ragebot.HarionVoid) or {}
    local hideTime  = type(hvcfg.HideTime)  == "number" and hvcfg.HideTime  or 0.25
    local shootTime = type(hvcfg.ShootTime) == "number" and hvcfg.ShootTime or 0.03
    if not arg._hvPhaseEnd then
        arg._hvPhaseEnd = now + hideTime
        arg._hvHiding   = true
    end
    if now >= arg._hvPhaseEnd then
        arg._hvHiding   = not arg._hvHiding
        arg._hvPhaseEnd = now + (arg._hvHiding and hideTime or shootTime)
    end
    if arg._hvHiding then
        -- hide in extreme skyward void — OOB kill zones are ground-level only
        characterController:SetServerCFrame(CFrame.new(0, 1073741824, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi, math.pi, math.pi))
        arg._hvAttackCF = nil
        return
    end
    -- attack phase: compute CFrame behind the target's root facing their head
    local hvTarget = arg._targetSelection:GetTarget()
    if hvTarget then
        local hvChar = hvTarget.AliveState.Character
        local hvRoot = hvChar and hvChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hvHead = hvChar and (hvChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or hvRoot)
        if hvRoot and hvHead then
            local shootPos  = hvRoot.Position - hvRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 2.5 + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
            arg._hvAttackCF = CFrame.new(shootPos, hvHead.Position)
        else
            arg._hvAttackCF = nil
        end
    else
        arg._hvAttackCF = nil
    end
    -- fall through → _Plan uses _EvadePlan("HarionVoid") → stored CF → WeaponAction fires
end
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- ── OrbitDesync backend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Each Update tick advances an orbit angle around the target's head. Server
-- sees the character at the current orbit position (exposed). Client is kept
-- visually at that same position via a BindToRenderStep, so locally the
-- character appears to orbit while the server position matches. When no
-- target exists the character is voided skyward and the render bind is removed.
if mode == "OrbitDesync" then
    local now    = os.clock()
    local odcfg  = (v115.Data.Ragebot and v115.Data.Ragebot.OrbitDesync) or {}
    local orbitRadius = type(odcfg.Radius)      == "number" and math.clamp(odcfg.Radius,      1.25, 5)  or 3
    local orbitHeight = type(odcfg.Height)      == "number" and math.clamp(odcfg.Height,      -2,   6)  or 1.5
    local strafeSpeed = type(odcfg.StrafeSpeed) == "number" and odcfg.StrafeSpeed                        or 2
    if not arg._odAngle then arg._odAngle = 0 end
    if not arg._odLastT then arg._odLastT = now end
    local dt = now - arg._odLastT
    arg._odLastT = now
    arg._odAngle = (arg._odAngle + dt * math.max(1, strafeSpeed * 1.5)) % (math.pi * 2)
    local odTarget = arg._targetSelection:GetTarget()
    if odTarget then
        local odChar  = odTarget.AliveState.Character
        local odRoot  = odChar and odChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local odHead  = odChar and (odChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or odRoot)
        if odRoot and odHead then
            local angle    = arg._odAngle
            local orbitPos = odHead.Position + Vector3.new(
                math.cos(angle) * orbitRadius,
                orbitHeight,
                math.sin(angle) * orbitRadius
            )
            local orbitCF   = CFrame.new(orbitPos, odHead.Position)
            arg._odAttackCF  = orbitCF
            arg._odCurrentCF = orbitCF
            -- bind a render step once to hold the client visual at the orbit position
            if not arg._odRenderBound then
                arg._odRenderBound = true
                local rsvc   = game:GetService("RunService")
                local rbRoot = state.RootPart
                rsvc:BindToRenderStep("GravOrbit", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
                    if v115.Data.Ragebot.Evasion.Mode ~= "OrbitDesync" then
                        rsvc:UnbindFromRenderStep("GravOrbit")
                        arg._odRenderBound = nil
                        return
                    end
                    local cf = arg._odCurrentCF
                    if rbRoot and rbRoot.Parent and cf then
                        rbRoot.CFrame = cf
                    end
                end)
            end
        else
            arg._odAttackCF = nil
        end
    else
        -- no target: void skyward, tear down the render bind
        if arg._odRenderBound then
            game:GetService("RunService"):UnbindFromRenderStep("GravOrbit")
            arg._odRenderBound = nil
        end
        arg._odAttackCF  = nil
        arg._odCurrentCF = nil
        characterController:SetServerCFrame(CFrame.new(0, 1073741824, 0))
        return
    end
    -- fall through → _Plan uses _EvadePlan("OrbitDesync") → stored CF → WeaponAction fires
end
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local target = arg._targetSelection:GetTarget()

if target ~= nil then
arg._lastTargetWorld = target.AliveState.RootPart.Position
else
arg._lastTargetWorld = nil
end

local v131 = arg:_Plan(arg2, v130, target, state.RootPart, clientCFrame, mode)
arg:_ApplyPlan(v131, target, innerContext)
local reloadGun = arg._reloadGun

if reloadGun ~= nil and arg._reloadReadyAt == nil and arg._pendingDepletionAmmo == nil and not reloadGun:IsReloading() then
arg._reloadReadyAt = os.clock() + v122.getEstimatedReplicationDelay()
end

arg:_ApplyForcedCrouch(v131.ShouldForceCrouch == true)
local v132 = innerContext.ItemBehaviors:EquippedItemAsGun()
local ammo = v132 ~= nil and v132:GetAmmo() or 0
local shotRequestCount = v132 ~= nil and v132.ShotRequestCount or 0
local weaponAction = v131.WeaponAction

if weaponAction ~= nil then
weaponAction()

if v132 ~= nil and (v132 ~= nil and v132.ShotRequestCount - shotRequestCount or 0) > 0 and v132:GetExpectedAmmoAfterPendingShots() <= 0 then
innerContext.CharacterController:SetServerCFrame(v127.getImmune())
local now2 = os.clock()
arg._reloadGun = v132
arg._reloadReadyAt = now2 + v122.getEstimatedReplicationDelay()
arg._pendingDepletionAmmo = ammo
arg._reloadAcknowledgementDeadline = now2 + v122.getEstimatedRemoteDelay() + v122.getEstimatedReplicationDelay()
end
end
end

index2._Plan = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7)
local flag19 = arg4 ~= nil and not arg._spatialLimitGate:Tick(arg4)
local v130 = arg:_PlanReloadTransport(arg3)
if v130 ~= nil then
return v130
end

if arg3 == nil then

if arg3.Type == "Swap" then

end

end

if arg3.Type == "Reload" then

end

if arg4 == nil then

local item = arg3.Item

end

if item.__type == "Melee" then
local v131, v132, v133 = arg._meleeStrategy:Plan(arg2, arg4, item, arg5, flag19)

CFrame = v131,

index2._ClearReloadTransport = function(arg)

end

index2._PlanReloadTransport = function(arg, arg2)
local reloadGun = arg._reloadGun
local now2 = os.clock()

if reloadGun ~= nil then
if (arg._innerContext ~= nil and arg._innerContext.ItemBehaviors:EquippedItemAsGun() or nil) ~= reloadGun or arg2 ~= nil and (arg2.Type == "Swap" or arg2.Type == "Attack") and arg2.Item ~= reloadGun then
arg:_ClearReloadTransport()
return nil
end

if reloadGun:IsReloading() then
arg._reloadReadyAt = nil
arg._pendingDepletionAmmo = nil
arg._reloadAcknowledgementDeadline = nil
return fn36()
end

local ammo = reloadGun:GetAmmo()

if arg._pendingDepletionAmmo ~= nil then
local reloadAcknowledgementDeadline = arg._reloadAcknowledgementDeadline

if not (ammo <= 0 and reloadGun:GetAmmoReserve() > 0) then
local flag19 = reloadAcknowledgementDeadline == nil or now2 >= reloadAcknowledgementDeadline

if not flag19 then
local v130 = v86[186]
flag19 = reloadGun:GetExpectedAmmoAfterPendingShots() > v130
end

if flag19 then
arg:_ClearReloadTransport()
return nil
end
return fn36()
end

arg._pendingDepletionAmmo = nil
arg._reloadAcknowledgementDeadline = nil
end

if ammo > 0 or reloadGun:GetAmmoReserve() <= 0 then
arg:_ClearReloadTransport()
return nil
end
local reloadReadyAt = arg._reloadReadyAt

if reloadReadyAt == nil then
reloadReadyAt = now2 + v122.getEstimatedReplicationDelay()
arg._reloadReadyAt = reloadReadyAt
end

local v130 = fn36()
local reloadAcknowledgementDeadline = arg._reloadAcknowledgementDeadline

if now2 >= reloadReadyAt and (reloadAcknowledgementDeadline == nil or now2 >= reloadAcknowledgementDeadline) then
v130.WeaponAction = function()
if reloadGun:Reload() then
arg._reloadAcknowledgementDeadline = os.clock() + v122.getEstimatedRemoteDelay() + v122.getEstimatedReplicationDelay()
end
end
end

return v130
end

if arg2 == nil or arg2.Type ~= "Reload" then
return nil
end
arg._reloadGun = arg2.Item
arg._reloadReadyAt = nil
arg._reloadAcknowledgementDeadline = nil
arg._pendingDepletionAmmo = nil
return fn36()
end

index2._EvadePlan = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
if arg3 == "Off" then
return {}
end

if arg3 == "ProjectileBreaker" then
return { CFrame = arg._projectileBreakerTeleport:Compute(arg2), ShouldSkipDefense = v86[34] }
end
if arg3 == "TeleportV2" then
return {}
end
-- VoidSpam manages its own hide/attack phases in Update above; when
-- _EvadePlan is reached under VoidSpam (no target or no weapon action
-- in the attack phase) stay in place rather than firing the random
-- extreme-position evasion that kills the character via OOB detection.
if arg3 == "VoidSpam" then
return {}
end
-- HarionVoid: attack phase stores the computed CFrame in arg._hvAttackCF.
-- Return it with ShouldSkipDefense so _ApplyPlan does not re-derive it.
-- If no target the field is nil, so return {} (stay in place / void position).
if arg3 == "HarionVoid" then
return arg._hvAttackCF and { CFrame = arg._hvAttackCF, ShouldSkipDefense = v86[34] } or {}
end
-- OrbitDesync: same pattern — the orbit CFrame is stored each Update tick.
if arg3 == "OrbitDesync" then
return arg._odAttackCF and { CFrame = arg._odAttackCF, ShouldSkipDefense = v86[34] } or {}
end
return { CFrame = v121.compute(arg2) }
end

index2._ApplyPlan = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
local characterController = arg4.CharacterController
local cFrame = arg2.CFrame

if cFrame == nil or arg3 == nil or arg2.ShouldSkipDefense then
characterController:SetServerCFrame(cFrame)
characterController:SendViewAngles(20, arg2.ViewAngles)
return
end

local aliveState = arg3.AliveState
local v130 = v129(arg4.ItemBehaviors)
local v131 = v116.getDefensiveCFrame(cFrame, v130, arg3.FighterState, aliveState.RootPart)
characterController:SetServerCFrame(v131)

if arg2.IsAimPose or arg2.ShouldDefendInPlace then
arg._lastDefensiveViewAngles = v116.getDefensiveViewAngles(v130, arg3.FighterState)
end

characterController:SendViewAngles(v86[9], arg2.ViewAngles or arg._lastDefensiveViewAngles)
end

end

else
arg._stateHook:ClearForced("IsCrouching")
end
end

end

end

--  Lithium logo: written to disk once per load and turned into an asset id
--  for the menu rail and the watermark.
do
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local map = {}
    for i = 1, 64 do map[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
    local function decode(s)
        local out = buffer.create(#s * 3 // 4 + 3)
        local n = 0
        for i = 1, #s, 4 do
            local a, b, c, d = s:byte(i, i + 3)
            local vc, vd = map[c], map[d]
            local v = map[a] * 262144 + map[b] * 4096 + (vc or 0) * 64 + (vd or 0)
            buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.rshift(v, 16))
            n += 1
            if vc then buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(v, 8), 255)) n += 1 end
            if vd then buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.band(v, 255)) n += 1 end
        end
        return buffer.readstring(out, 0, n)
    end
    local wrf, gca = K.fn("writefile"), K.fn("getcustomasset") or K.fn("getsynasset")
    if wrf and gca then
        local path = "kiciarebuild/lithium_logo.png"
        local ok = pcall(wrf, path, decode(LITHIUM_LOGO_B64))
        local ok2, id = pcall(gca, path)
        if ok and ok2 and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then K.LithiumLogo = id end
    end
    local SCIFI_COMBAT_B64 = ""
    local SCIFI_AIMBOT_B64 = ""
    local SCIFI_PLAYER_B64 = ""
    local SCIFI_VISUALS_B64 = ""
    local SCIFI_WORLD_B64 = ""

            local _path = "kiciarebuild/scifi_combat.png"

            local _ok2, _id = pcall(gca, _path)
            if _ok and _ok2 and type(_id) == "string" and _id ~= "" then
                K.ScifiIcon_combat = _id
            else
                K.ScifiIcon_combat = ""
            end
        end
        do
            local _path = "kiciarebuild/scifi_aimbot.png"

                K.ScifiIcon_general = ""
            end
        end
        do
            local _path = "kiciarebuild/scifi_ragebot.png"
            local _ok = pcall(wrf, _path, decode(SCIFI_RAGEBOT_B64))
            local _ok2, _id = pcall(gca, _path)
            if _ok and _ok2 and type(_id) == "string" and _id ~= "" then
                K.ScifiIcon_ragebot = _id
            else
                K.ScifiIcon_ragebot = ""
            end
        end
    end
end

    local store = tbl17.bG()
    getgenv().GravitonConfig = store
    local profiles = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bN().new(store))
    store:UseMiddleware(profiles)
    local fonts = tbl17.az()
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.aB().use(store, { "Notifications" }, { "Theme" }, function(f) return fonts:Get(f) end,
        tbl17.bI().Notifications))

    local reporter = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.ad().new())
    local state = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.ae().new("kiciarebuild/rivals"))
    local stateData = state:Load()
    if stateData.AutoLoad and stateData.AutoLoadConfigName ~= nil then
        local r = reporter:ReportResult(store:LoadFromFile(stateData.AutoLoadConfigName))
        if not r.Ok then
            local text = "Failed to auto-load the selected config"
            if string.find(r.Error.Detail, "newer than current version", 1, true) ~= nil then
                text = "Your selected config was saved by a newer version - update or pick another config"
            end
            tbl17.aB().get():Notify(text)
        elseif #tbl17.bc().takeDroppedPaths() > 0 then
            tbl17.aB().get():Notify("Some saved settings could not be restored and were reset to defaults")
        end
    end

    local Theme = tbl17.A()
    local theme = store.Data.Theme
    if theme ~= nil then
        for k, v in next, theme do
            if Theme.Tokens[k] ~= nil and typeof(v) == "Color3" then Theme.refresh(k, v) end
        end
    end

    local registry = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bK().new())
    local identities = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bL().new(registry))
    local tags = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bM().new(registry))
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bR().new(tags, registry))
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bZ().new(identities))
    local avatar = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.b6().new(registry))

    return {
        StoreProfiles = profiles,
        PlayerRegistry = registry,
        PlayerIdentities = identities,
        PlayerTags = tags,
        DecoratorFactory = avatar ~= nil and avatar:GetDecoratorFactory() or nil,
        ArmAvatarSpoofer = function() avatar:Arm() end,
        GeneralState = state,
        GeneralStateData = stateData,
    }
end)()

function K.Unload()
    if K.destroyed then return end
    K.destroyed = true
    for _, f in ipairs(K.cleanups) do pcall(f) end
    pcall(function() GlobalTrove:Destroy() end)
    if getgenv().KiciaRebuild == K then getgenv().KiciaRebuild = nil end
end

local flagsReg = {}
local cfgSys = nil

local function cfgColor(v)
	if type(v) == "table" then
		return Color3.fromRGB(v[1] or 255, v[2] or 255, v[3] or 255)
	end
	return v
end

local function regFlag(flag, handle, kind, default)
	if flag and handle then
		flagsReg[flag] = { handle = handle, kind = kind or "raw", default = default }
		if cfgSys and cfgSys.lastData and type(cfgSys.lastData.flags) == "table" then
			local v = cfgSys.lastData.flags[flag]
			if v ~= nil then
				if kind == "color" then
					v = cfgColor(v)
				elseif kind == "keybind" then
					v = Enum.KeyCode[v]
				end
				-- Colors: use silent at registration time to avoid firing the callback before
				-- the ReactiveStore Color3→ColorSequence observer is live.  Firing the callback
				-- at startup stores Color3 in gc.Data which crashes the skeleton renderer's
				-- .Keypoints access on the first player join.  Silent updates the picker visual
				-- without touching gc.Data, so the ColorSequence stays intact.
				if kind == "color" and type(handle.silent) == "function" then
					pcall(handle.silent, v)
				else
					pcall(handle.Set, v)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function propSetRaw(o, k, v) o[k] = v end
local tw, twFlush

local TW_MODE = { instant = false }
do
	local live = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local seq = 0
	local noop = function() end
	local doneConn = { Connected = false, Disconnect = noop }
	local doneSig = {
		Connect = function(_, fn) task.defer(fn, Enum.PlaybackState.Completed); return doneConn end,
		Once = function(_, fn) task.defer(fn, Enum.PlaybackState.Completed); return doneConn end,
		Wait = function() return Enum.PlaybackState.Completed end,
	}
	local done = { Play = noop, Pause = noop, Cancel = noop, Completed = doneSig, PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Completed }
	function tw(o, i, p)
		if TW_MODE.instant and (i.RepeatCount or 0) == 0 and (i.Time or 0) <= 0.6 then
			for k, v in pairs(p) do pcall(propSetRaw, o, k, v) end
			return done
		end
		local okT, tRet = pcall(function()
			local t = TweenServ:Create(o, i, p)
			if (i.RepeatCount or 0) == 0 then
				local l = live[o]
				if not l then l = {}; live[o] = l end
				seq = seq + 1
				l[t] = { seq, p }
				t.Completed:Connect(function()
					local m = live[o]
					if m then m[t] = nil end
				end)
			end
			t:Play()
			return t
		end)
		if okT then return tRet end
	end
	function twFlush(keep)
		local list = {}
		for o, l in pairs(live) do
			if not (keep and keep(o)) then
				for t, e in pairs(l) do list[#list + 1] = { e[1], o, t, e[2] } end
				live[o] = nil
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			local o, goal = e[2], e[4]
			pcall(function() e[3]:Cancel() end)
			for k, v in pairs(goal) do pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end
		end
	end
end

local THEME, create, corner, fullRound, stroke, DRAG, setDraggable, textW, wheelScrollX, accentObjs, regAccent, accentHooks

THEME = {
	list = {},
	kind = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	strike = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	nextPrune = 6000,
	K = { Frame = 1, ImageLabel = 1, ImageButton = 1, CanvasGroup = 1, ViewportFrame = 1,
		ScrollingFrame = 2, TextLabel = 3, TextButton = 3, TextBox = 4, UIStroke = 5, UICorner = 6 },
}

function THEME.prune(l)
	local keep, kd, st = {}, THEME.kind, THEME.strike
	for _, o in ipairs(l) do
		if o.Parent == nil then
			if st[o] then kd[o] = nil; st[o] = nil else st[o] = true; keep[#keep + 1] = o end
		else
			if st[o] then st[o] = nil end
			keep[#keep + 1] = o
		end
	end
	return keep
end
THEME.gsOn = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function THEME.add(o, cls)
	local k = THEME.K[cls]
	if not k or THEME.kind[o] then return end
	THEME.kind[o] = k
	local l = THEME.list
	l[#l + 1] = o
	if #l > THEME.nextPrune then
		THEME.list = THEME.prune(l)
		THEME.nextPrune = math.max(6000, #THEME.list * 2)
	end
end

function create(c, pr, pa)
	local o = Instance.new(c)
	for k, v in pairs(pr) do
		if k ~= "Parent" then pcall(propSetRaw, o, k, v) end
	end
	if pa then
		o.Parent = pa
	end
	THEME.add(o, c)
	local gs = THEME.gs
	local kk = THEME.kind[o]
	if gs and (kk == 3 or kk == 4) then
		local f = o.Font
		local face = gs[f]
		if face and pcall(propSetRaw, o, "FontFace", face) then THEME.gsOn[o] = f end
	end
	return o
end

function corner(r, p)
	local uc = Instance.new("UICorner")
	uc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6)
	uc.Parent = p
	THEME.add(uc, "UICorner")
	return uc
end
function fullRound(p)
	local uc = Instance.new("UICorner")
	uc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	uc.Parent = p
	return uc
end

function stroke(t, c, p, mode)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = t or 1
	s.Color = c or T.Line
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = mode or Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Parent = p
	THEME.add(s, "UIStroke")
	return s
end

local GuiServ = game:GetService("GuiService")
local function pointInside(g, p)
	local ap, as = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize
	return p.X >= ap.X and p.X <= ap.X + as.X and p.Y >= ap.Y and p.Y <= ap.Y + as.Y
end
local function inputHits(g, i)
	if not (g and g.Parent and g.Visible) then return false end
	local p = Vector2.new(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y)
	if pointInside(g, p) then return true end

	local ok, inset = pcall(function() return GuiServ:GetGuiInset() end)
	if ok and inset then return pointInside(g, p + Vector2.new(0, inset.Y)) end
	return false
end

DRAG = { floats = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), pend = {}, busy = nil }
function DRAG.register(f)
	if f then DRAG.floats[f] = true end
	return f
end
local function dragShown(o)
	local n = 0
	while o and n < 64 do
		if o:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if not o.Visible then return false end
		elseif o:IsA("LayerCollector") then
			return o.Enabled ~= false
		end
		o = o.Parent
		n = n + 1
	end
	return true
end
function DRAG.floatOf(o)
	local n = 0
	while o and n < 64 do
		if DRAG.floats[o] then return o end
		o = o.Parent
		n = n + 1
	end
	return nil
end
local function dragZ(f)
	local d, g, n = 0, f.Parent, 0
	while g and n < 64 do
		local ok, isL = pcall(function() return g:IsA("LayerCollector") end)
		if ok and isL then
			pcall(function() d = tonumber(g.DisplayOrder) or 0 end)
			break
		end
		g = g.Parent
		n = n + 1
	end
	return d * 4096 + (tonumber(f.ZIndex) or 0)
end

local function dragOverlaps(f)
	local ap, as = f.AbsolutePosition, f.AbsoluteSize
	for o in pairs(DRAG.floats) do
		if o ~= f and o.Parent and dragShown(o) then
			local bp, bs = o.AbsolutePosition, o.AbsoluteSize
			if bp.X < ap.X + as.X and ap.X < bp.X + bs.X and bp.Y < ap.Y + as.Y and ap.Y < bp.Y + bs.Y then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function DRAG.claim(i, obj, fn)
	local f = DRAG.floatOf(obj)
	if not f or not dragOverlaps(f) then return fn() end
	local e = DRAG.pend[i]
	if not e then
		e = {}
		DRAG.pend[i] = e
		task.defer(function()
			DRAG.pend[i] = nil
			local top, tz = nil, -math.huge
			for _, c in ipairs(e) do
				local z = dragZ(c.f)
				if z > tz then top, tz = c.f, z end
			end
			for _, c in ipairs(e) do
				if c.f == top then pcall(c.fn) end
			end
		end)
	end
	e[#e + 1] = { f = f, fn = fn }
end

function DRAG.gate(obj, fn)
	return function(i)
		local t = i.UserInputType
		if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return DRAG.claim(i, obj, function() fn(i) end)
		end
		return fn(i)
	end
end

function DRAG.free()
	local b = DRAG.busy
	if not b then return true end
	local ok, st = pcall(function() return b.UserInputState end)
	if not ok or st == nil or st == Enum.UserInputState.End or st == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		DRAG.busy = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end
function DRAG.take(i) DRAG.busy = i end
function DRAG.release(i) if DRAG.busy == i or i == nil then DRAG.busy = nil end end

function setDraggable(gui, handle, exclude, cbs)
	local tgt = handle or gui
	local dragging, dragInput, startPos, startInput, moved
	DRAG.register(gui)
	hook(tgt.InputBegan, function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if exclude then
				for _, ex in ipairs(exclude) do
					if inputHits(ex, i) then return end
				end
			end
			local p0 = i.Position
			DRAG.claim(i, gui, function()
				if not DRAG.free() then return end
				DRAG.take(i)
				dragging = true
				moved = false
				startInput = p0
				startPos = gui.Position
				local endedConn
				endedConn = i.Changed:Connect(function()
					if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
						dragging = false
						DRAG.release(i)
						if endedConn then endedConn:Disconnect() end
						if moved and cbs and cbs.stop then pcall(cbs.stop) end
						moved = false
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end)
	hook(tgt.InputChanged, function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = i
		end
	end)
	hook(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
		if i == dragInput and dragging then
			local d = i.Position - startInput
			if not moved and (math.abs(d.X) + math.abs(d.Y)) >= 3 then
				moved = true
				if cbs and cbs.start then pcall(cbs.start) end
			end
			gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
		end
	end)
end

local function isDead(o)
	if typeof(o) ~= "Instance" then return o == nil end
	if o.Parent ~= nil then return false end

	return not pcall(function() o.Parent = nil end)
end
local function pruneList(list, key)
	local j = 0
	for i = 1, #list do
		local e = list[i]
		if not isDead(e[key]) then j = j + 1; list[j] = e end
	end
	for i = #list, j + 1, -1 do list[i] = nil end
end
function textW(s, size, font)
	local ok, v = pcall(function()
		return game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(s, size, font, Vector2.new(1000, 100)).X
	end)
	if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return v end
	return #tostring(s) * size * 0.6
end

function wheelScrollX(sf, enabled)
	sf.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
		if enabled and not enabled() then return end
		local before = sf.CanvasPosition
		local dz = inp.Position.Z
		task.defer(function()
			if not sf.Parent then return end
			local now = sf.CanvasPosition
			if now ~= before then return end
			local maxX = math.max(0, sf.AbsoluteCanvasSize.X - sf.AbsoluteWindowSize.X)
			if maxX <= 0 then return end
			sf.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(math.clamp(now.X - dz * 40, 0, maxX), now.Y)
		end)
	end)
end

accentObjs = {}
local accentPruneAt = 256
function regAccent(obj, prop, mode, extra)
	accentObjs[#accentObjs + 1] = { obj = obj, prop = prop, mode = mode or "color", extra = extra }
	if #accentObjs >= accentPruneAt then
		pruneList(accentObjs, "obj")
		accentPruneAt = math.max(256, #accentObjs * 2)
	end
end

accentHooks = {}
function onAccent(fn)
	accentHooks[#accentHooks + 1] = fn
end

local function accentPair(cl)
	cl = cl or T.Accent
	local h, s, v = cl:ToHSV()
	local c2 = Color3.fromHSV((h - 0.09) % 1, math.clamp(s * 0.95, 0, 1), math.clamp(v + 0.06, 0, 1))
	return c2, cl
end
local function accentSeq(kind, cl)
	local a, b = accentPair(cl)
	if kind == "aba" then
		return ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, a),
		})
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(a, b)
end
local gradObjs = {}

local gradPruneAt = 256
function regGrad(g, kind)
	gradObjs[#gradObjs + 1] = { g = g, kind = kind or "ab" }
	if #gradObjs >= gradPruneAt then
		pruneList(gradObjs, "g")
		gradPruneAt = math.max(256, #gradObjs * 2)
	end
	pcall(function() g.Color = accentSeq(kind) end)
	return g
end

function updateAllAccent(cl)
	T.Accent = cl
	T.AccentDim = shade(cl, 0.55)
	pruneList(gradObjs, "g")
	pruneList(accentObjs, "obj")
	for _, e in ipairs(gradObjs) do
		pcall(function()
			if e.g and e.g.Parent then e.g.Color = accentSeq(e.kind, cl) end
		end)
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(accentObjs) do
		pcall(function()
			if not (e.obj and e.obj.Parent) then return end
			if e.mode == "stroke" then
				e.obj.Color = cl
			elseif e.mode == "shaded" then
				e.obj[e.prop] = shade(cl, e.extra or 0.55)
			else
				e.obj[e.prop] = cl
			end
		end)
	end
	for _, fn in ipairs(accentHooks) do
		pcall(fn, cl)
	end
end

GLOW = { objs = {}, hooks = {}, keys = { head = "GlowHead", check = "GlowCheck", edge = "GlowEdge" } }
function GLOW.on(k)
	local v = SETTINGS[GLOW.keys[k] or ""]
	if k == "edge" then return v == true end
	return v ~= false
end
function GLOW.color(k)
	local t = type(SETTINGS.GlowColors) == "table" and SETTINGS.GlowColors[k]
	if type(t) == "table" and tonumber(t[1]) then
		return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(t[1]) or 255, tonumber(t[2]) or 255, tonumber(t[3]) or 255)
	end
	return nil
end
local function glowPaint(e)
	local o = e.o
	local c = GLOW.color(e.k)
	if e.p == "grad" then
		o.Color = c and ColorSequence.new(c) or accentSeq(e.g or "ab")
	else
		o[e.p] = c or T.Accent
	end
	if type(e.vo) == "function" then e.vo(GLOW.on(e.k))
	elseif e.vo then e.vo.Visible = GLOW.on(e.k) end
end

function GLOW.add(k, o, p, g, vo)
	local e = { k = k, o = o, p = p, g = g, vo = vo }
	GLOW.objs[#GLOW.objs + 1] = e
	if #GLOW.objs % 256 == 0 then pruneList(GLOW.objs, "o") end
	pcall(glowPaint, e)
	return o
end
function GLOW.onChange(fn) GLOW.hooks[#GLOW.hooks + 1] = fn end
function GLOW.refresh(k)
	pruneList(GLOW.objs, "o")
	for _, e in ipairs(GLOW.objs) do
		if not k or e.k == k then pcall(glowPaint, e) end
	end
	for _, fn in ipairs(GLOW.hooks) do pcall(fn, k) end
end
function GLOW.setColor(k, c)
	if type(SETTINGS.GlowColors) ~= "table" then SETTINGS.GlowColors = {} end
	if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
		SETTINGS.GlowColors[k] = { math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5) }
	else
		SETTINGS.GlowColors[k] = nil
	end
	GLOW.refresh(k)
end
function GLOW.set(k, on)
	SETTINGS[GLOW.keys[k]] = on and true or false
	GLOW.refresh(k)
end
onAccent(function() GLOW.refresh() end)

local CAMO_NAMES = { "PlayerInterface", "GameUI", "HUD", "InterfaceHandler", "ClientInterface", "MainGUI", "UIController", "InGameUI" }
local camoPool = {}

function nextCamoName()
	if #camoPool == 0 then
		for i = 1, #CAMO_NAMES do
			camoPool[i] = CAMO_NAMES[i]
		end
		for i = #camoPool, 2, -1 do
			local j = math.random(1, i)
			camoPool[i], camoPool[j] = camoPool[j], camoPool[i]
		end
	end
	return table.remove(camoPool)
end

local libGuis = {}
function makeGui(name, displayOrder, ignoreInset)
	local g = create("ScreenGui", {
		Name = name,
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
		IgnoreGuiInset = ignoreInset or false,
		Enabled = true,
		DisplayOrder = displayOrder,
	})
	libGuis[#libGuis + 1] = g
	local guiOk = false
	pcall(function()
		local pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
		if pg then
			g.Parent = pg
			guiOk = true
		end
	end)
	if not guiOk then
		pcall(function()
			g.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
			guiOk = true
		end)
	end
	if not guiOk then
		pcall(function()
			g.Parent = CoreGui
		end)
	end
	pcall(function()
		local pg = (syn and syn.protect_gui) or protect_gui or protectgui
		if pg then pcall(pg, g) end
	end)
	return g
end

pcall(function()

	blurEffect.Size = 0
	blurEffect.Parent = Lighting
	getgenv().AX_BlurEffect = blurEffect

blurState = { open = false }
function applyBlur(amount, t)
	t = t or 0.2
	blurState.open = amount > 0
	if amount > 0 and tonumber(SETTINGS.BlurSize) then amount = math.max(0.6, tonumber(SETTINGS.BlurSize)) end
	getgenv().AX_MenuOpen = amount > 0
	if backdropFrame then
		local veil = (amount > 0 and SETTINGS.Dim ~= false) and 0.5 or 1
		tw(backdropFrame, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { BackgroundTransparency = veil })
	end
	if blurEffect then
		pcall(function()
			blurEffect.Enabled = SETTINGS.Blur ~= false
			tw(blurEffect, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = amount })
		end)
	end
end

function refreshBlur()
	if blurState.open then applyBlur(IS_MOBILE and 8 or 10, 0.15) end
end
