local CURSOR_OUTLINE = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8)
local cursorFill = {}
do
	local H, WMAX, NECK = 15, 10, 9
	local function rowW(y)
		if y <= NECK then return y + 1 end
		return math.max(1, math.ceil(WMAX * (H - y) / (H - NECK)))
	end
	for y = 0, H - 1 do
		create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = CURSOR_OUTLINE,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-1, y - 1),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rowW(y) + 2, 3),
			ZIndex = 101,
		}, CursorRoot)
	end
	for y = 0, H - 1 do
		cursorFill[#cursorFill + 1] = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rowW(y), 1),
			ZIndex = 102,
		}, CursorRoot)
	end
	onAccent(function(cl)
		for _, f in ipairs(cursorFill) do f.BackgroundColor3 = cl end
	end)
end

local CURSOR_BIND = "AXLib_Cursor"
local cursorBound = false

local function startCursorTracking()
	if cursorBound then return end
	if IS_MOBILE then return end
	local p0 = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
	CursorRoot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p0.X, p0.Y)
	CursorRoot.Visible = true
	pcall(function()
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(CURSOR_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
			local pos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
            CursorGui.DisplayOrder=2147483647
			CursorRoot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
			pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = false end)
		end)
	end)
	cursorBound = true
end

local function stopCursorTracking()
	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CURSOR_BIND) end)
	cursorBound = false
	CursorRoot.Visible = false
end

function setMouseUnlocked(unlocked)
	if unlocked then
		if _modalBtn then _modalBtn.Modal = true end
		pcall(function() UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)
		if SETTINGS.CustomCursor ~= false then
			pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = false end)
			if not IS_MOBILE then startCursorTracking() end
		else
			stopCursorTracking()
			pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true end)
		end
	else
		if _modalBtn then _modalBtn.Modal = false end
		stopCursorTracking()
		pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true end)
		pcall(function() UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)
	end
end

end

local brand, BrandRoot, brandLayout, LOGO3D, brandShow, brandHide
do

local TextServ = game:GetService("TextService")

local BRAND_FONT  = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
local BRAND_DEPTH = 14
local GLOW_THICK  = { 3, 8 }
local GLOW_BASE   = { 0.8, 0.92 }
local SWEEP_EVERY = 5.5
local FADE_IN     = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local FADE_OUT    = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
local LAYER_IN    = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local SWEEP_TI    = TweenInfo.new(1.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)

brand = {
	enabled = true,
	shown = false,
	size = 96,
	halfW = 150,
	totalW = 300,
	glyphs = {},
	fades = {},
	layers = {},
	glows = {},
	loops = {},
	conn = nil,
	token = 0,
}

BrandRoot = create("Frame", {
	Name = "_brand",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
	Visible = false,
	Active = false,
	ZIndex = 1,
}, BackdropGui)

local function brandGlyph(ch, nine)
	local g = { ch = ch, nine = nine, layers = {}, all = {}, x = 0 }
	g.holder = create("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 1 }, BrandRoot)

	local function lbl(z, col)
		local l = create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Font = BRAND_FONT,
			Text = ch,
			TextColor3 = col,
			TextTransparency = 1,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
			ZIndex = z,
		}, g.holder)
		g.all[#g.all + 1] = l
		return l
	end

	if nine then
		local cols = { Color3.fromRGB(112, 110, 255), Color3.fromRGB(140, 92, 255) }
		for k = 2, 1, -1 do

			local gl = lbl(3 - k, Color3.fromRGB(18, 12, 46))
			brand.fades[#brand.fades + 1] = { gl, "TextTransparency", 0 }
			local st = create("UIStroke", {
				Color = cols[k],
				Thickness = GLOW_THICK[k],
				Transparency = 1,
				LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
				ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual,
			}, gl)
			g["glowLbl" .. k] = gl
			brand.glows[#brand.glows + 1] = { st, GLOW_BASE[k], k }
		end
	end

	local nearA, backA = Color3.fromRGB(96, 100, 116), Color3.fromRGB(16, 17, 22)
	local nearN, backN = Color3.fromRGB(78, 58, 190), Color3.fromRGB(12, 9, 34)
	for i = BRAND_DEPTH, 1, -1 do
		local k = (i - 1) / (BRAND_DEPTH - 1)
		k = k ^ 0.8
		local l = lbl(10 + (BRAND_DEPTH - i), nine and nearN:Lerp(backN, k) or nearA:Lerp(backA, k))
		g.layers[i] = l
		brand.layers[#brand.layers + 1] = { l, i }
	end

	local rim = lbl(11 + BRAND_DEPTH, nine and Color3.fromRGB(196, 206, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	g.rim = rim
	brand.fades[#brand.fades + 1] = { rim, "TextTransparency", 0.25 }

	local face = lbl(12 + BRAND_DEPTH, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	g.face = face
	brand.fades[#brand.fades + 1] = { face, "TextTransparency", 0 }
	if nine then
		g.grad = create("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 40,
			Offset = Vector2.new(-0.18, 0),
			Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(64, 156, 255)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(100, 118, 255)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(170, 84, 255)),
			}),
		}, face)
	else
		create("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(252, 252, 254)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, Color3.fromRGB(236, 237, 242)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(196, 199, 212)),
			}),
		}, face)
	end

	local shine = lbl(13 + BRAND_DEPTH, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	g.shine = create("UIGradient", {
		Rotation = 22,
		Offset = Vector2.new(-1.2, 0),
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.45),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		}),
	}, shine)
	brand.fades[#brand.fades + 1] = { shine, "TextTransparency", 0 }

	brand.glyphs[#brand.glyphs + 1] = g
	return g
end

brandGlyph("g", false)
brandGlyph("3", true)

local function brandComputeSize()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
	if IS_MOBILE then
		return math.clamp(math.floor(vp.Y * 0.12), 40, 80)
	end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(vp.Y * 0.105), 56, 100)
end

function brandLayout(size)
	size = size or brandComputeSize()
	brand.size = size
	local depth = BRAND_DEPTH
	local gap = math.max(2, math.floor(size * 0.07))
	local x, maxH = 0, 0
	for gi, g in ipairs(brand.glyphs) do
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			return TextServ:GetTextSize(g.ch, size, BRAND_FONT, Vector2.new(4096, 4096))
		end)
		local w = (ok and v and v.X > 0) and math.floor(v.X + 0.5) or math.floor(size * 0.72)
		local h = (ok and v and v.Y > 0) and math.floor(v.Y + 0.5) or size
		g.x = x
		g.holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 0)
		g.holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w + depth, h + depth)
		for _, l in ipairs(g.all) do
			l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
			l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
			l.TextSize = size
		end
		for i, l in ipairs(g.layers) do
			l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(i, i)
		end
		if g.rim then g.rim.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-1, -1) end
		local mid = math.floor(depth / 2)
		for k = 1, 2 do
			local gl = g["glowLbl" .. k]
			if gl then gl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mid, mid) end
		end
		x = x + w + (gi < #brand.glyphs and gap or 0)
		maxH = math.max(maxH, h)
	end
	local k = size / 96
	for _, e in ipairs(brand.glows) do
		e[1].Thickness = math.max(1, math.floor(GLOW_THICK[e[3]] * k + 0.5))
	end
	brand.totalW = x
	BrandRoot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x + depth, maxH + depth)
	brand.halfW = math.floor((x + depth) / 2)
end
brandLayout()

local function brandLoop(obj, info, goal)
	local ok, t = pcall(function() return TweenServ:Create(obj, info, goal) end)
	if ok and t then brand.loops[#brand.loops + 1] = t; t:Play() end
end

local function brandStopLoops()
	for _, t in ipairs(brand.loops) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
	table.clear(brand.loops)
end

local function brandSweep(my)
	local total = math.max(1, brand.totalW)
	for _, g in ipairs(brand.glyphs) do
		g.shine.Offset = Vector2.new(-1.2, 0)
		task.delay((g.x / total) * 0.42, function()
			if brand.token ~= my then return end
			tw(g.shine, SWEEP_TI, { Offset = Vector2.new(1.2, 0) })
		end)
	end
end

local function brandSweepLoop(my)
	if brand.token ~= my or not brand.shown then return end
	if brand.spinning then task.delay(SWEEP_EVERY, function() brandSweepLoop(my) end) return end
	brandSweep(my)
	task.delay(SWEEP_EVERY, function() brandSweepLoop(my) end)
end

brand.spinT = {}
brand.spinning = false
local SPIN_TI = TweenInfo.new(1.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
local SPIN_LIGHT = TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, -1, true)
local function spinPlay(obj, goal, info)
	local ok, t = pcall(function() return TweenServ:Create(obj, info or SPIN_TI, goal) end)
	if ok and t then brand.spinT[#brand.spinT + 1] = t; t:Play() end
end
function brand.spinReset()
	for _, t in ipairs(brand.spinT) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
	table.clear(brand.spinT)
	brand.spinning = false
	local mid = math.floor(BRAND_DEPTH / 2)
	for _, g in ipairs(brand.glyphs) do
		for i, l in ipairs(g.layers) do l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(i, i) end
		if g.rim then g.rim.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-1, -1) end
		for k = 1, 2 do
			local gl = g["glowLbl" .. k]
			if gl then gl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mid, mid) end
		end
		g.face.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		g.shine.Rotation = 22
		g.shine.Offset = Vector2.new(-1.2, 0)
	end
end
function brand.spinStart()
	local mode = SETTINGS.BrandSpin
	if mode ~= "Horizontal" and mode ~= "Vertical" then return end
	if not brand.shown then return end
	brand.spinReset()
	brand.spinning = true
	local hz = mode == "Horizontal"
	local mid = math.floor(BRAND_DEPTH / 2)
	local dim = Color3.fromRGB(196, 198, 210)
	for _, g in ipairs(brand.glyphs) do
		for i, l in ipairs(g.layers) do
			spinPlay(l, { Position = hz and UDim2.fromOffset(-i, i) or UDim2.fromOffset(i, -i) })
		end
		if g.rim then spinPlay(g.rim, { Position = hz and UDim2.fromOffset(1, -1) or UDim2.fromOffset(-1, 1) }) end
		for k = 1, 2 do
			local gl = g["glowLbl" .. k]
			if gl then spinPlay(gl, { Position = hz and UDim2.fromOffset(-mid, mid) or UDim2.fromOffset(mid, -mid) }) end
		end

		g.shine.Rotation = hz and 0 or 90
		g.shine.Offset = hz and Vector2.new(-0.75, 0) or Vector2.new(0, -0.75)
		spinPlay(g.shine, { Offset = hz and Vector2.new(0.75, 0) or Vector2.new(0, 0.75) })

		g.face.TextColor3 = dim
		spinPlay(g.face, { TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }, SPIN_LIGHT)
	end
end
function brand.setSpin(mode)
	if mode ~= "Horizontal" and mode ~= "Vertical" then mode = "Off" end
	SETTINGS.BrandSpin = mode
	brand.spinReset()
	if mode ~= "Off" and brand.shown then brand.spinStart() end
end

brand.edge = { frames = {}, shown = false, loop = nil }
do
	local sides = {
		{ UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), 90 },
		{ UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), -90 },
		{ UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), 0 },
		{ UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), 180 },
	}
	for i, sd in ipairs(sides) do
		local f = create("Frame", {
			Name = "_edgeGlow",
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(i == 4 and 1 or 0, i == 2 and 1 or 0),
			Position = sd[1],
			Size = sd[2],
			Visible = false,
			Active = false,
			ZIndex = 2,
		}, BackdropGui)
		local g = create("UIGradient", { Rotation = sd[3] }, f)
		brand.edge.frames[i] = { f = f, g = g, side = i }
	end
end
function brand.edgePaint()
	local e = brand.edge
	local k = math.clamp((tonumber(SETTINGS.GlowEdgeSize) or 50) / 100, 0, 1)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	local th = math.floor(math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * (0.05 + 0.13 * k))
	local a = 0.78 - 0.5 * k
	local seq = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, a + (1 - a) * 0.6),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	local col = GLOW.color("edge") or T.Accent
	for _, fr in ipairs(e.frames) do
		local horiz = fr.side <= 2
		fr.f.Size = horiz and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, th) or UDim2.new(0, th, 1, 0)
		fr.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
		fr.g.Transparency = seq
	end
end
function brand.edgeShow(on)
	local e = brand.edge
	on = on and GLOW.on("edge")
	if e.loop then pcall(function() e.loop:Cancel() end) e.loop = nil end
	for _, t in ipairs(e.loops or {}) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
	e.loops = {}
	e.shown = on
	if on then
		brand.edgePaint()
		for _, fr in ipairs(e.frames) do
			fr.f.Visible = true
			fr.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			local t1 = TweenServ:Create(fr.f, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
			t1:Play()

			local t2 = TweenServ:Create(fr.f, TweenInfo.new(2.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true, 0.35), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 })
			t2:Play()
			e.loops[#e.loops + 1] = t1
			e.loops[#e.loops + 1] = t2
		end
	else
		for _, fr in ipairs(e.frames) do
			if fr.f.Visible then
				local t = TweenServ:Create(fr.f, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
				t:Play()
				e.loops[#e.loops + 1] = t
			end
		end
		task.delay(0.22, function()
			if e.shown then return end
			for _, fr in ipairs(e.frames) do fr.f.Visible = false end
		end)
	end
end

GLOW.onChange(function(k)
	if k == nil then
		if brand.edge.shown then brand.edgePaint() end
		return
	end
	if k ~= "edge" then return end
	local open = false
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w._open then open = true break end
	end
	if open and GLOW.on("edge") then
		if brand.edge.shown then brand.edgePaint() else brand.edgeShow(true) end
	elseif brand.edge.shown then
		brand.edgeShow(false)
	end
end)

LOGO3D = { minis = {}, angle = 0, shown = false }
LOGO3D.MATS = { "SmoothPlastic", "Neon", "Glass", "ForceField", "Metal", "Plastic" }
function LOGO3D.ok()
	return type(CFrame) == "table" or typeof(CFrame) == "table" or (CFrame ~= nil and CFrame.new ~= nil)
end

LOGO3D.SHAPE = {

	{ 0.66, 3.30, 0.86, -2.28, 0, 0, 0, "u" },
	{ 0.66, 3.30, 0.86, -1.08, 0, 0, 0, "u" },
	{ 1.86, 0.66, 0.86, -1.68, -1.48, 0, 0, "u" },

	{ 0.66, 3.62, 0.86, 0.28, 0, 0, 0, "c" },
	{ 2.12, 0.66, 0.86, 1.34, 1.48, 0, 0, "c" },
	{ 2.12, 0.66, 0.86, 1.34, -1.48, 0, 0, "c" },
}
LOGO3D.COLORS = {
	u = Color3.fromRGB(238, 240, 245),
	c = Color3.fromRGB(180, 194, 255),
}
function LOGO3D.mat()
	local m = tostring(SETTINGS.Logo3DMat or "SmoothPlastic")
	local ok, e = pcall(function() return Enum.Material[m] end)
	return ok and e or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
end
function LOGO3D.build(parent)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "UC3DLogo"
	local list = {}
	local tr = math.clamp((tonumber(SETTINGS.Logo3DTr) or 0) / 100, 0, 0.95)
	for i, d in ipairs(LOGO3D.SHAPE) do
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = "UCPart_" .. tostring(i)
		pcall(function()
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = false
			p.CanQuery = false
			p.CanTouch = false
			p.CastShadow = false
			p.Locked = true
			p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.Size = Vector3.new(d[1], d[2], d[3])
			p.Color = LOGO3D.COLORS[d[8]]
			p.Material = LOGO3D.mat()
			p.Transparency = tr
		end)
		p.Parent = model
		list[#list + 1] = { p, CFrame.new(d[4], d[5], d[6]) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(d[7])) }
	end
	model.Parent = parent
	return { model = model, parts = list }
end
function LOGO3D.place(m, base)
	local rot = base * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(LOGO3D.angle), 0)
	for _, e in ipairs(m.parts) do e[1].CFrame = rot * e[2] end
end
function LOGO3D.restyle(m)
	if not m then return end
	local mat = LOGO3D.mat()
	local tr = math.clamp((tonumber(SETTINGS.Logo3DTr) or 0) / 100, 0, 0.95)
	for _, e in ipairs(m.parts) do
		pcall(function() e[1].Material = mat; e[1].Transparency = tr end)
	end
end
function LOGO3D.viewport(parent, size, z)
	local vf = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	vf.Name = "_uc3d"
	vf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vf.BorderSizePixel = 0
	vf.Size = size
	vf.ZIndex = z or 1
	pcall(function()
		vf.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)
		vf.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		vf.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.55, -1, -0.75)
	end)
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	pcall(function()
		cam.FieldOfView = 38
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 28)
	end)
	cam.Parent = vf
	vf.CurrentCamera = cam
	vf.Parent = parent
	return vf
end
LOGO3D.ORIGIN = nil
function LOGO3D.step(dt)
	local L = LOGO3D
	local speed = math.max(0, tonumber(SETTINGS.Logo3DSpeed) or 0)
	L.angle = (L.angle + speed * dt) % 360
	if not L.ORIGIN then L.ORIGIN = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) end
	if L.shown and L.main then L.place(L.main, L.ORIGIN) end
	for i = #L.minis, 1, -1 do
		local m = L.minis[i]
		if m.vf.Parent then
			if m.vf.Visible then L.place(m, L.ORIGIN) end
		else
			table.remove(L.minis, i)
		end
	end
end
function LOGO3D.needsStep()
	local L = LOGO3D
	return (L.shown and (tonumber(SETTINGS.Logo3DSpeed) or 0) > 0) or #L.minis > 0
end
function LOGO3D.run(on)
	local L = LOGO3D
	on = on and L.needsStep()
	if on and not L.conn then
		L.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt) pcall(L.step, dt) end)
		pcall(L.step, 0)
	elseif not on and L.conn then
		L.conn:Disconnect()
		L.conn = nil
	end
end
function LOGO3D.show()
	local L = LOGO3D
	if not L.ok() then return false end
	if not L.main then
		L.worldMode = false
		L.vf = L.viewport(BackdropGui, UDim2.fromOffset(180, 104), 1)
		L.vf.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		L.vf.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		L.main = L.build(L.vf)
	end
	L.vf.Visible = true
	L.restyle(L.main)
	L.shown = true
	L.ORIGIN = L.ORIGIN or CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	L.place(L.main, L.ORIGIN)
	L.run(true)
	return true
end
function LOGO3D.hide(destroy)
	local L = LOGO3D
	L.shown = false
	if L.vf then L.vf.Visible = false end
	if L.main and (destroy or L.worldMode) then
		pcall(function() L.main.model:Destroy() end)
		L.main = nil
		if L.vf then pcall(function() L.vf:Destroy() end); L.vf = nil end
	end
end

function LOGO3D.sync(open)
	local L = LOGO3D
	if open and brand.enabled and SETTINGS.Brand3D ~= false and SETTINGS.Logo3D ~= false then L.show() else L.hide(true) end
	L.run(L.ok() and L.needsStep())
end

function LOGO3D.mini(parent)
	local L = LOGO3D
	if not L.ok() then return false end
	local vf = L.viewport(parent, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), (parent.ZIndex or 1) + 1)
	pcall(function() vf.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 18) end)
	local m = L.build(vf)
	m.vf = vf
	L.minis[#L.minis + 1] = m
	L.place(m, CFrame.new(0, 0, 0))
	return true
end
function LOGO3D.refresh()
	local L = LOGO3D
	if L.main then L.restyle(L.main) end
	for _, m in ipairs(L.minis) do L.restyle(m) end
	if L.shown then L.show() end
end

local function brandHost()
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w.Gui and w.Gui.Parent and w._open then
			return w.Gui
		end
	end
	return BackdropGui
end

function brandShow()

	LOGO3D.sync(true)
end

function brandHide()
	LOGO3D.sync(false)
	if not brand.shown then return end
	brand.shown = false
	brand.token = brand.token + 1
	local my = brand.token
	brandStopLoops()
	brand.spinReset()
	for _, f in ipairs(brand.fades) do tw(f[1], FADE_OUT, { [f[2]] = 1 }) end
	for _, e in ipairs(brand.layers) do tw(e[1], FADE_OUT, { TextTransparency = 1 }) end
	for _, e in ipairs(brand.glows) do tw(e[1], FADE_OUT, { Transparency = 1 }) end
	task.delay(0.22, function()
		if brand.shown or brand.token ~= my then return end
		BrandRoot.Visible = false
	end)
end

end

local NotifGui, PopupGui, NOTIF, NOTIF_POS, notifPos, placeNotifHolder, onNotifMoved, notif
do

NotifGui = makeGui(nextCamoName(), 2147483646, true)
PopupGui = makeGui(nextCamoName(), 2147483646, true)
NOTIF = { style = "Default" }
NOTIF_POS = { LeftUp = true, LeftDown = true, Center = true, RightUp = true, RightDown = true, Custom = true }

local NotifHolder = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Notifications",
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 0),
	AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	ZIndex = 50,
}, NotifGui)
local notifList = create("UIListLayout", {
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
}, NotifHolder)

local function notifXY()
	local t = SETTINGS.NotifXY
	if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local ax, ay, x, y = tonumber(t[1]), tonumber(t[2]), tonumber(t[3]), tonumber(t[4])
	if not (ax and ay and x and y) then return nil end
	return ax, ay, math.clamp(x, 0, 1), math.clamp(y, 0, 1)
end
function notifPos()
	local p = SETTINGS.NotifPos
	if p == "Custom" and not notifXY() then return "RightDown" end
	return NOTIF_POS[p] and p or "RightDown"
end

function placeNotifHolder()
	local p = notifPos()
	local topY = (SETTINGS.Watermark and 44 or 16)
	if p == "Custom" then
		local ax, ay, x, y = notifXY()
		NotifHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
		NotifHolder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
		notifList.VerticalAlignment = ay >= 0.5 and Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
		notifList.HorizontalAlignment = ax >= 0.5 and Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
		return
	elseif p == "LeftUp" then
		NotifHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		NotifHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, topY)
	elseif p == "LeftDown" then
		NotifHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		NotifHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -16)
	elseif p == "RightUp" then
		NotifHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		NotifHolder.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
	elseif p == "Center" then
		NotifHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		NotifHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 70)
	else
		NotifHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
		NotifHolder.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
	end
	notifList.VerticalAlignment = (p == "LeftDown" or p == "RightDown") and Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
	notifList.HorizontalAlignment = (p == "LeftUp" or p == "LeftDown") and Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
		or (p == "Center" and Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right)
end
placeNotifHolder()

local nIdx = 0
local NOTIF_GLOW = "rbxassetid://18245826428"

local function notifFrom(W, H)
	local p = notifPos()
	if p == "Center" then return UDim2.fromOffset(0, -H - 4) end
	if p == "Custom" then
		local ax = notifXY()
		return UDim2.fromOffset(ax >= 0.5 and (W + 24) or -(W + 24), 0)
	end
	if p == "LeftUp" or p == "LeftDown" then return UDim2.fromOffset(-(W + 24), 0) end
	return UDim2.fromOffset(W + 24, 0)
end

local function notifLabel(props, parent)
	props.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	props.TextXAlignment = props.TextXAlignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	props.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	props.ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 53
	return create("TextLabel", props, parent)
end

local notifDrag = nil
onNotifMoved = nil
local function notifDragBind(card)
	card.Active = true
	DRAG.register(card)
	card.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if SETTINGS.NotifDrag == false then return end
		local t = inp.UserInputType
		if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		local p0 = Vector2.new(inp.Position.X, inp.Position.Y)
		DRAG.claim(inp, card, function()
			if not DRAG.free() then return end
			DRAG.take(inp)
			notifDrag = { start = p0, abs = NotifHolder.AbsolutePosition, moved = false, inp = inp }
		end)
	end)
end
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
	local d = notifDrag
	if not d then return end
	local t = inp.UserInputType
	if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
	local delta = Vector2.new(inp.Position.X, inp.Position.Y) - d.start
	if not d.moved then
		if delta.Magnitude < 5 then return end
		d.moved = true
	end
	NotifHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	NotifHolder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(d.abs.X + delta.X, d.abs.Y + delta.Y)
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
	local d = notifDrag
	if not d then return end
	local t = inp.UserInputType
	if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
	notifDrag = nil
	DRAG.release(d.inp)
	if not d.moved then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	local ap, as = NotifHolder.AbsolutePosition, NotifHolder.AbsoluteSize
	local cx, cy = ap.X + as.X / 2, ap.Y + as.Y / 2
	local ax = cx > vp.X / 2 and 1 or 0
	local ay = cy > vp.Y / 2 and 1 or 0
	local px = math.clamp(ap.X + ax * as.X, 0, vp.X)
	local py = math.clamp(ap.Y + ay * as.Y, 0, vp.Y)
	SETTINGS.NotifXY = { ax, ay, px / math.max(1, vp.X), py / math.max(1, vp.Y) }
	SETTINGS.NotifPos = "Custom"
	placeNotifHolder()
	if onNotifMoved then pcall(onNotifMoved) end
end)

function notif(text, dur, col, kind)
	if not showNotifs then return end
	if not SETTINGS.Notifications then return end
	dur = dur or 3
	col = col or T.Accent
	nIdx = nIdx + 1
	text = tostring(text)
	local titleEnd = text:find(":")
	local title = titleEnd and text:sub(1, titleEnd - 1) or text
	local body = titleEnd and text:sub(titleEnd + 1):gsub("^%s+", "") or ""
	local style = NOTIF.style
	local W, H
	W, H = 290, body ~= "" and 54 or 38

	local wrap = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W + 2, H + 2),
		LayoutOrder = nIdx,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	}, NotifHolder)
	local from = notifFrom(W, H)
	local card = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = T.Background,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = from,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H),
		ZIndex = 52,
	}, wrap)
	local pb, pbFull, pbGoal
	notifDragBind(card)


	local TI_IN = TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local TI_OUT = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
	tw(card, TI_IN, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1) })
	if pb then tw(pb, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = pbGoal }) end

	task.delay(dur, function()
		if not (card and card.Parent) then return end
		tw(card, TI_OUT, { Position = notifFrom(W, H) })
		task.wait(0.22)
		if not (wrap and wrap.Parent) then return end
		tw(wrap, TI_FAST, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W + 2, 0) })
		task.wait(0.12)
		if wrap.Parent then wrap:Destroy() end
	end)
end

	notif(text, dur or 5, T.Accent, "info")
end

local colonSafe, libHandle, FOVGui, FOV
do

function colonSafe(owner, fn)
	return function(a, ...)
		if a == owner then
			return fn(...)
		end
		return fn(a, ...)
	end
end

function libHandle(el)
	if not el then return nil end
	local function setter(a, v)
		if el.set then
			if v == nil then return el.set(a) end
			return el.set(v)
		end
	end
	return {
        SetValues = function(a,b) if el.refresh then return el.refresh(b or a) end end,
		SetValue = setter,
		GetValue = function() if el.get then return el.get() end end,
		Set = setter,
		Get = function() if el.get then return el.get() end end,
		silent = el.silent,
		SetText = setter,
		Instance = el.row,
		SetVisible = function(a, v)
			if v == nil and type(a) ~= "table" then v = a end
			if el.row then el.row.Visible = (v ~= false) end
		end,
	}
end

FOVGui = makeGui(nextCamoName(), 2147483645, true)
local fovCircles = {}
local fovLoopConn = nil
local fovTime = 0
FOV = {}

local FOV_MODES = { ["center of screen"] = "Center of Screen", screen = "Center of Screen", center = "Center of Screen",
	mouse = "Mouse", cursor = "Mouse", ["on target"] = "On Target", target = "On Target",
	["on gun muzzle"] = "On Gun Muzzle", muzzle = "On Gun Muzzle", custom = "Custom" }
FOV.Modes = { "Center of Screen", "Mouse", "On Target", "On Gun Muzzle", "Custom" }

local function fovV2(v)
	if type(v) == "function" then
		local ok, r = pcall(v)
		v = ok and r or nil
	end
	local t = typeof(v)
	if t == "Vector2" then return v end
	if t == "Vector3" then return Vector2.new(v.X, v.Y) end
	if t == "UDim2" then return Vector2.new(v.X.Offset, v.Y.Offset) end
	return nil
end

local function fovSeq(a, b)
	if b and b ~= a then return ColorSequence.new(a, b) end
	return ColorSequence.new(a)
end

FOV.Create = function(opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local fillOp = opts.FillOpacity
	if fillOp == nil and opts.FillTransparency ~= nil then fillOp = 1 - opts.FillTransparency end
	local outOp = opts.Opacity
	if outOp == nil and opts.Transparency ~= nil then outOp = 1 - opts.Transparency end
	local c = {
		radius = opts.Radius or 100,
		visible = opts.Visible ~= false,
		color = opts.Color or T.Accent,
		color2 = opts.Color2 or opts.Color or T.Accent,
		gradient = opts.Gradient or false,
		thickness = math.clamp(opts.Thickness or 1.5, 0, 25),
		opacity = math.clamp(outOp or 1, 0, 1),
		fill = (opts.Fill ~= nil and opts.Fill) or opts.Filled or false,
		fillColor = opts.FillColor or opts.Color or T.Accent,
		fillColor2 = opts.FillColor2 or opts.FillColor or opts.Color or T.Accent,
		fillGradient = opts.FillGradient or false,
		fillOpacity = math.clamp(fillOp or 0.15, 0, 1),
		animated = opts.Animated or opts.AnimateGradient or opts.Rotate or false,
		animSpeed = opts.AnimationSpeed or 90,
		mode = FOV_MODES[string.lower(tostring(opts.PositionMode or opts.Center or "Mouse"))] or "Mouse",
		lerp = opts.Lerp or false,
		lerpSpeed = math.clamp(opts.LerpSpeed or 12, 1, 60),
		target = opts.Target,
		muzzle = opts.Muzzle,
		position = opts.Position or Vector2.new(0, 0),
		hideNoTarget = opts.HideWithoutTarget or false,
		rainbow = opts.Rainbow or false,
		rainbowSpeed = opts.RainbowSpeed or 0.5,
		contrast = opts.Contrast or false,
		zIndex = opts.ZIndex or 2,
		key = opts.Key,
		cur = nil,
		cache = {},
	}

	local back = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-9999, -9999), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
		ZIndex = c.zIndex, Visible = false, Active = false,
	}, FOVGui)
	fullRound(back)
	local backStroke = create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Transparency = 0.45, Thickness = 3, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, back)

	local ring = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-9999, -9999),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), ZIndex = c.zIndex + 1, Visible = c.visible, Active = false,
	}, FOVGui)
	fullRound(ring)
	local st = create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = c.thickness, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, ring)
	local sg = create("UIGradient", { Color = fovSeq(c.color) }, st)
	local fg = create("UIGradient", { Color = fovSeq(c.fillColor), Enabled = false }, ring)

	c.ring, c.back, c.stroke, c.backStroke, c.sg, c.fg = ring, back, st, backStroke, sg, fg
	local cache = c.cache
	local function put(obj, prop, v, tag)
		local k = tag or prop
		if cache[k] ~= v then cache[k] = v; obj[prop] = v end
	end

	local function apply(dt)
		local t = fovTime

		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
		local want, hide = nil, false
		local m = c.mode
		if m == "Mouse" then
			want = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
		elseif m == "On Target" then
			want = fovV2(c.target)
			if not want and c.hideNoTarget then hide = true end
		elseif m == "On Gun Muzzle" then
			want = fovV2(c.muzzle)
		elseif m == "Custom" then
			want = fovV2(c.position)
		end
		want = want or (vp / 2)
		if c.lerp and c.cur and dt and dt > 0 then
			c.cur = c.cur:Lerp(want, 1 - math.exp(-c.lerpSpeed * dt))
		else
			c.cur = want
		end
		local show = c.visible and not hide
		put(ring, "Visible", show, "rv")
		put(back, "Visible", show and c.contrast and c.thickness > 0, "bv")
		if not show then return end
		local px, py = math.floor(c.cur.X + 0.5), math.floor(c.cur.Y + 0.5)
		local d = math.max(4, math.floor(c.radius * 2 + 0.5))
		local pos, size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py), UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
		put(ring, "Position", pos, "rp"); put(ring, "Size", size, "rs")
		if c.contrast then
			put(back, "Position", pos, "bp"); put(back, "Size", size, "bs")
			put(backStroke, "Thickness", c.thickness + 2, "bt")
			put(backStroke, "Transparency", 1 - c.opacity * 0.55, "btr")
		end

		put(st, "Enabled", c.thickness > 0, "se")
		put(st, "Thickness", c.thickness, "st")
		put(st, "Transparency", 1 - c.opacity, "str")
		local c1 = c.color
		if c.rainbow then c1 = Color3.fromHSV((t * math.max(0.02, c.rainbowSpeed)) % 1, 0.75, 1) end
		local c2 = c.gradient and (c.rainbow and Color3.fromHSV((t * math.max(0.02, c.rainbowSpeed) + 0.35) % 1, 0.75, 1) or c.color2) or c1
		local key = tostring(c1) .. "|" .. tostring(c2)
		if cache.sk ~= key then cache.sk = key; sg.Color = fovSeq(c1, c2) end

		put(ring, "BackgroundTransparency", c.fill and (1 - c.fillOpacity) or 1, "bt2")
		local fgOn = c.fill and c.fillGradient
		put(ring, "BackgroundColor3", fgOn and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or c.fillColor, "bc")
		put(fg, "Enabled", fgOn, "fe")
		if fgOn then
			local fk = tostring(c.fillColor) .. "|" .. tostring(c.fillColor2)
			if cache.fk ~= fk then cache.fk = fk; fg.Color = fovSeq(c.fillColor, c.fillColor2) end
		end

		local rot = c.animated and ((t * c.animSpeed) % 360) or 0
		put(sg, "Rotation", rot, "sr")
		put(fg, "Rotation", rot, "fr")
	end
	c.apply = apply

	local circle = {}
	local function cself(fn)
		return function(a, b)
			if a == circle then return fn(b) end
			return fn(a)
		end
	end

	local SET = {
		radius = function(v) c.radius = math.max(1, tonumber(v) or c.radius) end,
		visible = function(v) c.visible = v and true or false end,
		color = function(v) c.color = v or c.color end,
		color2 = function(v) c.color2 = v or c.color2 end,
		gradient = function(v) c.gradient = v and true or false end,
		thickness = function(v) c.thickness = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 1.5, 0, 25) end,
		opacity = function(v) c.opacity = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 1, 0, 1) end,
		transparency = function(v) c.opacity = 1 - math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0, 0, 1) end,
		fill = function(v) c.fill = v and true or false end,
		filled = function(v) c.fill = v and true or false end,
		fillcolor = function(v) c.fillColor = v or c.fillColor end,
		fillcolor2 = function(v) c.fillColor2 = v or c.fillColor2 end,
		fillgradient = function(v) c.fillGradient = v and true or false end,
		fillopacity = function(v) c.fillOpacity = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0.15, 0, 1) end,
		filltransparency = function(v) c.fillOpacity = 1 - math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0.85, 0, 1) end,
		animated = function(v) c.animated = v and true or false end,
		animategradient = function(v) c.animated = v and true or false end,
		rotate = function(v) c.animated = v and true or false end,
		animationspeed = function(v) c.animSpeed = tonumber(v) or 90 end,
		positionmode = function(v) c.mode = FOV_MODES[string.lower(tostring(v))] or c.mode end,
		center = function(v) c.mode = FOV_MODES[string.lower(tostring(v))] or c.mode end,
		lerp = function(v) c.lerp = v and true or false end,
		lerpspeed = function(v) c.lerpSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 12, 1, 60) end,
		target = function(v) c.target = v end,
		muzzle = function(v) c.muzzle = v end,
		position = function(v) c.position = v end,
		hidewithouttarget = function(v) c.hideNoTarget = v and true or false end,
		rainbow = function(v) c.rainbow = v and true or false end,
		rainbowspeed = function(v) c.rainbowSpeed = tonumber(v) or 0.5 end,
		contrast = function(v) c.contrast = v and true or false end,
		zindex = function(v) c.zIndex = v; ring.ZIndex = v + 1; back.ZIndex = v end,
	}

	circle.Update = cself(function(props)
		for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do
			local f = SET[string.lower(tostring(k))]
			if f then f(v) end
		end
		pcall(apply, 0)
		return circle
	end)
	local function setter(key)
		return cself(function(v) return circle.Update({ [key] = v }) end)
	end
	for _, k in ipairs({ "Radius", "Visible", "Color", "Color2", "Gradient", "Thickness", "Opacity",
		"Transparency", "Fill", "FillColor", "FillColor2", "FillGradient", "FillOpacity",
		"FillTransparency", "Animated", "AnimationSpeed", "PositionMode", "Center", "Lerp",
		"LerpSpeed", "Target", "Muzzle", "Position", "HideWithoutTarget", "Rainbow",
		"RainbowSpeed", "Contrast", "ZIndex" }) do
		circle["Set" .. k] = setter(k)
	end
	circle.SetFilled = circle.SetFill
	circle.SetRotate = circle.SetAnimated

	local noop = function() return circle end
	for _, k in ipairs({ "Radius2", "Double", "Glow", "GlowTransparency", "Style", "Sides", "Animation" }) do
		circle["Set" .. k] = noop
	end

	circle.Get = function()
		return {
			Radius = c.radius, Visible = c.visible, Color = c.color, Color2 = c.color2,
			Gradient = c.gradient, Thickness = c.thickness, Opacity = c.opacity,
			Transparency = 1 - c.opacity, Fill = c.fill, Filled = c.fill, FillColor = c.fillColor,
			FillColor2 = c.fillColor2, FillGradient = c.fillGradient, FillOpacity = c.fillOpacity,
			FillTransparency = 1 - c.fillOpacity, Animated = c.animated, AnimationSpeed = c.animSpeed,
			PositionMode = c.mode, Center = c.mode, Lerp = c.lerp, LerpSpeed = c.lerpSpeed,
			Position = c.position, Rainbow = c.rainbow, RainbowSpeed = c.rainbowSpeed,
			Contrast = c.contrast, HideWithoutTarget = c.hideNoTarget, Key = c.key,
		}
	end

	circle.GetCenter = function()
		if not c.cur then pcall(apply, 0) end
		return c.cur or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
	circle.GetPosition = circle.GetCenter
	circle.GetRadius = function() return c.radius end
	circle.Contains = cself(function(p)
		p = fovV2(p)
		if not p then return false end
		local ctr = circle.GetCenter()
		return (p - ctr).Magnitude <= c.radius
	end)

	circle.Gui = FOVGui
	circle.Container = ring
	circle.Frame = ring
	circle.Stroke = st

	circle.Remove = function()
		pcall(function() ring:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() back:Destroy() end)
		for i = #fovCircles, 1, -1 do
			if fovCircles[i] == c then table.remove(fovCircles, i) end
		end
	end
	circle.Destroy = circle.Remove
	circle.SetValue = circle.Update
	circle.GetValue = circle.Get

	fovCircles[#fovCircles + 1] = c
	pcall(apply, 0)

	if not fovLoopConn then
		fovLoopConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			fovTime = fovTime + dt
			for i = #fovCircles, 1, -1 do
				local cc = fovCircles[i]
				if not (cc.ring and cc.ring.Parent) then
					table.remove(fovCircles, i)
				elseif cc.visible or cc.cache.rv then
					pcall(cc.apply, dt)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	return circle
end

FOV.DestroyAll = function()
	for i = #fovCircles, 1, -1 do
		local c = fovCircles[i]
		pcall(function() c.ring:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() c.back:Destroy() end)
		fovCircles[i] = nil
	end
	fovCircles = {}
	if fovLoopConn then
		pcall(function() fovLoopConn:Disconnect() end)
		fovLoopConn = nil
	end
end
FOV.Clear = FOV.DestroyAll

end

local hideTip, attachHint
do

local TipFrame = create("Frame", {
	Name = "_tip",
	BackgroundColor3 = T.Element,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
	AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
	Visible = false,
	ZIndex = 500,
}, PopupGui)
corner(RADIUS, TipFrame)
stroke(1, T.Line, TipFrame)
local TipText = create("TextLabel", {
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
	AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
	Font = F_BODY,
	Text = "",
	TextColor3 = T.Font,
	TextSize = TS_SMALL,
	TextWrapped = true,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	ZIndex = 501,
}, TipFrame)
create("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(240, 400) }, TipText)
create("UIPadding", {
	PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 7),
	PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5),
}, TipText)

local function placeTip()
	if not TipFrame.Visible then return end
	local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
	local s = TipFrame.AbsoluteSize
	TipFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
		math.clamp(m.X + 14, 4, math.max(4, vp.X - s.X - 4)),
		math.clamp(m.Y + 16, 4, math.max(4, vp.Y - s.Y - 4))
	)
end
local function showTip(text)
	TipText.Text = tostring(text)
	TipFrame.Visible = true
	placeTip()
	task.defer(placeTip)
end
function hideTip()
	TipFrame.Visible = false
end

function attachHint(row, lbl, text)
	if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then return end
	local hint = create("TextButton", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 14),
		Font = F_BODY,
		Text = "(?)",
		TextColor3 = T.FontSub,
		TextSize = 12,
		ZIndex = 20,
	}, row)
	local function place()
		local x = lbl.Position.X.Offset + lbl.TextBounds.X + 6
		local ys, yo
		if lbl.Size.Y.Scale > 0 then
			ys, yo = lbl.Position.Y.Scale + lbl.Size.Y.Scale / 2, lbl.Position.Y.Offset
		else
			ys, yo = lbl.Position.Y.Scale, lbl.Position.Y.Offset + lbl.Size.Y.Offset / 2
		end
		hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, ys, yo)
	end
	lbl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(place)
	place()
	if IS_MOBILE then
		hint.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if TipFrame.Visible then hideTip() else showTip(text); task.delay(2.5, hideTip) end
		end)
	else
		hint.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			tw(hint, TI_FAST, { TextColor3 = T.Accent })
			showTip(text)
		end)
		hint.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			tw(hint, TI_FAST, { TextColor3 = T.FontSub })
			hideTip()
		end)
		hint.MouseMoved:Connect(placeTip)
	end
end

end


local WIN_W_BASE, WIN_H_BASE, SIDEBAR_W, SIDE_MIN, SIDE_MAX, CONTENT_MIN, TOP_H, BOT_H, SEARCH_H, COL_P, GUTTER, SUB_TOP
local SUB_STRIP, SUBTAB_H, PAD, MIN_W, MIN_H, weakK, fontRole, gbReg, gbWideOf, gbIsRail, gbWideFix, skinners
local LAYOUT_NAMES, STYLES, AU, layoutIn, layoutOut, curStyle, FX, fxFor, onFX, runFX, skinKey, applyStyle
local layoutPos, layoutDrag, layoutDirty
do

WIN_W_BASE = 640
WIN_H_BASE = 440
SIDEBAR_W = 124
SIDE_MIN, SIDE_MAX = 92, 240
CONTENT_MIN = 300
TOP_H = 40
BOT_H = 20
SEARCH_H = 26
COL_P = 3
GUTTER = 10
SUB_TOP = 4
SUB_STRIP = 24
SUBTAB_H = SUB_TOP + SUB_STRIP + 4
PAD = 8
MIN_W, MIN_H = 500, 340
local WIN_POS_X = 0.72

weakK = { __mode = "k" }
fontRole = setmetatable({}, weakK)
gbReg = setmetatable({}, weakK)
gbWideOf = setmetatable({}, weakK)
gbIsRail = setmetatable({}, weakK)
gbWideFix = setmetatable({}, weakK)
skinners = {}
LAYOUT_NAMES = { "Obsidian" }

local LAYOUT_IDS = {
	Default = "Default", Obsidian = "Default",
}
local LAYOUT_SHOW = {
	Default = "Obsidian", Obsidian = "Obsidian",
}
local TXT_KEYS = { "Font", "FontDim", "FontSub" }
local PAL_KEYS = { "Background", "Sidebar", "Main", "Container", "Footer", "Card", "Element", "ElementHover", "Track", "Line", "LineHi", "CtlEdge" }

local function fontOr(name, fb)
	local ok, f = pcall(function() return Enum.Font[name] end)
	if ok and f then return f end
	return fb
end

local function pal(bg, main, cont, card, el, hov, line, hi, edge)
	return {
		Background = bg, Sidebar = main, Main = main, Footer = main, Container = cont,
		Card = card, Element = el, Track = el, ElementHover = hov, Line = line, LineHi = hi, CtlEdge = edge,
	}
end
local function g3(v) return Color3.fromRGB(v, v, v) end

STYLES = {
	Default = {
		radius = RADIUS, pal = {}, fonts = {},
		fx = { glow = true, line = true, tabLine = true, headGlow = true, slide = true },
	},
}

function layoutIn(n)
	n = tostring(n or "Default")
	return LAYOUT_IDS[n] or "Default"
end
function layoutOut(n)
	n = tostring(n or "Default")
	return LAYOUT_SHOW[n] or n
end

curStyle = "Default"
FX = {}
for k, v in pairs(STYLES.Default.fx) do FX[k] = v end

function fxFor(name)
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs((STYLES[name] or STYLES.Default).fx) do out[k] = v end
	local o = type(SETTINGS.LayoutFX) == "table" and SETTINGS.LayoutFX[name]
	if type(o) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(o) do if out[k] ~= nil and type(v) == "boolean" then out[k] = v end end
	end
	return out
end

local fxHooks = {}
function onFX(fn) fxHooks[#fxHooks + 1] = fn end
function runFX(y)
	for _, fn in ipairs(fxHooks) do
		pcall(fn, y)
		if y then y() end
	end
end

local function colKey(c)
	return math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536 + math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256 + math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
end

function skinKey(...)
	local n = select("#", ...)
	local t = { ... }
	for i = 1, n do
		local v = t[i]
		t[i] = typeof(v) == "Color3" and tostring(colKey(v)) or tostring(v)
	end
	return table.concat(t, "|", 1, n)
end

local cornerD = setmetatable({}, weakK)
function applyStyle(name, y)
	local st = STYLES[name]
	if not st then return end
	if curStyle == "Default" then
		for _, k in ipairs(PAL_KEYS) do STYLES.Default.pal[k] = T[k] end
		STYLES.Default.text = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(TXT_KEYS) do STYLES.Default.text[k] = T[k] end
		STYLES.Default.fonts = { title = F_TITLE, tab = F_TAB, group = F_GROUP, body = F_BODY, med = F_MED, mono = F_MONO }
		STYLES.Default.radius = RADIUS
	end
	local cmap = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(PAL_KEYS) do
		local n = st.pal[k]
		if n then cmap[colKey(T[k])] = n end
	end

	local tmap = {}
	local ntext = st.text or STYLES.Default.text
	if ntext then
		for _, k in ipairs(TXT_KEYS) do
			local n = ntext[k]
			if n and T[k] then
				tmap[colKey(T[k])] = n

				if k ~= "Font" and not cmap[colKey(T[k])] then cmap[colKey(T[k])] = n end
			end
		end
	end

	for k, v in pairs(cmap) do if colKey(v) == k then cmap[k] = nil end end
	for k, v in pairs(tmap) do if colKey(v) == k then tmap[k] = nil end end
	local slots = { [F_TAB] = true, [F_TITLE] = true, [F_GROUP] = true, [F_BODY] = true, [F_MED] = true, [F_MONO] = true }
	local nf = st.fonts
	local fTab, fTitle, fGroup, fBody = nf.tab or F_TAB, nf.title or F_TITLE, nf.group or F_GROUP, nf.body or F_BODY
	local fMed, fMono = nf.med or fBody, nf.mono or fBody
	local oldR, newR = RADIUS, st.radius

	local function remap(o, prop, map)
		local c = o[prop]
		local n = c and map[colKey(c)]
		if n then o[prop] = n end
	end

	local gsOn = THEME.gsOn
	local gsMap = nil

	local mapChanged = THEME.gsCur ~= gsMap
	THEME.gsCur = gsMap
	THEME.gs = gsMap
	local function visit(d, k)
		if k <= 4 then
			remap(d, "BackgroundColor3", cmap)
			if k == 2 then
				remap(d, "ScrollBarImageColor3", cmap)
			elseif k >= 3 then
				local gsf = gsOn[d]
				local cf = gsf or d.Font
				local r = fontRole[d]
				if r or slots[cf] then
					local f = (r == "tab" and fTab) or (r == "title" and fTitle) or (r == "group" and fGroup) or fBody
					if f ~= cf or (gsf and (not gsMap or mapChanged)) then d.Font = f; gsOn[d] = nil; gsf = nil end
					local face = gsMap and gsMap[f]
					if face and not gsf and pcall(propSetRaw, d, "FontFace", face) then gsOn[d] = f end
				end
				remap(d, "TextColor3", tmap)
				if k == 4 then remap(d, "PlaceholderColor3", cmap) end
			end
		elseif k == 5 then
			remap(d, "Color", cmap)
		elseif k == 6 then
			local cr = d.CornerRadius
			if cr.Scale == 0 then
				local dd = cornerD[d]
				if dd == nil then dd = cr.Offset - oldR; cornerD[d] = dd end
				local o = newR <= 0 and 0 or math.max(0, newR + dd)
				if o ~= cr.Offset then d.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, o) end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, k in ipairs(PAL_KEYS) do if st.pal[k] then T[k] = st.pal[k] end end
	if ntext then for _, k in ipairs(TXT_KEYS) do if ntext[k] then T[k] = ntext[k] end end end
	F_TAB, F_TITLE, F_GROUP, F_BODY, F_MED, F_MONO = fTab, fTitle, fGroup, fBody, fMed, fMono
	RADIUS = newR
	curStyle = name
	NOTIF.style = name
	FX = fxFor(name)

	local skip = {}
	if BrandRoot then
		skip[BrandRoot] = true
		for _, d in ipairs(BrandRoot:GetDescendants()) do skip[d] = true end
	end
	local list, kinds = THEME.prune(THEME.list), THEME.kind
	THEME.list = {}
	for i = 1, #list do
		local d = list[i]
		if not skip[d] then pcall(visit, d, kinds[d] or 0) end
		if y then y() end
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(THEME.list) do list[#list + 1] = d end
	THEME.list = list
	THEME.texts = nil
	local skName = name
	for i = #skinners, 1, -1 do
		local ok, alive = pcall(skinners[i], skName)
		if ok and alive == false then table.remove(skinners, i) end
		if y then y() end
	end
	runFX(y)
end

function layoutPos(key, x, y, w, h)
	local p = type(SETTINGS.LayoutPos) == "table" and SETTINGS.LayoutPos[key]
	if type(p) == "table" and tonumber(p[1]) and tonumber(p[2]) then x, y = tonumber(p[1]), tonumber(p[2]) end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	if vp.X > 100 then
		x = math.clamp(x, -(w or 100) + 60, vp.X - 60)
		y = math.clamp(y, 0, vp.Y - 30)
	end
	return math.floor(x), math.floor(y)
end
local function saveLayoutPos(key, f)
	if type(SETTINGS.LayoutPos) ~= "table" then SETTINGS.LayoutPos = {} end
	SETTINGS.LayoutPos[key] = { f.Position.X.Offset, f.Position.Y.Offset }
end

function layoutDrag(handle, target, key, when, exclude, onStart)
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		local t = i.UserInputType
		if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		if when and not when() then return end
		if exclude then
			for _, ex in ipairs(exclude) do
				if ex and ex.Visible then
					local p, s = ex.AbsolutePosition, ex.AbsoluteSize
					local x, y = i.Position.X, i.Position.Y
					if x >= p.X and x <= p.X + s.X and y >= p.Y and y <= p.Y + s.Y then return end
				end
			end
		end
		local p0 = i.Position
		DRAG.claim(i, target, function()
			if not DRAG.free() then return end
			DRAG.take(i)
			closeAllDropdowns()
			if onStart then pcall(onStart) end
			local start, sp = p0, target.Position
			local mc, ec
			mc = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
				if inp == i or (t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
					local d = inp.Position - start
					target.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y)
				end
			end)
			ec = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
				if inp == i or (t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
					mc:Disconnect()
					ec:Disconnect()
					DRAG.release(i)
					if key then saveLayoutPos(key, target) end
				end
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

function layoutDirty()
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w._lay and w._lay.schedule then w._lay.schedule() end
	end
end

end

local layoutBusy, newLayoutEngine, layoutUIHooks, setLayoutAll, layoutIsBusy, setLayoutFX
do

layoutBusy = false
local SLICE_MS = 4
local layoutRunning = nil
local function newSlicer()
	local t0, n = os.clock(), 0
	return function()
		n = n + 1
		if n % 2 ~= 0 then return end
		local ms = tonumber(getgenv().AX_SLICE_MS) or SLICE_MS
		if (os.clock() - t0) * 1000 >= ms then
			task.wait()
			t0 = os.clock()
		end
	end
end
local function propGet(o, k) return o[k] end
local function propSet(o, k, v) o[k] = v end
function newLayoutEngine(c)
	local E = { name = "Default", active = false }
	local rec, seen = {}, setmetatable({}, weakK)

	local function setp(o, k, v)
		if not o then return end
		local s = seen[o]
		if not s then s = {}; seen[o] = s end
		if s[k] == nil then
			local ok, cur = pcall(propGet, o, k)
			if not ok then return end
			s[k] = true
			rec[#rec + 1] = { o, k, cur }
		end
		pcall(propSet, o, k, v)
		local y = E._y
		if y then y() end
	end
	local owned = {}
	local function own(o, prop, off)
		if off == nil then off = false end
		owned[#owned + 1] = { o, prop or "Visible", off }
		return o
	end
	local function viewport()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local v = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
		if v.X < 100 then v = Vector2.new(1280, 720) end
		return v
	end
	local function tabOf(row)
		for _, t in ipairs(c.tabs) do if t.row == row then return t end end
	end
	local function secOfPage(p)
		for _, t in ipairs(c.tabs) do
			for _, s in ipairs(t.secs) do if s.page == p then return s end end
		end
	end
	local function eachBox(fn)
		for _, t in ipairs(c.tabs) do
			for _, s in ipairs(t.secs) do
				if s.wide then
					for _, ch in ipairs(s.wide:GetChildren()) do
						local g = gbReg[ch]
						if g then
							fn(ch, g, s)
							if E._y then E._y() end
						end
					end
				end
				for _, col in ipairs(s.cols) do
					for _, ch in ipairs(col.sc:GetChildren()) do
						local g = gbReg[ch]
						if g then
							fn(ch, g, s)
							if E._y then E._y() end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function shellTL()
		local w, h = c.size()
		local v = viewport()
		local p = c.Shell.Position
		return math.floor(v.X * p.X.Scale + p.X.Offset - w / 2), math.floor(v.Y * p.Y.Scale + p.Y.Offset - h / 2)
	end

	local HB = IS_MOBILE and 16 or 12
	local GAP = 8
	local zTop = 20
	local pops = {}

	local function raise(f)
		if not f then return end
		local top = zTop
		for _, o in ipairs(c.gui:GetChildren()) do
			if o ~= f and o:IsA("GuiObject") and (o.Name == "AXVapeWindow" or pops[o]) then
				local z = tonumber(o.ZIndex) or 0
				if z > top then top = z end
			end
		end
		if (tonumber(f.ZIndex) or 0) > top and f.ZIndex == zTop then return end
		zTop = top + 1
		f.ZIndex = zTop
	end
	E.raise = raise
	local function panel(name, z)
		local f = create("Frame", {
			Name = name,
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Main,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100),
			Visible = false,
			Active = true,
			ZIndex = z or 15,
		}, c.gui)
		corner(RADIUS + 2, f)
		stroke(1, T.Line, f)
		pops[f] = create("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, f)
		own(f)
		DRAG.register(f)
		f.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			local t = i.UserInputType

			if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				DRAG.claim(i, f, function() raise(f) end)
			end
		end)
		return f
	end
	local function hair(parent, y, z)
		return create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Line,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
			ZIndex = z or 16,
		}, parent)
	end
	local function handleBar(f, key, when)
		local h = create("Frame", {
			Name = "_handle",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HB),
			Active = true,
			ZIndex = 40,
		}, f)
		local pill = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.LineHi,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 3),
			ZIndex = 41,
		}, h)
		fullRound(pill)
		if not IS_MOBILE then
			h.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(pill, TI_HOVER, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 3), BackgroundColor3 = T.FontSub }) end)
			h.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(pill, TI_HOVER, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 3), BackgroundColor3 = T.LineHi }) end)
		end
		layoutDrag(h, f, key, when, nil, function() raise(f) end)
		return h
	end
	local function popIn(list)
		if not FX.slide then return end
		for _, f in ipairs(list) do
			local s = pops[f]
			if s and f.Visible then
				s.Scale = 0.965
				tw(s, TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 })
			end
		end
	end

	function E.setOpen(v, quiet)
		v = v and true or false
		if v and layoutBusy then v = false end
		c.Shell.Visible = v
		c.Main.Visible = v
	end

	function E.reset(y)
		if E.name == "Default" then return end
		for _, o in ipairs(owned) do
			pcall(propSet, o[1], o[2], o[3])
			if y then y() end
		end
		for i = #rec, 1, -1 do
			local r = rec[i]
			pcall(propSet, r[1], r[2], r[3])
			if y then y() end
		end
		rec, seen = {}, setmetatable({}, weakK)
		E.name, E.active = "Default", false
		pcall(c.afterReset)
		if layoutBusy then
			c.Shell.Visible = false
			c.Main.Visible = false
		end
	end

	function E.apply(name, y)
		if E.name ~= "Default" then E.reset(y) end
		E.name = "Default"
		E.active = false
		pcall(c.afterApply, "Default")
	end

	function E.refit() end

	function E.resize() end

	function E.paintTab(row, on)
		return false
	end

	function E.tabSelected() end

	function E.reveal(row) end

	function E.resetPositions()
		SETTINGS.LayoutPos = {}
	end

	return E
end

layoutUIHooks = {}
local layoutWanted = nil
local function keepTween(o)
	local ok, r = pcall(function() return o:IsDescendantOf(NotifGui) end)
	return ok and r
end
local function runLayoutSwitch()
	local y = newSlicer()
	while layoutWanted do
		local name = layoutWanted
		layoutWanted = nil
		layoutRunning = name
		local t0 = os.clock()
		for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
			if w and w._lay then pcall(w._lay.reset, y) end
		end
		if curStyle ~= name then
			applyStyle(name, y)
		else
			FX = fxFor(name)
			runFX(y)
		end
		y()
		for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
			if w and w._lay then pcall(w._lay.apply, name, y) end
		end
		for _, fn in ipairs(layoutUIHooks) do pcall(fn, name) end
		if getgenv().AX_PROFILE then print(("[AX] layout %s: %.1f ms of work"):format(name, (os.clock() - t0) * 1000)) end
	end
	pcall(twFlush, keepTween)
	TW_MODE.instant = false

	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w._gui and w._ownGui then pcall(function() w._gui.Enabled = true end) end
	end
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	if layoutWanted then
		TW_MODE.instant = true
		for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
			if w and w._gui and w._ownGui then pcall(function() w._gui.Enabled = false end) end
		end
		return runLayoutSwitch()
	end
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w._lay and w._open then pcall(w._lay.refit) end
	end
	pcall(twFlush, keepTween)
	layoutBusy = false
	layoutRunning = nil
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w._lay and w._open then
			if w._setVisible then pcall(w._setVisible, true) else pcall(w._lay.setOpen, true) end
		end
	end
end

function setLayoutAll(name)
	if name ~= "Default" then name = "Default" end
	SETTINGS.Layout = name
	if layoutBusy then

		if name == layoutRunning then layoutWanted = nil else layoutWanted = name end
		return
	end

	if curStyle == name then
		local all = true
		for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
			if w and w._lay and w._lay.name ~= name then all = false break end
		end
		if all then return end
	end
	layoutWanted = name
	layoutBusy = true
	pcall(closeAllDropdowns)
	pcall(closeAllPickers)
	pcall(hideTip)
	pcall(twFlush, keepTween)
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w._lay then pcall(w._lay.setOpen, false) end
	end

	TW_MODE.instant = true
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w._gui and w._ownGui then pcall(function() w._gui.Enabled = false end) end
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(runLayoutSwitch)
		if not ok then
			warn("[AX] layout switch failed: " .. tostring(err))
			layoutBusy = false
			layoutRunning = nil
			TW_MODE.instant = false
			for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
				if w and w._gui then pcall(function() w._gui.Enabled = true end) end
			end
			for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
				if w and w._open and w._setVisible then pcall(w._setVisible, true) end
			end
		end
	end)
end
function layoutIsBusy() return layoutBusy end

function setLayoutFX(key, v)
	local name = curStyle
	if type(SETTINGS.LayoutFX) ~= "table" then SETTINGS.LayoutFX = {} end
	if type(SETTINGS.LayoutFX[name]) ~= "table" then SETTINGS.LayoutFX[name] = {} end
	SETTINGS.LayoutFX[name][key] = v and true or false
	FX = fxFor(name)
	runFX()
end

onFX(function(y)
	local on = GLOW.on("head")
	for _, g in pairs(gbReg) do
		for _, gl in ipairs(g.glows) do pcall(propSet, gl, "Visible", on) end
		if y then y() end
	end
end)

end

local externalPanelOpen, reconcileUI, computeSize, createWindow
do
externalPanelOpen=false
function reconcileUI()
	local winOpen = false
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w._open then
			winOpen = true
			break
		end
	end
	local anyOpen = externalPanelOpen or winOpen
	if anyOpen then
		applyBlur(IS_MOBILE and 8 or 10, 0.2)
		setMouseUnlocked(true)
		pcall(function() CursorGui.Enabled = true end)
	else
		applyBlur(0, 0.15)
		setMouseUnlocked(false)
		pcall(function() CursorGui.Enabled = false end)
	end
	if winOpen then brandShow() else brandHide() end
	if winOpen ~= brand.edge.shown and (not winOpen or GLOW.on("edge")) then pcall(brand.edgeShow, winOpen) end
end

function computeSize()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return WIN_W_BASE, WIN_H_BASE end
	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	if IS_MOBILE then
		local sx = vp.X * 0.94
		local sy = vp.Y * 0.86
		local s = math.min(sx / WIN_W_BASE, sy / WIN_H_BASE, 1)
		return math.floor(WIN_W_BASE * s), math.floor(WIN_H_BASE * s)
	end
	return WIN_W_BASE, WIN_H_BASE
end

function createWindow(opts)
	opts = opts or {}

	if opts.TabFont then F_TAB = opts.TabFont end
	if opts.GroupboxFont then F_GROUP = opts.GroupboxFont end
	if opts.ElementFont then F_BODY = opts.ElementFont; F_MED = opts.ElementFont end
	if opts.ShowBrand == false then brand.enabled = false end

	local gui = opts.Gui or makeGui(nextCamoName(), opts.DisplayOrder or 2147483645, true)

	pcall(function() if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling end end)

	local Content
	local tabFrameOwnerRow = {}
	local pageOwnerSB = {}
	local winTabs = {}
	local win = {}

	local W, H = computeSize()
	local sizeVec = nil
	if typeof(opts.Size) == "Vector2" then
		W, H = opts.Size.X, opts.Size.Y
		sizeVec = opts.Size
	elseif typeof(opts.Size) == "UDim2" then
		W, H = opts.Size.X.Offset, opts.Size.Y.Offset
		sizeVec = Vector2.new(W, H)
	end

	local function defaultPos()
		return UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	end

	local Shell = create("Frame", {
		Name = "WindowShell",

		Position = opts.Position or defaultPos(),

		ZIndex = 10,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
		Visible = false,
	}, gui)
	corner(RADIUS + 4, Shell)
	local ShellScale = create("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, Shell)

		Name = "Window",

		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H),

		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Visible = false,
	}, Shell)
	corner(RADIUS + 2, Main)
	local mainStroke = stroke(1, T.Line, Main)

	local coverCbs
	do
		local function raw(cls, props, parent)
			local o = Instance.new(cls)
			for k, v in pairs(props) do pcall(propSetRaw, o, k, v) end
			o.Parent = parent
			return o
		end
		local cover = raw("Frame", {
			Name = "_dragCover", BackgroundColor3 = T.Main, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 500, Visible = false, Active = false,
		}, Main)
		local cc = raw("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, RADIUS + 2) }, cover)
		local row = raw("Frame", {
			Name = "_uc", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, ZIndex = 501,
		}, cover)
		raw("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		}, row)
		local function glyph(txt, ord)
			return raw("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = txt, TextSize = 60, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				TextTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = ord, ZIndex = 502,
			}, row)
		end
		local ucU, ucC = glyph("g", 1), glyph("3", 2)
		raw("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(59, 0, 128), Color3.fromRGB(110, 20, 200)),
		}, ucC)
		local TI_CV = TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local token = 0
		coverCbs = {
			start = function()
				if SETTINGS.DragCover == false then return end
				token = token + 1
				cover.BackgroundColor3 = Main.BackgroundColor3
				local mc = Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
				if mc then cc.CornerRadius = mc.CornerRadius end
				cover.Visible = true
				TweenServ:Create(cover, TI_CV, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
				TweenServ:Create(ucU, TI_CV, { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
				TweenServ:Create(ucC, TI_CV, { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
			end,
			stop = function()
				token = token + 1
				local my = token
				TweenServ:Create(cover, TI_CV, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				TweenServ:Create(ucU, TI_CV, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				TweenServ:Create(ucC, TI_CV, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				task.delay(0.16, function() if token == my then cover.Visible = false end end)
			end,
		}
		win._cover = cover
	end

	local Header = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Header",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TOP_H),
		ZIndex = 11,
	}, Main)

	local HeaderLine = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = T.Line,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, TOP_H),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
		ZIndex = 12,
	}, Main)
	local sideW = math.clamp(tonumber(opts.SidebarWidth) or SIDEBAR_W, SIDE_MIN, SIDE_MAX)
	sideW = math.max(SIDE_MIN, math.min(sideW, W - CONTENT_MIN))
	local VDivider = create("Frame", {
		Name = "SidebarDivider",
		BackgroundColor3 = T.Line,

		Position = UDim2.new(0, sideW, 0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -(BOT_H + 1)),
		ZIndex = 12,

	local TitleArea = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Brand",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, sideW, 1, 0),
		ClipsDescendants = true,

		if img:match("^%d+$") then img = "rbxassetid://" .. img end

			Name = "Logo",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -10),
			Image = img,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, TitleArea)
	end

	local TitleLbl = create("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0),
		Font = F_TITLE,
		Text = opts.Title or "UI",
		TextColor3 = T.Font,
		TextSize = 18,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Visible = not hasLogo,
		ZIndex = 13,
	}, TitleArea)
	fontRole[TitleLbl] = "title"

	local CloseBtn = create("TextButton", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "",
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = 14,
	}, Header)
	icon(CloseBtn, "close", 10, T.FontSub, 15)

	local SearchWrap = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = T.Element,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, sideW + 1 + PAD, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -(sideW + 1 + PAD + 6 + SEARCH_H + PAD), 0, SEARCH_H),
		ZIndex = 13,
	}, Header)
	corner(RADIUS, SearchWrap)
	local searchStroke = stroke(1, T.CtlEdge, SearchWrap)

	local mag = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
		ZIndex = 14,
	}, SearchWrap)
	local magRing = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
		ZIndex = 14,

	local closeSearchPop
	closeSearchPop = function()
		SearchPop.Visible = false
		openDropdowns[closeSearchPop] = nil
	end

	local function flashRow(row)
		local hl = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.55,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			ZIndex = 60,
		}, row)
		corner(RADIUS, hl)
		regAccent(hl, "BackgroundColor3")
		TweenServ:Create(hl, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		task.delay(0.65, function() if hl then hl:Destroy() end end)
	end

	local function jumpTo(row)
		local node = row
		while node do
			if pageOwnerSB[node] then pcall(pageOwnerSB[node]) end
			if tabFrameOwnerRow[node] then pcall(tabFrameOwnerRow[node]) end
			node = node.Parent
		end
		if win._lay and win._lay.active then pcall(win._lay.reveal, row) end
		task.defer(function()
			if not row.Parent then return end
			local sc = row.Parent
			while sc and not (sc:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and sc.ScrollingEnabled) do sc = sc.Parent end
			if sc then
				local relY = row.AbsolutePosition.Y - sc.AbsolutePosition.Y + sc.CanvasPosition.Y
				sc.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(sc.CanvasPosition.X, math.max(0, relY - 24))
			end
			flashRow(row)
		end)
	end

	local function runSearch()
		for _, ch in ipairs(SearchPopInner:GetChildren()) do
			if ch:IsA("TextButton") or ch:IsA("TextLabel") then ch:Destroy() end
		end
		local q = string.lower(SearchBox.Text or "")
		if q == "" then closeSearchPop(); return end
		local shown = 0

		local function ours(r)
			local n = r.Parent
			while n do
				if pageOwnerSB[n] or tabFrameOwnerRow[n] then return true end
				n = n.Parent
			end
			return false
		end
		for _, e in ipairs(searchIndex) do
			if shown >= 8 then break end
			if e.row.Parent and ours(e.row) and string.find(string.lower(tostring(e.text)), q, 1, true) then
				shown = shown + 1
				local B = create("TextButton", {
					BackgroundColor3 = T.ElementHover,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					Text = "",
					LayoutOrder = shown,
					ZIndex = 302,
				}, SearchPopInner)
				corner(RADIUS - 1, B)
				create("TextLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -11, 1, 0),
					Font = F_BODY,
					Text = e.text,
					TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
					TextSize = TS_SMALL,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
					ZIndex = 303,
				}, B)
				if not IS_MOBILE then
					B.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(B, TI_FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }) end)
					B.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(B, TI_FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
				end
				local rowRef = e.row
				B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					closeSearchPop()
					jumpTo(rowRef)
				end)
			end
		end
		if shown == 0 then
			create("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
				Font = F_BODY,
				Text = "  no matches",
				TextColor3 = T.FontSub,
				TextSize = TS_SMALL,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				ZIndex = 302,
			}, SearchPopInner)
			shown = 1
		end
		local bp, bs = SearchWrap.AbsolutePosition, SearchWrap.AbsoluteSize
		SearchPop.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bp.X, bp.Y + bs.Y + 4)
		SearchPop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bs.X, math.min(shown, 6) * 22 + 6)
		SearchPop.Visible = true
		openDropdowns[closeSearchPop] = true
	end

	SearchBox.Focused:Connect(function()
		tw(searchStroke, TI_FAST, { Color = T.Accent })
		if SearchBox.Text ~= "" then runSearch() end
	end)
	SearchBox.FocusLost:Connect(function() tw(searchStroke, TI_FAST, { Color = T.CtlEdge }) end)
	SearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(runSearch)

	local composeFooter
	do
		pcall(cfgSys.AutoExec.setDev, opts.AutoExecute or opts.Loader or opts.LoaderUrl)
		local DISCORD = opts.Discord
		if DISCORD == nil then DISCORD = "grav.lol" end
		win._discord = DISCORD
		local short = DISCORD and (tostring(DISCORD):gsub("^https?://", ""):gsub("/+$", "")) or ""
		local function esc(x) return (x:gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")) end
		local DcBtn, dcGlow, dcLine, dcHover, dcBusy
		local plainFull, footerBase, compact = "", "", false

		local function render()
			local pre = footerBase ~= "" and (footerBase .. "  |  ") or ""
			local aw = FooterText.AbsoluteSize.X
			compact = pre ~= "" and aw > 0 and textW(pre .. short, FooterText.TextSize, FooterText.Font) > aw - 4
			if compact then pre = "" end
			plainFull = pre .. short
			local txt = esc(pre) .. '<font transparency="1">' .. esc(short) .. "</font>"
			FooterText.RichText = true
			if FooterText.Text ~= txt then FooterText.Text = txt end
		end
		function composeFooter(l)
			l = tostring(l or "")
			if not DISCORD then
				FooterText.RichText = false
				FooterText.Text = l
				return
			end
			local base = l:gsub("https?://discord%.gg/[%w%-_]+", ""):gsub("discord%.gg/[%w%-_]+", "")
			base = base:gsub("[%s|%-]+$", ""):gsub("^[%s|%-]+", "")
			footerBase = base
			render()
		end
		if DISCORD then
			local TI_DC = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			dcGlow = create("ImageLabel", {
				Name = "DiscordGlow",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Image = "rbxassetid://18245826428",
				ImageColor3 = T.Accent,
				ImageTransparency = 0.8,
				ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
				SliceCenter = Rect.new(21, 21, 79, 79),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 30),
				ZIndex = 13,
			}, FooterText)
			regAccent(dcGlow, "ImageColor3")
			DcBtn = create("TextButton", {
				Name = "DiscordLink",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, 0),
				Font = FooterText.Font,
				Text = short,
				TextColor3 = T.Accent,
				TextSize = FooterText.TextSize,
				ZIndex = 14,
			}, FooterText)
			regAccent(DcBtn, "TextColor3")
			dcLine = create("Frame", {
				BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
				Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -3),
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1),
				ZIndex = 15,
			}, DcBtn)
			regAccent(dcLine, "BackgroundColor3")
			local function place()
				local f, ts = FooterText.Font, FooterText.TextSize
				DcBtn.Font, DcBtn.TextSize = f, ts
				if not dcBusy then DcBtn.Text = short end
				local lw = math.ceil(textW(short, ts, f))
				local tb = FooterText.TextBounds.X
				if not tb or tb <= 0 then tb = textW(plainFull, ts, f) end
				local ax, sx, ox = FooterText.TextXAlignment, 0.5, tb / 2
				if ax == Enum.TextXAlignment.Left then sx, ox = 0, tb
				elseif ax == Enum.TextXAlignment.Right then sx, ox = 1, 0 end
				ox = math.floor(ox + 0.5)
				DcBtn.Position = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0.5, 0)
				DcBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, lw + 2, 1, 0)
				dcGlow.Position = UDim2.new(sx, ox - lw / 2, 0.5, 0)
				dcGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(lw + 30, 30)
			end
			for _, prop in ipairs({ "TextBounds", "Text", "TextXAlignment" }) do
				FooterText:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(place)
			end
			for _, prop in ipairs({ "Font", "TextSize", "AbsoluteSize" }) do
				FooterText:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(function() render(); place() end)
			end
			local function paint()
				local on = dcHover or dcBusy
				tw(DcBtn, TI_DC, { TextColor3 = on and T.Font or T.Accent })
				tw(dcGlow, TI_DC, { ImageTransparency = on and 0.45 or 0.8, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(DcBtn.Size.X.Offset + (on and 40 or 30), on and 34 or 30) })
				tw(dcLine, TI_DC, { Size = UDim2.new(on and 1 or 0, 0, 0, 1) })
			end
			DcBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() dcHover = true; paint() end)
			DcBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() dcHover = false; paint() end)
			DcBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				local f = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set) or (syn and syn.write_clipboard)
				local ok = f and pcall(f, DISCORD)
				if ok then notif("Discord: invite copied to clipboard", 3, T.Accent, "info")
				else notif("Discord: " .. DISCORD, 6, T.Accent, "info") end
				dcBusy = true
				DcBtn.Text = ok and "copied!" or short
				dcGlow.ImageTransparency = 0.25
				paint()
				task.delay(1.2, function()
					dcBusy = false
					if DcBtn.Parent then DcBtn.Text = short; paint() end
				end)
			end)
			composeFooter(FooterText.Text)
			place()
		else
			composeFooter(FooterText.Text)
		end
	end

	local curW, curH = W, H

	local SideGrip, gripPill
	local function applySidebar(w)
		w = math.floor(math.clamp(w, SIDE_MIN, SIDE_MAX))
		w = math.max(SIDE_MIN, math.min(w, curW - CONTENT_MIN))
		sideW = w
		win._sideW = w
		if win._lay and win._lay.active then win._lay.schedule() return w end
		VDivider.Position = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 0)
		TitleArea.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0)
		SearchWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, w + 1 + PAD, 0.5, 0)
		SearchWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(w + 1 + PAD + 6 + SEARCH_H + PAD), 0, SEARCH_H)
		Sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0)
		Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, w + 1, 0, 0)
		Content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(w + 1), 1, 0)
		if SideGrip then SideGrip.Position = UDim2.new(0, w - SideGrip.Size.X.Offset / 2, 0, TOP_H + 1) end
		win._sideW = w
		return w
	end

	local function layoutWin(nw, nh)
		curW, curH = nw, nh
		Shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(nw + 4, nh + 4)
		Main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(nw, nh)
		if sideW > nw - CONTENT_MIN then applySidebar(sideW) end
		if win._lay and win._lay.active then win._lay.resize() end
	end

	do
		local GRIP_W = IS_MOBILE and 16 or 9
		SideGrip = create("TextButton", {
			Name = "SidebarGrip",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
			Position = UDim2.new(0, sideW - GRIP_W / 2, 0, TOP_H + 1),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, GRIP_W, 1, -(TOP_H + 1 + BOT_H + 1)),
			ZIndex = 40,
		}, Main)
		gripPill = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.LineHi,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 30),
			ZIndex = 41,
		}, SideGrip)
		fullRound(gripPill)
		local TI_GRIP = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local hovering, dragging = false, nil
		local function paintGrip()
			local on = hovering or dragging ~= nil
			tw(VDivider, TI_GRIP, { BackgroundColor3 = on and T.LineHi or T.Line })
			tw(gripPill, TI_GRIP, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, on and 36 or 24) })
		end
		SideGrip.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hovering = true; paintGrip() end)
		SideGrip.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hovering = false; paintGrip() end)
		SideGrip.InputBegan:Connect(DRAG.gate(SideGrip, function(i)
			if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if dragging then return end
			dragging = i
			closeAllDropdowns()
			closeAllPickers()
			paintGrip()
			local startX, startW = i.Position.X, sideW
			local mc, ec
			mc = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
				if inp == dragging or (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and dragging and dragging.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
					applySidebar(startW + (inp.Position.X - startX))
				end
			end)
			ec = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
				if inp == dragging or (dragging and dragging.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
					if mc then mc:Disconnect() end
					if ec then ec:Disconnect() end
					dragging = nil
					paintGrip()
				end
			end)
		end))
	end
	win._sideW = sideW

	local function setVisible(v)
		v = v and true or false
		win._open = v
		if layoutBusy then
			Shell.Visible = false
			Main.Visible = false
			if win._lay then pcall(win._lay.setOpen, false) end
			if not v then closeAllDropdowns(); closeAllPickers(); hideTip() end
			reconcileUI()
			return
		end
		if win._lay and win._lay.active then
			win._lay.setOpen(v)
		else
			Shell.Visible = v
			Main.Visible = v
		end
		if v then
			local sc = math.clamp((tonumber(SETTINGS.MenuScale) or 100) / 100, 0.5, 1.6)
			if FX.slide then
				ShellScale.Scale = 0.965 * sc
				tw(ShellScale, TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = sc })
			else
				ShellScale.Scale = sc
			end
		else
			closeAllDropdowns()
			closeAllPickers()
			hideTip()
		end
		reconcileUI()
	end
