	end)

	local resizing = nil
	ResizeBtn.InputBegan:Connect(DRAG.gate(ResizeBtn, function(i)
		if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		if resizing then return end
		resizing = i
		closeAllDropdowns()
		closeAllPickers()
		local startPos = i.Position
		local sw, sh = curW, curH
		local lastW, lastH = curW, curH
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
		local mc, ec
		mc = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
			if inp == resizing or (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and resizing and resizing.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
				local d = inp.Position - startPos
				local nw = math.clamp(math.floor(sw + d.X), MIN_W, math.max(MIN_W, vp.X - 24))
				local nh = math.clamp(math.floor(sh + d.Y), MIN_H, math.max(MIN_H, vp.Y - 24))
				if nw ~= lastW or nh ~= lastH then

					local sp = Shell.Position
					Shell.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + (nw - lastW) / 2, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + (nh - lastH) / 2)
					lastW, lastH = nw, nh
					layoutWin(nw, nh)
					win._size = Vector2.new(nw, nh)
				end
			end
		end)
		ec = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
			if inp == resizing or (resizing and resizing.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
				if mc then mc:Disconnect() end
				if ec then ec:Disconnect() end
				resizing = nil
			end
		end)
	end))

	local selectedTabBtn = nil
	local firstTab = true
	local tabCount = 0
	local tabGlow = {}

	local HALOS = { { 2, 0.74 }, { 4, 0.86 }, { 7, 0.94 } }
	local NAV_GLOW_IMAGE = "rbxassetid://18245826428"
	local function navGlow(btn, radius, z, inset, withFill, kind)
		inset = inset or 12
		local vertical = kind == "sub"
		local c = {}
		if withFill then
			c.hover = create("Frame", {
				Name = "_hover", BackgroundColor3 = T.Glow, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = z,
			}, btn)
			corner(radius, c.hover)
		end
		local edge = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.18, 0.35),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.82, 0.35),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		c.halos = {}
		if not vertical then
			for k, h in ipairs(HALOS) do
				local f = create("Frame", {
					Name = "_halo", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, h[1]), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1 + h[1] * 2), ZIndex = z,
				}, btn)
				create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, f)
				regGrad(create("UIGradient", { Transparency = edge }, f), "aba")
				c.halos[k] = { f = f, pad = h[1], base = h[2] }
			end
		end
		c.line = create("Frame", {
			Name = vertical and "_subIndicator" or "_glow", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AnchorPoint = vertical and Vector2.new(0, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Position = vertical and UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
			Size = vertical and UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1), ZIndex = z + 2,
		}, btn)
		regGrad(create("UIGradient", { Transparency = edge }, c.line), vertical and "ab" or "aba")
		if vertical then
			c.bloom = create("ImageLabel", {
				Name = "_subIndicatorGlow", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = NAV_GLOW_IMAGE,
				ImageColor3 = T.Accent, ImageTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
				SliceCenter = Rect.new(21, 21, 79, 79), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 1, 12), ZIndex = z + 1,
			}, btn)
			regAccent(c.bloom, "ImageColor3")

			local ok, sh = pcall(function()
				local q = Instance.new("UIShadow")
				q.Color = T.Accent; q.Spread = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 15)
				q.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 10); q.Transparency = 1; q.Parent = c.line
				return q
			end)
			if ok and sh then c.shadow = sh; regAccent(sh, "Color") end
		end
		local loops, selected, token = {}, false, 0
		local function stopLoops()
			for _, t in ipairs(loops) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
			table.clear(loops)
		end
		local function wantLine() return vertical or (FX.line and (kind ~= "tab" or FX.tabLine)) end
		function c.select(on, force)
			if on == selected and not force then return end
			selected, token = on, token + 1
			local my = token
			stopLoops()
			local L, G = wantLine(), (wantLine() and FX.glow)
			if on then
				if c.hover then tw(c.hover, TI_HOVER, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end
				local lineGoal = vertical
					and { Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -8), BackgroundTransparency = L and 0 or 1 }
					or { Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset, 0, 1), BackgroundTransparency = L and 0 or 1 }
				if force or not FX.slide then
					for k, v in pairs(lineGoal) do c.line[k] = v end
				else
					c.line.Size = vertical and UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)
					tw(c.line, TI_SELECT, lineGoal)
				end
				if c.bloom then
					c.bloom.Visible = true
					if force or not FX.slide then c.bloom.ImageTransparency = G and 0.82 or 1
					else tw(c.bloom, TI_SELECT, { ImageTransparency = G and 0.82 or 1 }) end
				end
				if c.shadow then c.shadow.Transparency = G and 0.18 or 1 end
				for _, h in ipairs(c.halos) do
					local goal = { Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset + h.pad * 2, 0, 1 + h.pad * 2), BackgroundTransparency = G and h.base or 1 }
					if force or not FX.slide then for k, v in pairs(goal) do h.f[k] = v end
					else h.f.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1 + h.pad * 2); tw(h.f, TI_SELECT, goal) end
				end
				if G and not vertical then
					task.delay(force and 0 or 0.45, function()
						if token ~= my or not selected then return end
						for _, h in ipairs(c.halos) do
							local ok, t = pcall(function() return TweenServ:Create(h.f, TI_BREATHE, { BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, h.base + 0.05) }) end)
							if ok and t then loops[#loops + 1] = t; t:Play() end
						end
					end)
				end
			else
				local out = TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				tw(c.line, out, { Size = vertical and UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
				if c.bloom then tw(c.bloom, out, { ImageTransparency = 1 }) end
				if c.shadow then c.shadow.Transparency = 1 end
				for _, h in ipairs(c.halos) do tw(h.f, out, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1 + h.pad * 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end
			end
		end
			function c.hoverOn(on)
				if selected or not c.hover or (win._lay and win._lay.name == "Aurelia") then return end
				tw(c.hover, TI_HOVER, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.97 or 1 })
			end
			onFX(function()
				if not selected then return end
				if win._lay and win._lay.name == "Aurelia" then c.select(false, true)
				else c.select(true, true) end
			end)
		return c
	end

	local function paintTabRow(row, on)
		if win._lay and win._lay.active and win._lay.paintTab(row, on) then return end
		local g = tabGlow[row]
		if g then g.select(on) end
		local l = row:FindFirstChild("_lbl")
		if l then tw(l, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = on and T.Font or T.FontSub }) end
	end

	local SB_IDLE = IS_MOBILE and 4 or 2
	local SB_WIDE = IS_MOBILE and 7 or 6
	local SB_HIT = IS_MOBILE and 18 or GUTTER
	local SB_MIN_THUMB = IS_MOBILE and 36 or 24
	local function attachScrollbar(sc, parent, xScale, xOff)
		local Rail = create("TextButton", {
			Name = "_scroll",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(xScale, xOff, 0, 2),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, SB_HIT, 1, -12),
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 20,
		}, parent)
		local Groove = create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Line,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, SB_IDLE, 1, 0),
			ZIndex = 20,
		}, Rail)
		fullRound(Groove)
		local Thumb = create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = T.LineHi,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, SB_IDLE, 0, SB_MIN_THUMB),
			ZIndex = 21,
		}, Rail)
		fullRound(Thumb)

		local hovered, dragging = false, false
		local function metrics()
			local viewH = math.max(0, sc.AbsoluteSize.Y)
			local canvasH = math.max(0, sc.CanvasSize.Y.Offset)
			local railH = math.max(0, Rail.AbsoluteSize.Y)
			if railH <= 0 or viewH <= 0 or canvasH <= 0 then
				return viewH, canvasH, railH, 0
			end
			local thumbMin = math.min(SB_MIN_THUMB, railH)
			local thumbH = math.clamp(railH * viewH / math.max(canvasH, viewH, 1), thumbMin, railH)
			return viewH, canvasH, railH, thumbH
		end
		local function refresh()
			local viewH, canvasH, railH, thumbH = metrics()
			local need = (not win._railsOff) and railH > 0 and canvasH > viewH + 1
			Rail.Visible = need
			if not need then return end
			local maxScroll = canvasH - viewH
			local r = math.clamp(sc.CanvasPosition.Y / maxScroll, 0, 1)
			local w = Thumb.Size.X.Offset
			Thumb.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, thumbH)
			Thumb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.floor((railH - thumbH) * r + 0.5))
		end
		local function paint()
			local wide = hovered or dragging
			local w = wide and SB_WIDE or SB_IDLE
			tw(Thumb, TI_HOVER, {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, Thumb.Size.Y.Offset),
				BackgroundColor3 = wide and T.FontSub or T.LineHi,
			})
			tw(Groove, TI_HOVER, {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = wide and 0.4 or 1,
			})
		end
		local function scrollToThumbY(y)
			local viewH, canvasH, railH, thumbH = metrics()
			local maxScroll = math.max(canvasH - viewH, 0)
			local r = math.clamp(y / math.max(railH - thumbH, 1), 0, 1)
			sc.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, r * maxScroll)
		end

		Rail.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hovered = true; paint() end)
		Rail.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hovered = false; paint() end)

		local active
		Rail.InputBegan:Connect(DRAG.gate(Rail, function(i)
			local t = i.UserInputType
			if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
				local _, canvasH = metrics()
				local maxScroll = math.max(canvasH - sc.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0)
				sc.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.clamp(sc.CanvasPosition.Y - i.Position.Z * 40, 0, maxScroll))
				return
			end
			if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if active then return end
			active = i
			dragging = true
			paint()
			local _, _, _, thumbH = metrics()
			local localY = i.Position.Y - Rail.AbsolutePosition.Y
			local thumbY = Thumb.Position.Y.Offset
			local grab
			if localY >= thumbY and localY <= thumbY + thumbH then
				grab = localY - thumbY
			else
				grab = thumbH / 2
				scrollToThumbY(localY - grab)
			end
			local mc, ec
			mc = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
				if inp == active or (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
					scrollToThumbY(inp.Position.Y - Rail.AbsolutePosition.Y - grab)
				end
			end)
			ec = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
				if inp == active or (active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
					if mc then mc:Disconnect() end
					if ec then ec:Disconnect() end
					active = nil
					dragging = false
					paint()
				end
			end)
		end))

		sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(refresh)
		sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasSize"):Connect(refresh)
		sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(refresh)
		Rail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(refresh)
		refresh()
		return Rail, refresh
	end

	local function slideIn(frame)
		if not FX.slide then frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) return end
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8)
		tw(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) })
	end

	local function newTab(tabTitle, isSettings, to)
		tabCount = tabCount + 1

		local tIcon, tCat = nil, win._cat
		if type(to) == "string" then tIcon = to
		elseif type(to) == "table" then
			tIcon = to.Icon or to.icon
			if to.Category ~= nil or to.category ~= nil then tCat = to.Category or to.category end
		end
		if isSettings then tCat = "Menu"; tIcon = tIcon or "settings" end
		local tabRec = { title = tabTitle, secs = {}, isSettings = isSettings, icon = tIcon, category = tCat }
		winTabs[#winTabs + 1] = tabRec
		local TabRow = create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 32 or 30),
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			ClipsDescendants = false,
			ZIndex = 13,
			LayoutOrder = (isSettings and 9999 or tabCount),
		}, TabList)
		corner(RADIUS, TabRow)

		tabGlow[TabRow] = navGlow(TabRow, RADIUS, 13, 16, false, "tab")

		local TB = create("TextLabel", {
			Name = "_lbl",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,

			Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0),
			Font = F_TAB,
			Text = tabTitle,
			TextColor3 = T.FontSub,
			TextSize = TS_TAB,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			ZIndex = 16,
		}, TabRow)
		fontRole[TB] = "tab"

		local TabFrame = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 10,
		}, Content)

		local SubBox = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, GUTTER, 0, SUB_TOP),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, SUB_STRIP),
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 11,
		}, TabFrame)

		local SubRule = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Line,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, GUTTER, 0, SUB_TOP + SUB_STRIP - 1),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -GUTTER * 2, 0, 1),
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 10,
		}, TabFrame)

		local SubBar = create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Active = true,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			ZIndex = 12,
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
			ScrollBarThickness = 0,
			TopImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			BottomImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			ClipsDescendants = true,
		}, SubBox)
		local subList = create("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		}, SubBar)

		local function fitSubBox()
			local avail = math.max(60, TabFrame.AbsoluteSize.X - GUTTER * 2)
			local h = SubBox.Size.Y.Offset
			SubBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(subList.AbsoluteContentSize.X, avail), h > 0 and h or SUB_STRIP)
		end

		wheelScrollX(SubBar)
		subList:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(fitSubBox)
		TabFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitSubBox)
		fitSubBox()

		local SubContent = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, SUBTAB_H),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -SUBTAB_H),
			ZIndex = 10,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
		}, TabFrame)

		local function activate()
			paintTabRow(TabRow, true)
			TabFrame.Visible = true
		end

		local function selectTab()
			if selectedTabBtn == TabRow then return end
			closeAllDropdowns()
			closeAllPickers()
			for _, ch in ipairs(TabList:GetChildren()) do
				if ch:IsA("TextButton") and ch ~= TabRow then paintTabRow(ch, false) end
			end
			for _, f in ipairs(Content:GetChildren()) do
				if f:IsA("Frame") then f.Visible = false end
			end
			selectedTabBtn = TabRow
			activate()
			slideIn(TabFrame)
			if win._lay and win._lay.active then win._lay.tabSelected() end
		end
		tabFrameOwnerRow[TabFrame] = selectTab

		if firstTab and not isSettings then
			firstTab = false
			selectedTabBtn = TabRow
			activate()
		end

		TabRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(selectTab)

		if not IS_MOBILE then
			TabRow.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				if selectedTabBtn ~= TabRow then
					tabGlow[TabRow].hoverOn(true)
					tw(TB, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = T.FontDim })
				end
			end)
			TabRow.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				tabGlow[TabRow].hoverOn(false)
				if selectedTabBtn ~= TabRow then
					tw(TB, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = T.FontSub })
				end
			end)
		end

		local firstSub = true
		local activeSubBtn = nil
		local subGlow = {}
		local subBtns = {}
		tabRec.row, tabRec.lbl, tabRec.frame = TabRow, TB, TabFrame
		tabRec.subBox, tabRec.subRule, tabRec.subBar, tabRec.subContent = SubBox, SubRule, SubBar, SubContent
		tabRec.select = selectTab
		tabRec.fitSub = fitSubBox
		tabRec.active = function()
			for _, sr in ipairs(tabRec.secs) do
				if sr.btn == activeSubBtn then return sr end
			end
		end
		layoutDirty()

		local function paintSub(sb, on)
			local g = subGlow[sb]
			if g then g.select(on) end
			local l = sb:FindFirstChild("_lbl")
			if l then tw(l, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = on and T.Font or T.FontSub }) end
		end

		local function newSection(sName, sIcon)
			if type(sIcon) == "table" then sIcon = sIcon.Icon or sIcon.icon end
			SubBox.Visible = true
			SubRule.Visible = true
			local SB = create("TextButton", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "",
				LayoutOrder = #subBtns + 1,
				ZIndex = 13,
			}, SubBar)
			corner(RADIUS - 1, SB)
			local SLbl = create("TextLabel", {
				Name = "_lbl",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				Font = F_TAB,
				Text = sName,
				TextColor3 = T.FontSub,
				TextSize = TS_BODY,
				ZIndex = 16,
			}, SB)
			create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9) }, SLbl)
			fontRole[SLbl] = "tab"
			subGlow[SB] = navGlow(SB, 0, 13, 4, false, "sub")
			subBtns[#subBtns + 1] = SB

			local Page = create("Frame", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
				Visible = false,
				ZIndex = 10,
			}, SubContent)

			local Wide = create("Frame", {
				Name = "WideRail", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Position = UDim2.new(0, GUTTER - COL_P, 0, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -(GUTTER - COL_P) * 2, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
				ZIndex = 10,
			}, Page)
			local wll = create("UIListLayout", {
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
			}, Wide)
			create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 1) }, Wide)
			local ColsWrap = create("Frame", {
				Name = "ColsWrap", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 9,
			}, Page)
			local function placeCols()
				local h = 0
			pcall(function()
				local has = false
				for _, c in ipairs(Wide:GetChildren()) do
					if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible then has = true break end
				end
				if has then h = (wll.AbsoluteContentSize and wll.AbsoluteContentSize.Y or 0) + 1 end
			end)
				local off = h > 0 and (h + 8) or 0
				ColsWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, off)
				ColsWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -off)
			end
			gbWideFix[Wide] = placeCols
			Wide:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(placeCols)

			wll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(placeCols)
			placeCols()

			local function mkCol(xScale)
				local sc = create("ScrollingFrame", {
					Active = true,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,

					Position = UDim2.new(xScale, xScale == 0 and (GUTTER - COL_P) or (GUTTER / 2 - COL_P), 0, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -(GUTTER + GUTTER / 2) + COL_P * 2, 1, 0),
					CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
					ScrollBarThickness = 0,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
					TopImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
					BottomImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
					ZIndex = 10,
					ClipsDescendants = true,
				}, ColsWrap)
				create("UIPadding", {
					PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 1),
					PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
					PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, COL_P),
					PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, COL_P),
				}, sc)
				local list = create("UIListLayout", {
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
					Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
				}, sc)

				local function resizeCol()
					sc.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, list.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 14)
				end
				list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(resizeCol)
				resizeCol()
				sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(closeAllDropdowns)

				local rail, railRefresh = attachScrollbar(sc, ColsWrap, xScale + 0.5, xScale == 0 and 0 or -GUTTER / 2)
				return sc, { sc = sc, list = list, rail = rail, refresh = railRefresh }
			end

			local L, Lc = mkCol(0)
			local R, Rc = mkCol(0.5)
			gbWideOf[L] = Wide
			gbWideOf[R] = Wide
			gbIsRail[Wide] = true

			local function selectThis()
				local changed = activeSubBtn ~= SB
				closeAllDropdowns()
				for _, sb in ipairs(subBtns) do
					if sb ~= SB then paintSub(sb, false) end
				end
				for _, p in ipairs(SubContent:GetChildren()) do
					if p:IsA("Frame") then p.Visible = false end
				end
				paintSub(SB, true)
				Page.Visible = true
				activeSubBtn = SB
				if changed and not firstSub then slideIn(Page) end
				if win._lay and win._lay.active and win._lay.subSelected then pcall(win._lay.subSelected) end
			end

			pageOwnerSB[Page] = selectThis
			tabRec.secs[#tabRec.secs + 1] = {
				btn = SB, lbl = SLbl, page = Page, L = L, R = R, wide = Wide, cols = { Lc, Rc },
				select = selectThis, name = sName, tab = tabRec, icon = sIcon,
			}
			layoutDirty()
			SB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(selectThis)
			if not IS_MOBILE then
				SB.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
					if activeSubBtn ~= SB then
						subGlow[SB].hoverOn(true)
						tw(SLbl, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = T.FontDim })
					end
				end)
				SB.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					subGlow[SB].hoverOn(false)
					if activeSubBtn ~= SB then
						tw(SLbl, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = T.FontSub })
					end
				end)
			end

			if firstSub then
				selectThis()
				firstSub = false
			end

			return L, R, Wide
		end

		return newSection
	end

	win._size = sizeVec
	win._layout = layoutWin
	win.Gui = gui
	win._ownGui = opts.Gui == nil
	win._gui = gui
	win.Shell = Shell
	win.Main = Main
	win.Header = Header
	win.Body = Body
	win.Sidebar = Sidebar
	win.Content = Content
	win.SearchBox = SearchBox
	win.Avatar = Avatar
	win.TitleLabel = TitleLbl
	win.SubtitleLabel = VerLbl
	win._setVisible = setVisible

	win.AddTab = colonSafe(win, function(t, o) return newTab(t, nil, o) end)

	win.AddCategory = colonSafe(win, function(text) win._cat = text ~= nil and tostring(text) or nil; layoutDirty(); return win end)
	win.AddSection = win.AddCategory
	win.CreateTab = win.AddTab
	win.Tab = win.AddTab
	win.SetVisible = colonSafe(win, function(v) setVisible(v) return win end)
	win.IsVisible = function() return win._open == true end
	win.Toggle = function() setVisible(not win._open) end
	win.SetTitle = colonSafe(win, function(t) if TitleLbl then TitleLbl.Text = t end return win end)
	win.SetSubtitle = colonSafe(win, function(t) if VerLbl and t ~= nil then composeFooter(t) end return win end)
	win.Footer = Footer
	win.FooterText = FooterText
	win.FooterRight = FooterRight
	win.SetFooter = colonSafe(win, function(l, r)
		if FooterText and type(l) == "string" then composeFooter(l) end
		if FooterRight and type(r) == "string" then FooterRight.Text = r end
		return win
	end)
	win.SetToggleKey = colonSafe(win, function(kc)
		if win._toggleKey then keyedWindows[win._toggleKey] = nil end
		win._toggleKey = kc
		if kc then keyedWindows[kc] = win end
		return win
	end)
	win.GetToggleKey = function() return win._toggleKey end

	win.SetSidebarWidth = colonSafe(win, function(w) if tonumber(w) then applySidebar(tonumber(w)) end return win end)
	win.GetSidebarWidth = function() return sideW end

	win.SetLayout = colonSafe(win, function(n) setLayoutAll(layoutIn(n)) return win end)
	win.GetLayout = function() return layoutOut(SETTINGS.Layout) end
	win.Destroy = function()
		if win._toggleKey then keyedWindows[win._toggleKey] = nil end
		for i = #allWindows, 1, -1 do
			if allWindows[i] == win then table.remove(allWindows, i) end
		end
		pcall(function() SearchPop:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
		reconcileUI()
	end

	allWindows[#allWindows + 1] = win

	win._open = false
	win._lay = newLayoutEngine({
		gui = gui, win = win, Shell = Shell, Main = Main, mainStroke = mainStroke,
		Header = Header, HeaderLine = HeaderLine, VDivider = VDivider, SideGrip = SideGrip,
		TitleArea = TitleArea, TitleLbl = TitleLbl, SearchWrap = SearchWrap, Avatar = Avatar,
		SearchStroke = searchStroke, SearchMag = mag, SearchBox = SearchBox,
		Body = Body, Sidebar = Sidebar, TabList = TabList, tabListLayout = tabListLayout, tabListPad = tabListPad,
		Content = Content, FooterLine = FooterLine, Footer = Footer, FooterText = FooterText, ResizeBtn = ResizeBtn,
		tabs = winTabs, dragCbs = coverCbs, ShellScale = ShellScale, CloseBtn = CloseBtn,
		size = function() return curW, curH end,
		setSize = function(w, h) layoutWin(math.floor(w), math.floor(h)) end,
		side = function() return sideW end,
		selected = function() return selectedTabBtn end,
		clearTabGlow = function()
			for _, glow in pairs(tabGlow) do pcall(glow.select, false, true) end
		end,
		afterApply = function(name)
			win._railsOff = (name == "Vape")
			for _, t in ipairs(winTabs) do
				for _, sr in ipairs(t.secs) do
					for _, col in ipairs(sr.cols) do pcall(col.refresh) end
				end
			end
		end,
		afterReset = function()
			win._railsOff = false
			for _, t in ipairs(winTabs) do if t.fitSub then pcall(t.fitSub) end end
			applySidebar(sideW)
			layoutWin(curW, curH)
			Shell.Visible = win._open == true
			Main.Visible = win._open == true
			for _, t in ipairs(winTabs) do
				local on = t.row == selectedTabBtn
				if t.frame then t.frame.Visible = on end
				local act = t.active and t.active()
				for _, sr in ipairs(t.secs) do
					sr.page.Visible = (sr == act)
					for _, col in ipairs(sr.cols) do pcall(col.refresh) end
				end
				if t.row then
					local g = tabGlow[t.row]
					if g then g.select(on, true) end
					if t.lbl then t.lbl.TextColor3 = on and T.Font or T.FontSub end
				end
			end
		end,
	})

	if opts.ToggleKey then win:SetToggleKey(opts.ToggleKey) end
	if settingsBuilder then pcall(settingsBuilder, win, newTab) end
	if opts.AutoShow and menuShown then setVisible(true) end
	if (SETTINGS.Layout or "Default") ~= "Default" then
		task.defer(function() setLayoutAll(SETTINGS.Layout) end)
	end

	return win
end

end

local function newGroupbox(parent, title, order, gIcon)
	if type(gIcon) == "table" and (gIcon.Icon ~= nil or gIcon.icon ~= nil) then gIcon = gIcon.Icon or gIcon.icon end
	local box = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = order or 0,
		ZIndex = 11,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	}, parent)

	local inner = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = T.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ZIndex = 11,
	}, box)
	corner(RADIUS, inner)
	stroke(1, T.Line, inner)

	local HEAD_H = 32
	local titleLbl = create("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, HEAD_H),
		Font = F_GROUP,
		Text = title,
		TextColor3 = T.Font,
		TextSize = TS_GROUP,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		ZIndex = 12,
	}, inner)
	fontRole[titleLbl] = "group"

	local divider = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = T.Line,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, HEAD_H),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
		ZIndex = 12,
	}, inner)
	local glowLine = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
		ZIndex = 13,
	}, divider)
	GLOW.add("head", create("UIGradient", {
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 0.45),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		}),
	}, glowLine), "grad", "ab", glowLine)
	local glowHalo = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.8,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3),
		ZIndex = 12,
	}, divider)
	GLOW.add("head", create("UIGradient", {
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.5),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		}),
	}, glowHalo), "grad", "ab", glowHalo)

	local glowBloom = create("ImageLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Image = "rbxassetid://18245826428",
		ImageTransparency = 0.82,
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
		SliceCenter = Rect.new(21, 21, 79, 79),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, -12, 0, -12),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 12, 0, 25),
		ZIndex = 12,
	}, divider)
	create("UIGradient", {
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 0.4),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		}),
	}, glowBloom)
	GLOW.add("head", glowBloom, "ImageColor3", nil, glowBloom)
	TweenServ:Create(glowLine, TI_BREATHE, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }):Play()
	TweenServ:Create(glowHalo, TI_BREATHE, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 }):Play()
	glowLine.Visible = GLOW.on("head")
	glowHalo.Visible = GLOW.on("head")

	local body = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, HEAD_H + 1),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ZIndex = 11,
	}, inner)
	create("UIListLayout", {
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 7),
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
	}, body)
	create("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9),
	}, body)

	gbReg[box] = { inner = inner, title = titleLbl, divider = divider, body = body, glows = { glowLine, glowHalo, glowBloom }, headH = HEAD_H, icon = gIcon }
	layoutDirty()

	local winGui = PopupGui

	local S = {}

	function S.addToggle(text, def, cb, ord, extra)
		local st = def or false
		local ROW_H = IS_MOBILE and 28 or 20
		local SW, SH = (IS_MOBILE and 36 or 30), (IS_MOBILE and 20 or 16)
		local KN = SH - 6

		local Row = create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H),
			Text = "",
			LayoutOrder = ord or 0,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			ZIndex = 12,
		}, body)

		local Lbl = create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SW + 10), 1, 0),
			Font = F_BODY,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = st and T.Font or T.FontDim,
			TextSize = TS_BODY,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, Row)

		local Track = create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Track,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SW, SH),
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, Row)
		fullRound(Track)
		local Edge = stroke(1, T.Line, Track)
		Edge.Transparency = st and 1 or 0

		local On = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = st and 0 or 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			ZIndex = 14,
		}, Track)
		fullRound(On)
		regGrad(create("UIGradient", {}, On), "ab")

		local KNOB_OFF = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0)
		local KNOB_ON = UDim2.new(1, -(KN + 3), 0.5, 0)

		local VP = { off = Color3.fromRGB(62, 60, 62), hov = Color3.fromRGB(120, 116, 120) }
		local Knob = create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = st and T.White or T.FontSub,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = st and KNOB_ON or KNOB_OFF,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(KN, KN),
			ZIndex = 15,
		}, Track)
		fullRound(Knob)

		local SwGlow = create("ImageLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = "rbxassetid://18245826428",
			ImageTransparency = st and 0.7 or 1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
			SliceCenter = Rect.new(21, 21, 79, 79),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 10, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SW + 20, SH + 20),
			ZIndex = 12,
		}, Row)
		GLOW.add("check", SwGlow, "ImageColor3", nil, SwGlow)

		local lilPaint
		local TI_SW = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local hovered = false
		local running = {}
		local function play(obj, goal)
			local t = tw(obj, TI_SW, goal)
			if t then running[#running + 1] = t end
		end
		local function upd(instant)
			for _, t in ipairs(running) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
			table.clear(running)
			local vp = curStyle == "Vape"
			local au = curStyle == "Aurelia"
			local goals = {
				{ On, { BackgroundTransparency = st and 0 or 1 } },
				{ Edge, { Transparency = (st or vp) and 1 or 0, Color = hovered and T.LineHi or T.Line } },
				{ Knob, { Position = st and KNOB_ON or KNOB_OFF, BackgroundColor3 = vp and T.Main or (au and (st and T.Main or Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 238)) or (st and T.White or (hovered and T.FontDim or T.FontSub))) } },
				{ Lbl, { TextColor3 = vp and T.FontDim or ((st or hovered) and T.Font or T.FontDim) } },
				{ SwGlow, { ImageTransparency = (st and curStyle ~= "Linoria" and not vp and GLOW.on("check")) and 0.7 or 1 } },
			}
			if vp then
				On.BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent
				goals[#goals + 1] = { Track, { BackgroundColor3 = hovered and VP.hov or VP.off } }
			end
			if lilPaint then lilPaint(instant) end
			for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
				if instant then
					for k, v in pairs(g[2]) do pcall(function() g[1][k] = v end) end
				else
					play(g[1], g[2])
				end
			end
		end

		if not IS_MOBILE then
			Row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hovered = true; upd() end)
			Row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hovered = false; upd() end)
		end

		Row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			st = not st
			upd()
			if cb then pcall(cb, st) end
		end)

		if extra and extra.Tooltip then attachHint(Row, Lbl, extra.Tooltip) end
		searchIndex[#searchIndex + 1] = { text = text, row = Row }

		local trackCorner = Track:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		local onCorner = On:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		local lil

		local WELL_LIL = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 23)
		local TI_LILCB = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		lilPaint = function(instant)
			if not lil or curStyle ~= "Linoria" then return end
			local gF = { Size = st and UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) or UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = st and 0 or 1 }
			local gG = { ImageTransparency = st and 0.75 or 1 }
			if instant then
				for k, v in pairs(gF) do lil.fill[k] = v end
				lil.glow.ImageTransparency = gG.ImageTransparency
			else
				tw(lil.fill, TI_LILCB, gF)
				tw(lil.glow, TI_LILCB, gG)
			end
		end
		local skinLast
		local function skin(style)
			if not Row.Parent then return false end
			local box = style == "Linoria"
			local vape = style == "Vape"
			local au = style == "Aurelia"
			local sk = skinKey(box, vape, au, FX.glow)
			if sk == skinLast then
				if not box and not vape and Track.BackgroundColor3 ~= T.Track then Track.BackgroundColor3 = T.Track end
				if box and lil and lil.well then
					local b = WELL_LIL
					if lil.well.BackgroundColor3 ~= b then lil.well.BackgroundColor3 = b end
				end
				return
			end
			skinLast = sk
			local CB = IS_MOBILE and 14 or 10
			if box and not lil then
				lil = {}
				lil.well = create("Frame", {
					BackgroundColor3 = WELL_LIL,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4),
					ClipsDescendants = true,
					ZIndex = 14,
				}, Track)
				lil.fill = create("Frame", {
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
					ZIndex = 15,
				}, lil.well)
				regGrad(create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90 }, lil.fill), "ab")
				lil.glow = create("ImageLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Image = "rbxassetid://18245826428",
					ImageColor3 = T.Accent,
					ImageTransparency = 1,
					ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
					SliceCenter = Rect.new(21, 21, 79, 79),
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-12, -12),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 24, 1, 24),
					ZIndex = 13,
				}, Track)
				GLOW.add("check", lil.glow, "ImageColor3", nil, function(on)
					if lil and lil.glow then lil.glow.Visible = on and curStyle == "Linoria" end
				end)
			end
			local og = On:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
			if og then og.Enabled = not vape and not au end
						On.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			Lbl.TextSize = vape and 14 or TS_BODY
			if vape then
				KNOB_OFF, KNOB_ON = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
				Knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
			elseif au then
				local k = SH - 4
				KNOB_OFF, KNOB_ON = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, -(k + 2), 0.5, 0)
				Knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(k, k)
			else
				KNOB_OFF, KNOB_ON = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, -(KN + 3), 0.5, 0)
				Knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(KN, KN)
			end
			if vape then
				Track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
				Track.Position = UDim2.new(1, 2, 0.5, 0)
				Track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(IS_MOBILE and 28 or 22, IS_MOBILE and 15 or 12)
				Track.BackgroundColor3 = VP.off
				Lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 1, 0)
				Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 30 or 26)
			elseif box then
				Track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
				Track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0.5, 0)
				Track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CB, CB)
				Track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8)
				Lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, CB + 9, 0, 0)
				Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(CB + 9), 1, 0)
				Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 26 or 14)
			else
				Track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
				Track.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
				Track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SW, SH)
				Track.BackgroundColor3 = T.Track
				Lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SW + 10), 1, 0)
				Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, au and (IS_MOBILE and 28 or 22) or ROW_H)
			end
			SwGlow.ImageTransparency = (st and not box and not vape and GLOW.on("check")) and 0.7 or 1
			Knob.Visible = not box
			On.Visible = not box
			Edge.Enabled = not box and not vape
			if lil then
				lil.well.Visible = box
				if box then
					if VKDB then print("SKINRUN", style, curStyle, tostring(lil ~= nil), sk == skinLast) end
					lil.well.BackgroundColor3 = WELL_LIL
					Track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8)
				end
				lil.glow.Visible = box and GLOW.on("check")
				if box then lilPaint(true) else lil.glow.ImageTransparency = 1 end
			end
			local cr = box and UDim.new(0, 0) or UDim.new(1, 0)
			if trackCorner then trackCorner.CornerRadius = cr end
			if onCorner then onCorner.CornerRadius = cr end
			upd(true)
		end
		onAccent(function() if curStyle == "Vape" and Row.Parent then On.BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent end end)
		skinners[#skinners + 1] = skin
		if curStyle ~= "Default" then skin(curStyle) end

		return {
			set = function(v) st = v; upd(); if cb then pcall(cb, st) end end,
			silent = function(v) st = v; upd() end,
			get = function() return st end,
			row = Row,
			label = Lbl,
			_p = { Track = Track, On = On, Knob = Knob },
		}
	end

	function S.addSlider(text, mn, mx, def, cb, ord, dec, extra)
		dec = dec or 0
		extra = extra or {}
		local prefix = tostring(extra.Prefix or "")
		local suffix = tostring(extra.Suffix or "")
		local factor = 10 ^ dec
		local iMn = math.floor(mn * factor + 0.5)
		local iMx = math.floor(mx * factor + 0.5)
		local ival = math.clamp(math.floor((def or mn) * factor + 0.5), iMn, iMx)

		local function realVal() return ival / factor end
		local function fmtVal()
			local s = dec > 0 and string.format("%." .. dec .. "f", realVal()) or tostring(ival)
			return prefix .. s .. suffix
		end

		local ROW_H = IS_MOBILE and 46 or 40
		local TRACK_H = IS_MOBILE and 18 or 14
		local HIT_PAD = IS_MOBILE and 16 or 8

		local F = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H),
			LayoutOrder = ord or 0,
			ZIndex = 12,
		}, body)

		local Lbl = create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 14),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
			Font = F_BODY,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, F)

		local focusEditing = false
		local Val = create("TextBox", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 14),
			Font = F_MONO,
			Text = fmtVal(),
			TextColor3 = T.Font,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
			ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, F)

		local TrackOuter = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.LineDark,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TRACK_H),
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, F)

		local Track = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Track,
			BorderSizePixel = 1,
			BorderColor3 = T.Line,
			BorderMode = Enum.BorderMode.Inset,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			ZIndex = 14,
		}, TrackOuter)

		local ratio0 = (iMx > iMn) and (ival - iMn) / (iMx - iMn) or 0

		local Fill = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
			ZIndex = 15,
		}, Track)
		regGrad(create("UIGradient", {
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.22, 0.12),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 0.08),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.3),
			}),
		}, Fill), "aba")

		local Hit = create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, -HIT_PAD, 0, 22 - HIT_PAD / 2),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, HIT_PAD * 2, 0, TRACK_H + HIT_PAD),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
			ZIndex = 16,
		}, F)

		local TI_DRAG = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local dragging = false
		local function render(instant)
			local r = (iMx > iMn) and (ival - iMn) / (iMx - iMn) or 0
			local goal = UDim2.new(r, 0, 1, 0)
			if instant then
				Fill.Size = goal
			else

				tw(Fill, dragging and TI_DRAG or TI_SELECT, { Size = goal })
			end
			if not focusEditing then Val.Text = fmtVal() end
		end
		render()
		local hovering = false
		local function setLit()
			tw(Lbl, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = (hovering or dragging) and T.Font or T.FontDim })
		end
		if not IS_MOBILE then
			Hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hovering = true; setLit() end)
			Hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hovering = false; setLit() end)
		end

		local function setFromX(absX)
			local tw_ = Track.AbsoluteSize.X
			if tw_ <= 0 then return end
			local r = math.clamp((absX - Track.AbsolutePosition.X) / tw_, 0, 1)
			local niv = math.clamp(math.floor((iMx - iMn) * r + iMn + 0.5), iMn, iMx)
			if niv ~= ival then
				ival = niv
				render()
				if cb then pcall(cb, realVal()) end
			end
		end

		local activeInput
		Hit.InputBegan:Connect(DRAG.gate(Hit, function(i)
			if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if activeInput then return end
			activeInput = i
			dragging = true
			setLit()
			setFromX(i.Position.X)
			local mc, ec
			mc = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
				if inp == activeInput or (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and activeInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
					setFromX(inp.Position.X)
				end
			end)
			ec = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
				if inp == activeInput or (activeInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
					if mc then mc:Disconnect() end
					if ec then ec:Disconnect() end
					activeInput = nil
					dragging = false
					setLit()
				end
			end)
		end))

		Val.Focused:Connect(function()
			if dragging then
				pcall(function() Val:ReleaseFocus() end)
				return
			end
			focusEditing = true
			Val.Text = tostring(realVal())
			Val.TextColor3 = T.Accent
		end)
		Val.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			if not focusEditing then return end
			focusEditing = false
			local n = tonumber(Val.Text)
			if n then
				ival = math.clamp(math.floor(n * factor + 0.5), iMn, iMx)
				if cb then pcall(cb, realVal()) end
			end
			Val.TextColor3 = T.Font
			render()
		end)
		local function silSet(v)
			ival = math.clamp(math.floor((v or mn) * factor + 0.5), iMn, iMx)
			render()
		end

		if extra.Tooltip then attachHint(F, Lbl, extra.Tooltip) end
		searchIndex[#searchIndex + 1] = { text = text, row = F }

		local fillGrad = Fill:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
		local fillTr = fillGrad and fillGrad.Transparency
		local lil
		local function step(d)
			local niv = math.clamp(ival + d, iMn, iMx)
			if niv ~= ival then
				ival = niv
				render()
				if cb then pcall(cb, realVal()) end
			end
		end
		local function stepBtn(txt, x, ax)
			local b = create("TextButton", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0, 13),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(IS_MOBILE and 18 or 12, IS_MOBILE and 18 or 14),
				Font = F_BODY,
				Text = txt,
				TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
				TextSize = 12,
				TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Visible = false,
				ZIndex = 17,
			}, F)
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() step(txt == "+" and 1 or -1) end)
			if not IS_MOBILE then
				b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(b, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = T.Font }) end)
				b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(b, TI_HOVER, { TextColor3 = T.FontDim }) end)
			end
			return b
		end
		local skinLast
		local ak
		local vk

		local TRACK_LIL = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 23)
		local function skin(style)
			if not F.Parent then return false end
			local on = style == "Linoria"
			local vape = style == "Vape"
			local au = style == "Aurelia"
			local sk = skinKey(on, vape, au, FX.glow)
			if sk == skinLast then
				if on and lil and Track.BackgroundColor3 ~= (TRACK_LIL) then
					Track.BackgroundColor3 = TRACK_LIL
				end
				if not on and not vape and not au then
					if TrackOuter.BackgroundColor3 ~= T.LineDark then TrackOuter.BackgroundColor3 = T.LineDark end
					if Track.BackgroundColor3 ~= T.Track then Track.BackgroundColor3 = T.Track end
				end
				return
			end
			skinLast = sk
			if on and not lil then
				lil = { minus = stepBtn("-", 0, 0), plus = stepBtn("+", 1, 1) }
				lil.glow = create("ImageLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Image = "rbxassetid://18245826428",
					ImageColor3 = T.Accent,
					ImageTransparency = 0.9,
					ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
					SliceCenter = Rect.new(21, 21, 79, 79),
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-18, -18),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 36, 1, 36),
					Visible = false,
					ZIndex = 14,
				}, Fill)
				regAccent(lil.glow, "ImageColor3")
			end
			local BAR = IS_MOBILE and 14 or 10
			local SIDE = IS_MOBILE and 22 or 15

			if vape and not vk then
				vk = {}
				vk.hold = create("Frame", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					BackgroundColor3 = T.Card,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 4),
					ZIndex = 16,
				}, Fill)
				vk.knob = create("Frame", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(IS_MOBILE and 18 or 14, IS_MOBILE and 18 or 14),
					ZIndex = 17,
				}, vk.hold)
				fullRound(vk.knob)
				onAccent(function()
					if not F.Parent then return end
					vk.knob.BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent
					if curStyle == "Vape" then Fill.BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent end
				end)
			end
			if vk then
				vk.hold.Visible = vape
				vk.hold.BackgroundColor3 = T.Card
				vk.knob.BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent
			end

			if au and not ak then
				ak = {}
				local function raw(cls, props, parent)
					local o = Instance.new(cls)
					for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
					o.Parent = parent
					return o
				end
				ak.knob = raw("Frame", {
					Name = "_auKnob", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
					BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(IS_MOBILE and 16 or 12, IS_MOBILE and 16 or 12), ZIndex = 17,
				}, Fill)
				raw("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, ak.knob)
				ak.cTrack = raw("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) }, TrackOuter)
				ak.cFill = raw("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) }, Fill)
				ak.pad = raw("UIPadding", {}, Val)
				ak.cVal = raw("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) }, Val)
				ak.sVal = raw("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Enabled = false, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, Val)
			end
			if ak then
				local r = au and UDim.new(1, 0) or UDim.new(0, 0)
				ak.knob.Visible = au
				ak.cTrack.CornerRadius = r
				ak.cFill.CornerRadius = r
				ak.cVal.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, au and 4 or 0)
				ak.sVal.Enabled = au
				ak.sVal.Color = T.CtlEdge
				ak.pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, au and 6 or 0)
				ak.pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, au and 6 or 0)
			end
			Val.AutomaticSize = au and Enum.AutomaticSize.X or Enum.AutomaticSize.None
			Val.BackgroundTransparency = au and 0 or 1
			if au then Val.BackgroundColor3 = T.Container end
			if fillGrad then fillGrad.Enabled = not vape and not au end
			if fillGrad and fillTr and not on then fillGrad.Transparency = fillTr end
						Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			Track.BackgroundTransparency = (vape or au) and 1 or 0
			Lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, vape and 7 or 0)
			Val.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, vape and 7 or 0)
			Lbl.TextSize = vape and 11 or 13
			Val.TextSize = (vape or au) and 11 or 12
			Val.TextColor3 = vape and T.FontDim or T.Font
			if au then
				F.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 44 or 38)
				Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 18)
				Val.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18)
				TrackOuter.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 27)
				TrackOuter.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 8 or 6)
				TrackOuter.BackgroundColor3 = T.Element
				Track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
				Track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
				Track.BorderSizePixel = 0
				Track.BackgroundColor3 = T.Track
				Track.ClipsDescendants = false
				Hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, -6, 0, 20)
				Hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 12, 0, 20)
			elseif vape then
				F.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 50 or 44)
				Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 14)
				Val.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 14)
				TrackOuter.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 31)
				TrackOuter.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)
				TrackOuter.BackgroundColor3 = T.Element
				Track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
				Track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
				Track.BorderSizePixel = 0
				Track.ClipsDescendants = false
				Hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, -6, 0, 18)
				Hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 12, 0, 26)
			elseif on then
				F.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 36 or 27)
				Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 12)
				Val.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 12)
				TrackOuter.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDE, 0, 15)
				TrackOuter.Size = UDim2.new(1, -SIDE * 2, 0, BAR)
				TrackOuter.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8)
				Track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
				Track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4)
				Track.BorderSizePixel = 0
				Track.BackgroundColor3 = TRACK_LIL
				Track.ClipsDescendants = false
				Hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDE - 4, 0, 15 - HIT_PAD / 2)
				Hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SIDE - 4) * 2, 0, BAR + HIT_PAD)
				if fillGrad then fillGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0) end
				lil.minus.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 15 + BAR / 2 - (IS_MOBILE and 9 or 7))
				lil.plus.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15 + BAR / 2 - (IS_MOBILE and 9 or 7))
			else
				F.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H)
				Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 14)
				Val.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 14)
				TrackOuter.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
				TrackOuter.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TRACK_H)
				TrackOuter.BackgroundColor3 = T.LineDark
				Track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1)
				Track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2)
				Track.BorderSizePixel = 1
				Track.BackgroundColor3 = T.Track
				Track.ClipsDescendants = true
				Hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, -HIT_PAD, 0, 22 - HIT_PAD / 2)
				Hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, HIT_PAD * 2, 0, TRACK_H + HIT_PAD)
				if fillGrad and fillTr then fillGrad.Transparency = fillTr end
			end
			if lil then
				lil.minus.Visible = on
				lil.plus.Visible = on
				lil.glow.Visible = on and FX.glow
			end
		end
		skinners[#skinners + 1] = skin
		if curStyle ~= "Default" then skin(curStyle) end

		return {
			row = F,
			label = Lbl,
			set = function(v) silSet(v); if cb then pcall(cb, realVal()) end end,
			silent = silSet,
			get = function() return realVal() end,
			_p = { Track = Track, TrackOuter = TrackOuter, Fill = Fill, Val = Val },
		}
	end

	function S.addDropdown(text, opts, def, cb, ord, multi, extra)
		local sel = def or opts[1] or ""
        local chosen={}
        local function normalize(value)
            table.clear(chosen)
            if type(value)=='table' then
                for k,v in pairs(value) do
                    local name=type(k)=='number' and v or (v==true and k or nil)
                    if name and table.find(opts,name) then chosen[name]=true end
                end
            end
        end
        local function selectedValues()
            local list={}
            for _,name in ipairs(opts) do if chosen[name] then table.insert(list,name) end end
            return list
        end
        local function displayValue()
            if not multi then return tostring(sel) end
            local values=selectedValues()
            return #values>0 and table.concat(values,', ') or 'None'
        end
        if multi then normalize(def) end
		local W2 = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 48 or 42),
			LayoutOrder = ord or 0,
			ZIndex = 12,
		}, body)

		local DLbl = create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
			Font = F_BODY,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
			TextSize = TS_BODY,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, W2)

		local DB = create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 30 or 24),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, W2)

		local DBInner = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Element,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
			ZIndex = 14,
		}, DB)
		corner(RADIUS, DBInner)
		local DBStroke = stroke(1, T.CtlEdge, DBInner)

		local DBText = create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0),
			Font = F_BODY,
			Text = displayValue(),
			TextColor3 = T.Font,
			TextSize = TS_SMALL,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 15,
		}, DBInner)

		local chev = triDown(DBInner, T.FontDim, 16)
		chev.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		chev.Position = UDim2.new(1, -9, 0.5, 0)

		local ITEM_H = IS_MOBILE and 28 or 24
		local function popH() return math.min(#opts, 6) * ITEM_H + 6 end

		local DS = create("Frame", {
			Active = true,
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Background,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, popH()),
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 300,
		}, winGui)
		corner(RADIUS, DS)
		stroke(1, T.Line, DS)

		local DSInner = create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Active = true,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6),
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, ITEM_H * #opts),
			ScrollBarThickness = IS_MOBILE and 3 or 2,
			ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.LineHi,
			ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
			ZIndex = 301,
			TopImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			BottomImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			ClipsDescendants = true,
		}, DS)
		create("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, DSInner)

		local items = {}
		local isOpen = false

		local function closeDD()
			if not isOpen then return end
			DS.Visible = false
			isOpen = false
			DSInner.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			tw(chev, TI_FAST, { Rotation = 0 })
			tw(DBStroke, TI_FAST, { Color = T.CtlEdge })
			openDropdowns[closeDD] = nil
		end

		local function openDD()
			closeAllDropdowns()
			local bp = DB.AbsolutePosition
			local bs = DB.AbsoluteSize
			local h = popH()
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local vpX = cam and cam.ViewportSize.X or 1920
			local vpY = cam and cam.ViewportSize.Y or 1080
			local px = math.clamp(bp.X, 8, vpX - bs.X - 8)
			local belowY = bp.Y + bs.Y + 4
			if belowY + h > vpY - 8 then
				belowY = math.max(8, bp.Y - h - 3)
			end
			DS.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, belowY)
			DS.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bs.X, h)
			DS.Visible = true
			isOpen = true
			tw(chev, TI_FAST, { Rotation = 180 })
			tw(DBStroke, TI_FAST, { Color = curStyle == "Aurelia" and T.LineHi or T.Accent })
			openDropdowns[closeDD] = true
		end

		local lastDDToggle = -1
		local function toggleDD()
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastDDToggle < 0.25 then return end
			lastDDToggle = now
			if isOpen then closeDD() else openDD() end
		end

		DB.InputBegan:Connect(DRAG.gate(DB, function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then toggleDD() end
		end))
		DB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleDD)
		if not IS_MOBILE then
			DB.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(DBInner, TI_FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = T.ElementHover }) end)
			DB.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(DBInner, TI_FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = T.Element }) end)
		end

		hook(UIS.InputBegan, function(inp)
			if not isOpen then return end
			if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local pos = inp.Position
			local function inside(g)
				local p, s = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize
				return pos.X >= p.X and pos.X <= p.X + s.X and pos.Y >= p.Y and pos.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
			end
			if not inside(DS) and not inside(DB) then closeDD() end
		end)

		local function markSel()
			for _, it in ipairs(items) do
				local isSel = multi and chosen[it.value]==true or (not multi and it.value==sel)
				it.check.Visible = isSel
				it.label.TextColor3 = isSel and T.Font or T.FontDim
			end
		end

		local function buildOpts()
			items = {}
			for _, opt in ipairs(opts) do
				local OB = create("TextButton", {
					BackgroundColor3 = T.ElementHover,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ITEM_H),
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					Text = "",
					ZIndex = 301,
				}, DSInner)
				corner(RADIUS - 1, OB)
				local check, checkImg = icon(OB, "check", 11, T.Accent, 303)
				check.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
				check.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0)
				check.Visible = (multi and chosen[opt]==true or (not multi and opt==sel))
				regAccent(checkImg, "ImageColor3")
				local txt = create("TextLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0),
					Font = F_BODY,
					Text = opt,
					TextColor3 = (multi and chosen[opt]==true or (not multi and opt==sel)) and T.Font or T.FontDim,
					TextSize = TS_SMALL,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
					ZIndex = 303,
				}, OB)
				items[#items + 1] = { value = opt, btn = OB, label = txt, check = check }

				if not IS_MOBILE then
					OB.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(OB, TI_FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }) end)
					OB.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(OB, TI_FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
				end
				OB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if multi then chosen[opt]=not chosen[opt] or nil else sel=opt end
                    DBText.Text=displayValue()
                    markSel()
                    if not multi then closeDD() end
                    if cb then pcall(cb,multi and selectedValues() or sel) end
				end)
			end
		end
		buildOpts()

		if extra and extra.Tooltip then attachHint(W2, DLbl, extra.Tooltip) end
		searchIndex[#searchIndex + 1] = { text = text, row = W2 }

		local lilPM
		local skinLast

		local DBIN_LIL = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 39)
		local function ddSkin(style)
			if not W2.Parent then return false end
			local on = style == "Linoria"
			local sk = skinKey(on)
			if sk == skinLast then
				local tc = on and T.FontDim or T.Font
				if DBText.TextColor3 ~= tc then DBText.TextColor3 = tc end
				if not on and DBInner.BackgroundColor3 ~= T.Element then DBInner.BackgroundColor3 = T.Element end
				if on then
					local b = DBIN_LIL
					if DBInner.BackgroundColor3 ~= b then DBInner.BackgroundColor3 = b end
				end
				return
			end
			skinLast = sk
			if on and not lilPM then
				lilPM = create("TextLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, 0),
					Font = F_BODY,
					Text = DS.Visible and "-" or "+",
					TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
					Visible = false,
					ZIndex = 16,
				}, DBInner)
				DS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					lilPM.Text = DS.Visible and "-" or "+"
				end)
			end
			local BOX = IS_MOBILE and 28 or 20
			if on then
				W2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14 + BOX)
				DLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
				DB.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 14)
				DB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, BOX)
				DB.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				DB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8)
				DBInner.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
				DBInner.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4)
				DBInner.BackgroundColor3 = DBIN_LIL
				DBText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
				DBText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 1, 0)
				DBText.TextColor3 = T.FontDim
			else
				W2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 48 or 42)
				DLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
				DB.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
				DB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 30 or 24)
				DB.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				DBInner.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1)
				DBInner.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2)
				DBInner.BackgroundColor3 = T.Element
				DBText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 0)
				DBText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
				DBText.TextColor3 = T.Font
			end
			DBStroke.Enabled = not on
			chev.Visible = not on
			if lilPM then lilPM.Visible = on end
		end
		skinners[#skinners + 1] = ddSkin
		if curStyle ~= "Default" then ddSkin(curStyle) end

		return {
			row = W2,
			label = DLbl,
			_p = { W2 = W2, DB = DB, DBInner = DBInner, DBText = DBText, chev = chev },
			set = function(v) if v==nil then return end;if multi then normalize(v)else sel=v end;DBText.Text=displayValue();markSel();if cb then pcall(cb,multi and selectedValues() or sel)end end,
			silent = function(v)if v==nil then return end;if multi then normalize(v)else sel=v end;DBText.Text=displayValue();markSel()end,
			get = function() return multi and selectedValues() or sel end,
			values = function() return opts end,
			multi = multi,
			refresh = function(newOpts)
				opts = newOpts
				for _, it in ipairs(items) do pcall(function() it.btn:Destroy() end) end
				items = {}
				DS.Size = UDim2.new(DS.Size.X.Scale, DS.Size.X.Offset, 0, popH())
                DSInner.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
				DSInner.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, ITEM_H * #opts)
				buildOpts()
                DBText.Text=displayValue()
                markSel()
			end,
		}
	end

	function S.addPlayerList(text, def, cb, ord)
		if type(def) ~= "table" then def = {} end
		local sel = {}
		for _, v in ipairs(def) do
			if v ~= "None" and v ~= "" then sel[v] = true end
		end

		local PANEL_H = IS_MOBILE and 96 or 80
		local W2 = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, PANEL_H + 18),
			LayoutOrder = ord or 0,
			ZIndex = 12,
		}, body)

		create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
			Font = F_BODY,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
			TextSize = TS_BODY,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, W2)

		local Panel = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, PANEL_H),
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, W2)

		local PanelInner = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Element,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, Panel)
		corner(RADIUS, PanelInner)
		stroke(1, T.Line, PanelInner)
		create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 3), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 3), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 3), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3) }, PanelInner)

		local Scroll = create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Active = true,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			ScrollBarThickness = IS_MOBILE and 3 or 1,
			ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.LineHi,
			ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			TopImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			BottomImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			ZIndex = 14,
		}, PanelInner)
		create("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 1) }, Scroll)

		local function getFlat()
			local f = {}
			for k, v in pairs(sel) do
				if v then f[#f + 1] = k end
			end
			return f
		end

		local ROW_H = IS_MOBILE and 24 or 20
		local function buildRows(pl)
			for _, ch in ipairs(Scroll:GetChildren()) do
				if ch:IsA("TextButton") or ch:IsA("TextLabel") then ch:Destroy() end
			end
			if #pl == 0 then
				create("TextLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H),
					Font = F_BODY,
					Text = "  refresh to load",
					TextColor3 = T.FontSub,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					ZIndex = 15,
				}, Scroll)
				return
			end
			for i, name in ipairs(pl) do
				local isSel = sel[name] or false
				local Row = create("TextButton", {
					BackgroundColor3 = T.ElementHover,
					BackgroundTransparency = isSel and 0 or 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H),
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					Text = "",
					LayoutOrder = i,
					ZIndex = 14,
				}, Scroll)
				corner(RADIUS - 1, Row)
				local Mark = create("Frame", {
					BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -8),
					Visible = isSel,
					ZIndex = 15,
				}, Row)
				regAccent(Mark, "BackgroundColor3")
				local Txt = create("TextLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -13, 1, 0),
					Font = F_BODY,
					Text = name,
					TextColor3 = isSel and T.Font or T.FontDim,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
					ZIndex = 15,
				}, Row)
				if not IS_MOBILE then
					Row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
						Row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
					end)
					Row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
						local s3 = sel[name] and true or false
						Row.BackgroundTransparency = s3 and 0 or 1
					end)
				end
				Row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					sel[name] = not sel[name]
					local s2 = sel[name]
					Mark.Visible = s2
					Txt.TextColor3 = s2 and T.Font or T.FontDim
					Row.BackgroundTransparency = s2 and 0 or 1
					if cb then pcall(cb, getFlat()) end
				end)
			end
		end
		buildRows({})

		return {
			set = function(v)
				sel = {}
				if type(v) == "table" then
					for _, x in ipairs(v) do
						if x ~= "None" and x ~= "" then sel[x] = true end
					end
				end
			end,
			silent = function(v)
				sel = {}
				if type(v) == "table" then
					for _, x in ipairs(v) do
						if x ~= "None" and x ~= "" then sel[x] = true end
					end
				end
			end,
			refresh = buildRows,
			get = getFlat,
		}
	end

	local function kbText(k)
		if curStyle == "Aurelia" then return k and k.Name or "none" end
		return k and ("[" .. k.Name .. "]") or "[ none ]"
	end
	function S.addKeybind(text, def, cb, ord)
		local key = def
		local binding = false

		local Row = create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 26 or 24),
			Text = "",
			LayoutOrder = ord or 0,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			ZIndex = 12,
		}, body)

		create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1, 0),
			Font = F_BODY,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
			TextSize = TS_BODY,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, Row)

		local KP = create("TextButton", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Element,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),

			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, IS_MOBILE and 22 or 18),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			Font = F_MONO,
			Text = kbText(key),
			TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
			TextSize = TS_SMALL,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, Row)
		corner(RADIUS, KP)
		create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) }, KP)
		local KPStroke = stroke(1, T.CtlEdge, KP)
		skinners[#skinners + 1] = function()
			KP.Text = kbText(key)
			return true
		end

		local lastKBToggle = -1
		local function startBinding()
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastKBToggle < 0.25 then return end
			lastKBToggle = now
			if binding then return end
			if IS_MOBILE then
				key = nil
				KP.Text = kbText(nil)
				if cb then pcall(cb, nil) end
				notif("info: keybinds disabled on mobile", 2.5, T.Amber)
				return
			end
			binding = true
			bindingKey = true
			KP.Text = "[ ... ]"
			KP.TextColor3 = T.Accent
			KPStroke.Color = T.Accent
			local cn
			cn = hook(UIS.InputBegan, function(inp)
				if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
					binding = false
					bindingKey = false
					if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape or inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
						key = nil
						KP.Text = kbText(nil)
					else
						key = inp.KeyCode
						KP.Text = kbText(key)
					end
					KP.TextColor3 = T.FontDim
					KPStroke.Color = T.CtlEdge
					if cb then pcall(cb, key) end
					cn:Disconnect()
				end
			end)
		end

		KP.InputBegan:Connect(DRAG.gate(KP, function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then startBinding() end
		end))
		KP.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startBinding)
		local _mode = "Toggle"
		local function _showModeMenu()
			-- Walk up to the ScreenGui so AbsolutePosition coords are correct
			local _sg = KP
			while _sg and not _sg:IsA("ScreenGui") do _sg = _sg.Parent end
			if not _sg then return end
			-- Destroy any existing mode menu first
			local existing = _sg:FindFirstChild("_KBModeMenu")
			if existing then existing:Destroy() end
			local ap = KP.AbsolutePosition
			local asz = KP.AbsoluteSize
			local menu = Instance.new("Frame")
			menu.Name = "_KBModeMenu"
			menu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 76)
			menu.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ap.X, ap.Y + asz.Y + 2)
			menu.BackgroundColor3 = T.Background
			menu.BorderSizePixel = 0
			menu.ZIndex = 200
			menu.Parent = _sg
			Instance.new("UICorner", menu).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, RADIUS)
			local us = Instance.new("UIStroke", menu)
			us.Color = T.Line
			us.Thickness = 1
			local modes = {"Toggle","Hold","Always"}
			for i, m in ipairs(modes) do
				local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", menu)
				btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22)
				btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, (i-1)*24 + 4)
				btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				btn.Text = (_mode == m and "● " or "  ") .. m
				btn.TextColor3 = _mode == m and T.Accent or T.FontDim
				btn.TextSize = 12
				btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
				btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				btn.ZIndex = 201
				local bm = m
				btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					_mode = bm
					menu:Destroy()
				end)
				btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() btn.TextColor3 = T.Font end)
				btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					btn.TextColor3 = _mode == bm and T.Accent or T.FontDim
				end)
			end
			-- Close when clicking outside
			local conn
			conn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
				if gp then return end
				if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return end
				task.defer(function()
					if not menu.Parent then return end
					local mp = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
					local mpos = menu.AbsolutePosition
					local msz  = menu.AbsoluteSize
					if mp.X < mpos.X or mp.X > mpos.X + msz.X
					or mp.Y < mpos.Y or mp.Y > mpos.Y + msz.Y then
						menu:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end)
			menu.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if not menu.Parent then conn:Disconnect() end
			end)
		end
		-- Right-click the KP button (TextButton) to open mode menu
		KP.MouseButton2Click:Connect(_showModeMenu)
		searchIndex[#searchIndex + 1] = { text = text, row = Row }

		return {
			row = Row,
			_p = { KP = KP },
			set = function(v)
				key = v
				KP.Text = kbText(key)
				refreshKeybindsHUD()
				if cb then pcall(cb, key) end
			end,
			silent = function(v)
				key = v
				KP.Text = kbText(key)
			end,
			get = function() return key end,
		}
	end

	function S.addColorPicker(text, default, callback, _previewType, ord)
		local color = default or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local ch, cs, cv = Color3.toHSV(color)

		local Row = create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 26 or 24),
			Text = "",
			LayoutOrder = ord or 0,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			ZIndex = 12,
		}, body)

		create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0),
			Font = F_BODY,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
			TextSize = TS_BODY,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, Row)

		local PreviewOuter = create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 18),
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, Row)
		local Preview = create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundColor3 = color,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
			ZIndex = 14,
		}, PreviewOuter)
		corner(RADIUS, Preview)
		stroke(1, T.Line, Preview)

		local CF = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Background,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(204, 230),
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 400,
		}, winGui)
		corner(RADIUS, CF)
		stroke(1, T.Line, CF)

		local CFS = create("Frame", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			ZIndex = 400,
		}, CF)

			return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
		end

			color = Color3.fromHSV(ch, cs, cv)
			Preview.BackgroundColor3 = color
