			CM.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(ch, 1, 1)
			CP.Position = UDim2.new(cs, 0, 1 - cv, 0)
			HP.Position = UDim2.new(0, -2, ch, -1)
		end

		local function updPicker()
			renderPicker()
			if callback then pcall(callback, color) end
		end

		local function attachDrag(btn, onMove)
			local active
			btn.InputBegan:Connect(DRAG.gate(btn, function(i)
				if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
				if active then return end
				active = i
				onMove(i.Position)
				local mc, ec
				mc = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
					if inp == active or (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
						onMove(inp.Position)
					end
				end)
				ec = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
					if inp == active or (active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
						if mc then mc:Disconnect() end
						if ec then ec:Disconnect() end
						active = nil
					end
				end)
			end))
		end

		attachDrag(CM, function(pos)
			local ap, sz = CM.AbsolutePosition, CM.AbsoluteSize
			cs = math.clamp((pos.X - ap.X) / sz.X, 0, 1)
			cv = 1 - math.clamp((pos.Y - ap.Y) / sz.Y, 0, 1)
			updPicker()
		end)
		attachDrag(HB, function(pos)
			local ap, sz = HB.AbsolutePosition, HB.AbsoluteSize
			ch = math.clamp((pos.Y - ap.Y) / sz.Y, 0, 1)
			updPicker()
		end)

		local function closePicker()
			if not CF.Visible then return end
			CF.Visible = false
			openPickers[closePicker] = nil
		end

		local function openPicker()
			closeAllPickers()
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
			local bp = Preview.AbsolutePosition
			local bs = Preview.AbsoluteSize
			local px = math.clamp(bp.X + bs.X + 8, 8, vp.X - 212)
			local py = math.clamp(bp.Y - 24, 8, vp.Y - 238)
			CF.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py)
			CF.Visible = true
			openPickers[closePicker] = true
		end

		local lastPkTgl = -1
		local function togglePicker()
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastPkTgl < 0.25 then return end
			lastPkTgl = now
			if CF.Visible then closePicker() else openPicker() end
		end

		Preview.InputBegan:Connect(DRAG.gate(Preview, function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then togglePicker() end
		end))
		Preview.MouseButton1Click:Connect(togglePicker)

		hook(UIS.InputBegan, function(inp)
			if not CF.Visible then return end
			if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local pos = inp.Position
			local function inside(g)
				local p, s = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize
				return pos.X >= p.X and pos.X <= p.X + s.X and pos.Y >= p.Y and pos.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
			end
			if not inside(CF) and not inside(Preview) then closePicker() end
		end)

		updPicker()
		searchIndex[#searchIndex + 1] = { text = text, row = Row }

		return {
			row = Row,
			_p = { PreviewOuter = PreviewOuter },
			set = function(cl)
				if cl == nil then return end
				color = cl
				ch, cs, cv = Color3.toHSV(cl)
				updPicker()
			end,
			silent = function(cl)
				if cl == nil then return end
				color = cl
				ch, cs, cv = Color3.toHSV(cl)
				renderPicker()
			end,
			get = function() return color end,
		}
	end

	function S.addButton(text, cb, ord)
		local B = create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, IS_MOBILE and 28 or 22),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
			LayoutOrder = ord or 0,
			ZIndex = 12,
		}, body)
		local BI = create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundColor3 = T.Element,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
			Font = F_MED,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = T.FontDim,
			TextSize = TS_BODY,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 13,
		}, B)
		corner(RADIUS, BI)
		local BStroke = stroke(1, T.CtlEdge, BI)
		if not IS_MOBILE then
			B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				tw(BStroke, TI_FAST, { Color = curStyle == "Aurelia" and T.LineHi or T.Accent })
				tw(BI, TI_FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = T.ElementHover, TextColor3 = T.Font })
			end)
			B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				tw(BStroke, TI_FAST, { Color = T.CtlEdge })
				tw(BI, TI_FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = T.Element, TextColor3 = T.FontDim })
			end)
		end
		B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			tw(BI, TI_FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = T.AccentDim })
			task.delay(0.14, function() tw(BI, TI_MED, { BackgroundColor3 = T.Element }) end)
			if cb then pcall(cb) end
		end)
		searchIndex[#searchIndex + 1] = { text = text, row = B }
		return B
	end

			tw(TB, TI_FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = T.Element })

	do

				S["add" .. kind] = function(...)

					gbr.ctrls[#gbr.ctrls + 1] = { kind = kind, a = table.pack(...), el = el }
					THEME.creg = (THEME.creg or 0) + 1

				end
			end
		end
	end

	S.AddToggle = colonSafe(S, function(text, def, cb, ord)
		local el, userCb
		if type(def) == "table" and cb == nil then
			userCb = def.Callback
			el = S.addToggle(text, def.Default, function(v)
				if userCb then pcall(userCb, v) end
				refreshKeybindsHUD()
			end, def.Order, def)
		else
			el = S.addToggle(text, def, function(v)
				if cb then pcall(cb, v) end
				refreshKeybindsHUD()
			end, ord)
		end
		local h = libHandle(el)
		if type(def) == "table" then
			regFlag(def.Flag, h, "toggle", def.Default)
			if def.Active then
				local label = (type(def.Active) == "string") and def.Active or text
				activeReg[#activeReg + 1] = { label = label, getState = function() return h:Get() end }
				refreshKeybindsHUD()
			end
		end
		return h
	end)

		if type(mn) == "table" and mx == nil then
			local o = mn
			local el = S.addSlider(text, o.Min or 0, o.Max or 100, o.Default or o.Min or 0, o.Callback, o.Order, o.Decimals or o.Rounding or 0, o)
			local h = libHandle(el)
			regFlag(o.Flag, h, "slider", o.Default)
			return h
		end
		return libHandle(S.addSlider(text, mn, mx, def, cb, ord, dec))
	end)

	S.AddDropdown = colonSafe(S, function(text, opts, def, cb, ord)
		if type(opts) == "table" and def == nil then

			local h = libHandle(el)
			regFlag(o.Flag, h, "dropdown", o.Default)
			return h
		end
		return libHandle(S.addDropdown(text, opts, def, cb, ord))
	end)

	S.AddKeybind = colonSafe(S, function(text, def, cb, ord)
		local fn, el
		if type(def) == "table" and cb == nil then
			fn = def.Callback
			el = S.addKeybind(text, def.Default, def.Callback, def.Order)
		else
			fn = cb
			el = S.addKeybind(text, def, cb, ord)
		end
		local h = libHandle(el)
		if fn then
			local entry = { get = function() return el.get() end, fn = fn }
			keybinds[#keybinds + 1] = entry
			h._unbind = function()
				for i = #keybinds, 1, -1 do
					if keybinds[i] == entry then table.remove(keybinds, i) end
				end
			end
		end
		if type(def) == "table" then
			local link = nil
			if type(def.Active) == "table" then link = def.Active
			elseif type(def.SyncWith) == "table" then link = def.SyncWith end
			if link then
				activeReg[#activeReg + 1] = {
					label = (type(def.Active) == "string") and def.Active or text,
					getState = function()
						local ok, v = pcall(function() return link.GetValue and link:GetValue() or link:Get() end)
						return ok and v
					end,
					getKey = function() return el.get() end,
				}
				refreshKeybindsHUD()
			end
			regFlag(def.Flag, h, "keybind", def.Default)
		end
		return h
	end)

	S.AddColorPicker = colonSafe(S, function(text, def, cb, pt, ord)
		local el
		if type(def) == "table" and cb == nil then
			el = S.addColorPicker(text, def.Default, def.Callback, def.PreviewType, def.Order)
		else
			el = S.addColorPicker(text, def, cb, pt, ord)
		end
		local h = libHandle(el)

	end)

		if type(cb) == "table" then return S.addButton(text, cb.Callback, cb.Order) end
		return S.addButton(text, cb, ord)
	end)

	S.AddLabel = colonSafe(S, function(text, ord) return libHandle(S.addLabel(text, ord)) end)

	S.AddTextBox = colonSafe(S, function(ph, cb, ord, dt)
		local tb
		if type(cb) == "table" then
			tb = S.addTextBox(ph, cb.Callback, cb.Order, cb.Text)
			regFlag(cb.Flag, {
				Get = function() return tb.Text end,
				Set = function(v) tb.Text = v or "" end,
				silent = function(v) tb.Text = v or "" end,
			}, "text", cb.Text)
		else
			tb = S.addTextBox(ph, cb, ord, dt)
		end
		return tb
	end)

	S.AddPlayerList = colonSafe(S, function(text, def, cb, ord)
		local el
		if type(def) == "table" and cb == nil then
			el = S.addPlayerList(text, def.Default or {}, def.Callback, def.Order)
		else
			el = S.addPlayerList(text, def, cb, ord)
		end
		local h = libHandle(el)
		if type(def) == "table" then
			regFlag(def.Flag, h, "playerlist", def.Default)
		end
		return h
	end)

	S.SetIcon = colonSafe(S, function(spec)
		if type(spec) == "table" and (spec.Icon ~= nil or spec.icon ~= nil) then spec = spec.Icon or spec.icon end
		local g = gbReg[box]
		if not g then return S end
		g.icon = spec
		if g.auIconUpdate then pcall(g.auIconUpdate, spec) end
		return S
	end)
	S.GetIcon = function()
		local g = gbReg[box]
		return g and g.icon or nil
	end
	S._body = body
	S._frame = box
	S._homeCol = parent

	S.SetWide = colonSafe(S, function(on)
		local rail = gbWideOf[S._homeCol]
		if on == true and rail then
			box.Parent = rail
			box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, box.Size.Y.Offset)
		elseif on == false then
			box.Parent = S._homeCol
			box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, box.Size.Y.Offset)
		end
		local fix = rail and gbWideFix[rail]
		if fix then pcall(fix) end
		return gbIsRail[box.Parent] == true
	end)
	S.IsWide = function() return gbIsRail[box.Parent] == true end

	S.SetWidth = colonSafe(S, function(px)
		if type(px) == "number" and px > 40 then
			box.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(px + 0.5), 0, box.Size.Y.Offset)
		else
			box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, box.Size.Y.Offset)
		end
		return S
	end)
	return S
end

local cfgFolder, jsonEnc, jsonDec, cfgEnsure, hudBatch, applyCfgFlags, cfgApplyHooks, AE
do

cfgFolder = "UILibConfigs"
local cfgAutoName = "__autoload"
local cfgMem = {}

function jsonEnc(v)
	local function esc(s)
		return tostring(s):gsub('[%c"\\]', function(ch)
			if ch == '"' then return '\\"'
			elseif ch == "\\" then return "\\\\"
			elseif ch == "\n" then return "\\n"
			elseif ch == "\t" then return "\\t"
			elseif ch == "\r" then return "\\r"
			elseif ch == "\b" then return "\\b"
			elseif ch == "\f" then return "\\f"
			else return " " end
		end)
	end
	local function enc(x)
		local ty = type(x)
		if ty == "nil" then return "null"
		elseif ty == "boolean" then return tostring(x)
		elseif ty == "number" then return tostring(x)
		elseif ty == "string" then return '"' .. esc(x) .. '"'
		elseif ty == "table" then
			local isArr = true
			for k in pairs(x) do
				if type(k) ~= "number" or k < 1 or k % 1 ~= 0 then isArr = false break end
			end
			if isArr and #x > 0 then
				local parts = {}
				for i = 1, #x do parts[i] = enc(x[i]) end
				return "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]"
			end
			local parts = {}
			for k, vv in pairs(x) do parts[#parts + 1] = '"' .. esc(k) .. '":' .. enc(vv) end
			return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}"
		end
		return "null"
	end
	local ok, r = pcall(enc, v)
	return ok and r or nil
end

local function jsonDecLua(s)

	local pos = 1
	local len = #s
	local byte, sub, find = string.byte, string.sub, string.find
	local ESC = { n = "\n", t = "\t", r = "\r", b = "\b", f = "\f" }
	local function ws() pos = find(s, "%S", pos) or (len + 1) end
	local function str()
		pos = pos + 1
		local buf, n = {}, 0
		while true do
			local q = find(s, '["\\]', pos)
			if not q then error("unterminated string") end
			n = n + 1; buf[n] = sub(s, pos, q - 1)
			if byte(s, q) == 34 then pos = q + 1; break end
			local e = sub(s, q + 1, q + 1)
			if e == "u" then
				local code = tonumber(sub(s, q + 2, q + 5), 16) or 63
				n = n + 1; buf[n] = (code < 128) and string.char(code) or utf8.char(code)
				pos = q + 6
			else
				n = n + 1; buf[n] = ESC[e] or e
				pos = q + 2
			end
		end
		return table.concat(buf)
	end
	local parse
	function parse()
		ws()
		local c = byte(s, pos)
		if c == 123 then
			pos = pos + 1
			local out = {}
			ws()
			if byte(s, pos) == 125 then pos = pos + 1 return out end
			while true do
				ws()
				if byte(s, pos) ~= 34 then error("key") end
				local key = str()
				ws()
				if byte(s, pos) ~= 58 then error("colon") end
				pos = pos + 1
				out[key] = parse()
				ws()
				local sep = byte(s, pos)
				pos = pos + 1
				if sep == 125 then break elseif sep ~= 44 then error("sep") end
			end
			return out
		elseif c == 91 then
			pos = pos + 1
			local out, i = {}, 0
			ws()
			if byte(s, pos) == 93 then pos = pos + 1 return out end
			while true do
				i = i + 1
				out[i] = parse()
				ws()
				local sep = byte(s, pos)
				pos = pos + 1
				if sep == 93 then break elseif sep ~= 44 then error("arrsep") end
			end
			return out
		elseif c == 34 then
			return str()
		else
			local tok = s:match("^[%w%+%-%.]+", pos) or ""
			pos = pos + #tok
			if tok == "true" then return true end
			if tok == "false" then return false end
			if tok == "null" or tok == "" then return nil end
			return tonumber(tok)
		end
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(parse)
	return ok and res or nil
end

local HttpServ
pcall(function() HttpServ = game:GetService("HttpService") end)
function jsonDec(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return nil end
	if HttpServ then
		local ok, r = pcall(function() return HttpServ:JSONDecode(s) end)
		if ok and type(r) == "table" then return r end
	end
	return jsonDecLua(s)
end
local jsonEncLua = jsonEnc
jsonEnc = function(v)
	if HttpServ then
		local ok, r = pcall(function() return HttpServ:JSONEncode(v) end)
		if ok and type(r) == "string" then return r end
	end
	return jsonEncLua(v)
end

local cfgReady = nil
function cfgEnsure()
	if cfgReady ~= nil then return cfgReady end
	if not (isfolder and writefile and readfile) then cfgReady = false return false end
	local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, cfgFolder)
	if not ok or not ex then pcall(makefolder, cfgFolder) end
	local ok2, ex2 = pcall(isfolder, cfgFolder)
	cfgReady = (ok2 and ex2) and true or false
	return cfgReady
end

local function fileExists(p)
	if not isfile then return false end
	local ok, ex = pcall(isfile, p)
	return (ok and ex) and true or false
end

local function cfgPath(n) return cfgFolder .. "/" .. n .. ".json" end

local function c3t(c)
	return { math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5) }
end

local function t3c(t)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
	return Color3.fromRGB(t[1] or 255, t[2] or 255, t[3] or 255)
end

local CFG_AXVER = 2
local function serializeCfg()
	local out = { ax = CFG_AXVER, settings = {}, flags = {} }
	for k, v in pairs(SETTINGS) do out.settings[k] = v end
	for name, reg in pairs(flagsReg) do
		local ok, v = pcall(reg.handle.Get)
		if ok and v ~= nil then
			if reg.kind == "color" and typeof(v) == "Color3" then v = c3t(v)
			elseif reg.kind == "keybind" and typeof(v) == "EnumItem" then v = v.Name end
			out.flags[name] = v
		end
	end
	-- capture full GravitonConfig game data (ragebot, SA, etc.)
	-- gc.Data can contain Color3/Vector3/EnumItem which JSONEncode can't handle —
	-- sanitize recursively before encoding.
	local function _sanitize(v)
		local t = typeof(v)
		if t == "Color3" then
			return { __t = "Color3", r = v.R, g = v.G, b = v.B }
		elseif t == "Vector3" then
			return { __t = "Vector3", x = v.X, y = v.Y, z = v.Z }
		elseif t == "EnumItem" then
			return { __t = "Enum", v = tostring(v) }
		elseif t == "table" then
			local out2 = {}
			for k2, v2 in pairs(v) do
				-- preserve string and integer keys; drop userdata/function keys
				if type(k2) == "string" or type(k2) == "number" then
					local sv = _sanitize(v2)
					if sv ~= nil then out2[k2] = sv end
				end
			end
			return out2
		elseif t == "number" or t == "boolean" or t == "string" then
			return v
		end
		-- functions, Instances, Connections etc. — drop silently
		return nil
	end
	pcall(function()
		local _gc = getgenv().GravitonConfig
		if not (_gc and _gc.Data) then return end
		local _sanOk, _san = pcall(_sanitize, _gc.Data)
		if not _sanOk then return end
		local _j = jsonEnc(_san)
		if not _j then return end
		local _d = jsonDec(_j)
		if type(_d) == "table" then out.gameData = _d end
	end)
	return out
end

-- Reverse the sanitization done in serializeCfg so _ApplyLoadedData gets proper types back.
local function _desanitizeGameData(v)
	if type(v) ~= "table" then return v end
	if type(v.__t) == "string" then
		if v.__t == "Color3" then
			return Color3.new(
				math.clamp(tonumber(v.r) or 0, 0, 1),
				math.clamp(tonumber(v.g) or 0, 0, 1),
				math.clamp(tonumber(v.b) or 0, 0, 1)
			)
		elseif v.__t == "Vector3" then
			return Vector3.new(tonumber(v.x) or 0, tonumber(v.y) or 0, tonumber(v.z) or 0)
		elseif v.__t == "Enum" then
			local parts = string.split(tostring(v.v or ""), ".")
			if #parts >= 3 then
				local ok2, ei = pcall(function() return Enum[parts[2]][parts[3]] end)
				if ok2 then return ei end
			end
			return nil
		end
	end
	local out2 = {}
	for k2, v2 in pairs(v) do out2[k2] = _desanitizeGameData(v2) end
	return out2
end

local function sameVal(a, b)
	if a == b then return true end
	local ta, tb = typeof(a), typeof(b)
	if ta ~= tb then return false end
	if ta == "Color3" then
		local x, y = c3t(a), c3t(b)
		return x[1] == y[1] and x[2] == y[2] and x[3] == y[3]
	end
	if ta == "number" then return math.abs(a - b) < 1e-9 end
	if ta == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(a) do if b[k] ~= v then return false end end
		for k, v in pairs(b) do if a[k] ~= v then return false end end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

hudBatch = 0

local CFG_SKIP = { ["Settings.MobileMode"] = true }

local cfgLoadSeq = 0

function applyCfgFlags(data)
	if type(data.flags) ~= "table" then return end
	local staleLayout = data.ax ~= CFG_AXVER
	cfgLoadSeq = cfgLoadSeq + 1
	local mySeq = cfgLoadSeq
	local onlyToggles = SETTINGS.CfgLoadMode == "Toggles only"
	local work = {}
	for name, reg in pairs(flagsReg) do
		if not (staleLayout and name == "Settings.Layout") and not CFG_SKIP[name] and (not onlyToggles or reg.kind == "toggle") then
			local v = data.flags[name]
			if v == nil then
				v = (not onlyToggles) and reg.default or nil
			elseif reg.kind == "color" then
				v = t3c(v)
			elseif reg.kind == "keybind" then
				v = (type(v) == "string") and Enum.KeyCode[v] or v
			end
			if v ~= nil then
				local forceAll = getgenv()._cfgForceApply == true
				local okc, cur = pcall(reg.handle.Get)
				if forceAll or not (okc and sameVal(cur, v)) then
					work[#work + 1] = { reg, v, reg.kind == "toggle" and 2 or (name:sub(1, 9) == "Settings." and 0 or 1), name }
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.sort(work, function(x, y)
		if x[3] ~= y[3] then return x[3] < y[3] end
		return x[4] < y[4]
	end)
	-- diagnostic
	local _diag = getgenv()._cfgDiag or {}
	_diag.flagsRegCount = (function() local c=0 for _ in pairs(flagsReg) do c=c+1 end return c end)()
	_diag.inputFlagCount = (function() local c=0 for _ in pairs(data.flags or {}) do c=c+1 end return c end)()
	_diag.workCount = #work
	_diag.setOk = 0; _diag.setFail = 0
	getgenv()._cfgDiag = _diag
	hudBatch = hudBatch + 1
	local canYield = #work >= 60 and coroutine.isyieldable()
	local t0 = os.clock()
	for _, w in ipairs(work) do
		if mySeq ~= cfgLoadSeq then break end
		local prev = TW_MODE.instant
		TW_MODE.instant = true
		-- During post-build startup replay, colors are applied silently:
		-- firing color callbacks at startup would store Color3 in gc.Data before
		-- the ReactiveStore observer (Color3→ColorSequence) is live, causing
		-- skeleton/tracer ".Keypoints" crashes on first player join.
		local _isSilentColor = getgenv()._cfgSilentColors == true
			and w[1].kind == "color"
			and type(w[1].handle.silent) == "function"
		local _setter = _isSilentColor and w[1].handle.silent or w[1].handle.Set
		local _sok, _serr = pcall(_setter, w[2])
		if _sok then _diag.setOk = _diag.setOk + 1 else _diag.setFail = _diag.setFail + 1
			_diag.lastSetErr = tostring(_serr):sub(1,80) end
		TW_MODE.instant = prev
		if canYield and os.clock() - t0 > 0.004 then
			task.wait()
			t0 = os.clock()
		end
	end
	hudBatch = hudBatch - 1
	if hudBatch == 0 then pcall(refreshKeybindsHUD) end
	pcall(syncFloatingHUD)
end

cfgApplyHooks = {}
getgenv()._gravHooks = cfgApplyHooks  -- bridge for toggle()/slider()/etc. which live in a different scope
local function applyCfg(data)
	if not data then return end
	if type(data.settings) == "table" then
		if data.settings.MenuHidden ~= nil and data.settings.MenuHiddenOnLoad == nil then
			data.settings.MenuHiddenOnLoad = data.settings.MenuHidden
		end
		if SETTINGS.CfgLoadMode ~= "Toggles only" then

			local stale = data.ax ~= CFG_AXVER
			for k, v in pairs(data.settings) do
				if k ~= "MobileMode" and k ~= "CfgLoadMode" and not (stale and k == "Layout") then SETTINGS[k] = v end
			end
			pcall(syncFloatingHUD)
			pcall(placeNotifHolder)
		end
	end
	applyCfgFlags(data)
	-- restore full game data (ragebot, SA, evasion, etc.) via ReactiveStore's own method.
	if type(data.gameData) == "table" then
		local _gc = getgenv().GravitonConfig
		if _gc and type(_gc._ApplyLoadedData) == "function" then
			local _restored = _desanitizeGameData(data.gameData)
			pcall(_gc._ApplyLoadedData, _gc, _restored)
		end
	end
	-- cfgApplyHooks syncs UILib element visuals from gc.Data after a named
	-- config load.  _ApplyLoadedData may update gc.Data asynchronously (via
	-- ReactiveStore Changed events / task.defer), so we defer hook execution
	-- by one task frame for named loads (_cfgForceApply is still set here
	-- because Load clears it only after applyCfg returns).  That guarantees
	-- every pending gc.Data write is committed before we read it.
	-- For __session / auto-load restores the synchronous path is fine.
	local function _runHooks()
		if SETTINGS.CfgLoadMode ~= "Toggles only" then
			for _, fn in ipairs(cfgApplyHooks) do pcall(fn) end
		end
	end
	if getgenv()._cfgForceApply == true then
		task.defer(_runHooks)
	else
		_runHooks()
	end
	if type(data.settings) == "table" and SETTINGS.CfgLoadMode ~= "Toggles only" then
		pcall(GLOW.refresh)
		pcall(brand.setSpin, SETTINGS.BrandSpin)
	end
	if type(refreshKeybindsHUD) == "function" then pcall(refreshKeybindsHUD) end
	if SETTINGS.MenuHiddenOnLoad then
		menuShown = false
		applyMenuVisibility()
	end
end

cfgSys = {
	lastData = nil,
	Save = function(n)
		if n == nil or n == "" then return false end
		local serOk, data = pcall(serializeCfg)
		if not serOk then
			warn("[config] serializeCfg threw: " .. tostring(data))
			return false
		end
		local _diag = getgenv()._cfgDiag or {}
		_diag.savedFlagCount = (function() local c=0 for _ in pairs(data.flags or {}) do c=c+1 end return c end)()
		_diag.savedDataKeys = (function() local c=0 for _ in pairs(data.gameData or {}) do c=c+1 end return c end)()
		_diag.savedFlagsRegCount = (function() local c=0 for _ in pairs(flagsReg) do c=c+1 end return c end)()
		getgenv()._cfgDiag = _diag
		local j = jsonEnc(data)
		if not j then warn("[config] jsonEnc failed for " .. n); return false end
		cfgMem[n] = data
		if cfgEnsure() then
			local ok, werr = pcall(writefile, cfgPath(n), j)
			if ok then log("[config] saved " .. n); return true end
			warn("[config] writefile failed for " .. n .. ": " .. tostring(werr))
			cfgReady = nil
		end
		log("[config] saved (mem) " .. n)
		return true
	end,
	Load = function(n)
		if n == nil or n == "" then return false end
		local data = cfgMem[n]
		if cfgEnsure() and fileExists(cfgPath(n)) then
			local ok, j = pcall(readfile, cfgPath(n))
			if ok and j then data = jsonDec(j) or data end
		end
		if not data then log("[config] not found " .. n); return false end
		cfgSys.lastData = data
		-- Named configs (not __session) force-apply all flags so loading is always
		-- visible even when __session already pre-synced the state at startup.
		local _isNamed = n:sub(1, 2) ~= "__"
		if _isNamed then getgenv()._cfgForceApply = true end
		local applyOk, applyErr = pcall(applyCfg, data)
		if _isNamed then getgenv()._cfgForceApply = nil end
		if not applyOk then warn("[config] applyCfg threw: " .. tostring(applyErr)) end
		log("[config] loaded " .. n)
		return true
	end,
	Delete = function(n)
		if cfgEnsure() and fileExists(cfgPath(n)) then pcall(delfile, cfgPath(n)) end
		cfgMem[n] = nil
		log("[config] deleted " .. n)
	end,
	List = function()
		local out = {}
		if cfgEnsure() then
			pcall(function()
				for _, f in ipairs(listfiles(cfgFolder)) do
					local nm = f:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
					if nm and nm ~= cfgAutoName and nm:sub(1, 2) ~= "__" then out[#out + 1] = nm end
				end
			end)
		end
		for k in pairs(cfgMem) do
			local dup = false
			for _, x in ipairs(out) do if x == k then dup = true break end end
			if not dup and k:sub(1, 2) ~= "__" then out[#out + 1] = k end
		end
		table.sort(out)
		return out
	end,
	SetAuto = function(n)
		local j = jsonEnc({ a = n })
		if not j then return false end
		if cfgEnsure() then
			local ok = pcall(writefile, cfgFolder .. "/" .. cfgAutoName .. ".json", j)
			if ok then log("[config] autoload " .. n); return true end
		end
		cfgMem["__autoload"] = { a = n }
		log("[config] autoload (mem) " .. n)
		return true
	end,
	GetAuto = function()
		if cfgEnsure() and fileExists(cfgFolder .. "/" .. cfgAutoName .. ".json") then
			local ok, j = pcall(readfile, cfgFolder .. "/" .. cfgAutoName .. ".json")
			if ok and j then
				local d = jsonDec(j)
				if d and d.a then return d.a end
			end
		end
		local d = cfgMem["__autoload"]
		return d and d.a or nil
	end,
	ClearAuto = function()
		if cfgEnsure() and fileExists(cfgFolder .. "/" .. cfgAutoName .. ".json") then
			pcall(delfile, cfgFolder .. "/" .. cfgAutoName .. ".json")
		end
		cfgMem["__autoload"] = nil
		log("[config] autoload cleared")
	end,
}

do
	local folder, mem = "UCVisualProfiles", {}
	local V = {}
	local visualKeys = {
		"Layout", "Blur", "BlurSize", "Dim", "CustomCursor", "MenuOpacity", "MenuScale", "DragCover",
		"Brand3D", "Logo3D", "Logo3DTop", "Logo3DMat", "Logo3DTr", "Logo3DSpeed",
		"LayoutFX", "LayoutPos", "NotifPos", "NotifXY", "NotifDrag", "BrandSpin", "GlowHead",
		"GlowCheck", "GlowEdge", "GlowEdgeSize", "GlowColors", "Watermark", "KeybindsHUD",
	}
	local function clone(v)
		if type(v) ~= "table" then return v end
		local out = {}
		for k, x in pairs(v) do out[k] = clone(x) end
		return out
	end
	local function path(n) return folder .. "/" .. n .. ".json" end
	local function ready()
		if not (isfolder and writefile and readfile) then return false end
		local ok, has = pcall(isfolder, folder)
		if not ok or not has then pcall(makefolder, folder) end
		local ok2, has2 = pcall(isfolder, folder)
		return ok2 and has2
	end
	function V.Clean(n)
		if cfgSys.Clean then return cfgSys.Clean(n) end
		return tostring(n or ""):gsub("[^%w %-_%.]", ""):sub(1, 40)
	end
	function V.Snapshot()
		local out = { version = 1, visual = {}, accent = c3t(T.Accent) }
		for _, k in ipairs(visualKeys) do out.visual[k] = clone(SETTINGS[k]) end
		return out
	end
	function V.Save(n)
		n = V.Clean(n)
		if n == "" then return false end
		local data = V.Snapshot()
		mem[n] = data
		if ready() then pcall(writefile, path(n), jsonEnc(data)) end
		return true
	end
	function V.Read(n)
		n = V.Clean(n)
		local data = mem[n]
		if ready() and fileExists(path(n)) then
			local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, path(n))
			if ok and raw then data = jsonDec(raw) or data end
		end
		return data
	end
	function V.List()
		local out = {}
		if ready() and listfiles then pcall(function()
			for _, f in ipairs(listfiles(folder)) do
				local n = f:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
				if n then out[#out + 1] = n end
			end
		end) end
		for n in pairs(mem) do
			if not table.find(out, n) then out[#out + 1] = n end
		end
		table.sort(out)
		return out
	end
	function V.Delete(n)
		n = V.Clean(n)
		if n == "" then return false end
		mem[n] = nil
		if ready() and fileExists(path(n)) then pcall(delfile, path(n)) end
		return true
	end
	function V.Load(n)
		local data = V.Read(n)
		if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.visual) ~= "table" then return false end
		for _, k in ipairs(visualKeys) do
			if data.visual[k] ~= nil then SETTINGS[k] = clone(data.visual[k]) end
		end
		if type(data.accent) == "table" then updateAllAccent(t3c(data.accent)) end
		pcall(GLOW.refresh)
		pcall(brand.setSpin, SETTINGS.BrandSpin)
		pcall(refreshBlur)
		pcall(placeNotifHolder)
		pcall(refreshKeybindsHUD)
		setLayoutAll(layoutIn(SETTINGS.Layout))
		return true
	end
	cfgSys.Visual = V
end

function cfgSys.Clean(n)
	if type(n) ~= "string" then return "" end
	n = n:gsub("[^%w %-_%.]", ""):gsub("^ +", ""):gsub(" +$", "")
	if #n > 40 then n = n:sub(1, 40) end
	if n == cfgAutoName then n = "" end
	return n
end
function cfgSys.Exists(n)
	if n == nil or n == "" then return false end
	if cfgMem[n] then return true end
	return cfgEnsure() and fileExists(cfgPath(n)) or false
end

function cfgSys.Read(n)
	local data = cfgMem[n]
	if cfgEnsure() and fileExists(cfgPath(n)) then
		local ok, j = pcall(readfile, cfgPath(n))
		if ok and j then data = jsonDec(j) or data end
	end
	return data
end

function cfgSys.SaveData(n, data)
	if n == nil or n == "" or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
	local j = jsonEnc(data)
	if not j then return false end
	cfgMem[n] = data
	if cfgEnsure() then
		local ok = pcall(writefile, cfgPath(n), j)
		if not ok then cfgReady = nil end
	end
	return true
end

function cfgSys.Export(n)
	local data
	if n and n ~= "" then data = cfgSys.Read(n) else data = serializeCfg() end
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return nil, "config not found" end
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(data) do out[k] = v end
	out.name = (n and n ~= "") and n or out.name
	out.lib = "UC"
	return jsonEnc(out)
end

function cfgSys.Import(text, asName)
	local nm = cfgSys.Clean(asName or "")
	if type(text) ~= "string" or not text:find("%S") then return false, nm, "nothing pasted" end
	text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if text:sub(1, 1) ~= "{" then return false, nm, "not JSON (must start with {)" end
	local data = jsonDec(text)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return false, nm, "invalid JSON (broken or cut off)" end
	if type(data.flags) ~= "table" and type(data.settings) ~= "table" then
		return false, nm, "not an UC config (no flags / settings)"
	end
	if nm == "" then nm = cfgSys.Clean(tostring(data.name or data.Name or "")) end
	if nm == "" then nm = "imported" end
	data.name, data.lib = nil, nil
	if type(data.flags) ~= "table" then data.flags = {} end
	if not cfgSys.SaveData(nm, data) then return false, nm, "could not save the file" end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		cfgSys.lastData = data
		applyCfg(data)
	end)
	if not ok then return false, nm, "saved, but applying it failed" end
	return true, nm
end
function cfgSys.Clip(text)
	local f = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set) or (syn and syn.write_clipboard)
	if not f then return false end
	return (pcall(f, text))
end

AE = { on = false, src = "", queued = false, conn = nil, file = cfgFolder .. "/__autoexec.json" }
cfgSys.AutoExec = AE
function AE.qot()
	local f = queue_on_teleport or queueonteleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport) or (fluxus and fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then
		local ok, g = pcall(function() return getgenv and getgenv().queue_on_teleport end)
		if ok and type(g) == "function" then f = g end
	end
	return type(f) == "function" and f or nil
end

function AE.code()
	local src = AE.src
	if type(src) ~= "string" or not src:find("%S") then src = AE.dev end
	if type(src) ~= "string" or not src:find("%S") then
		local ok, g = pcall(function() return getgenv and (getgenv().AX_LOADER or getgenv().AX_AUTOEXEC) end)
		src = (ok and type(g) == "string") and g or ""
	end
	src = src:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if src == "" then return nil end
	local body
	if src:match("^https?://") and not src:find("%s") then
		body = string.format("loadstring(game:HttpGet(%q))()", src)
	elseif not src:find("[%s%(]") and (src:match("%.luau?$") or src:match("%.txt$")) then
		body = string.format("loadstring(readfile(%q))()", src)
	else
		body = src
	end

	return "if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end; task.wait(1); " .. body
end
function AE.setDev(src)
	if type(src) == "string" and src:find("%S") then
		if AE.dev ~= src then AE.queued = false end
		AE.dev = src
		if AE.on then AE.watch(); AE.queue() end
	end
end
function AE.persist()
	if not cfgEnsure() then return end
	local j = jsonEnc({ on = AE.on, src = AE.src })
	if j then pcall(writefile, AE.file, j) end
end

function AE.queue()
	if AE.queued then return true end
	local f = AE.qot()
	if not f then return false, "queue_on_teleport not available" end
	local code = AE.code()
	if not code then return false, "no loader set" end
	local ok, err = pcall(f, code)
	if ok then AE.queued = true; return true end
	return false, tostring(err)
end
function AE.watch()
	if AE.conn then return end
	local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	local ok, c = pcall(function()
		return hook(lp.OnTeleport, function(state)
			if AE.on and state == Enum.TeleportState.Started then AE.queue() end
		end)
	end)
	if ok and c then AE.conn = c end
end
function AE.set(on, src)
	if type(src) == "string" and src ~= AE.src then AE.src = src; AE.queued = false end
	if on ~= nil then AE.on = on and true or false end
	AE.persist()
	if AE.on then AE.watch() end
end
pcall(function()
	if cfgEnsure() and fileExists(AE.file) then
		local ok, j = pcall(readfile, AE.file)
		local d = ok and jsonDec(j)
		if type(d) == "table" then
			AE.src = type(d.src) == "string" and d.src or ""
			AE.on = d.on == true
			if AE.on then AE.watch() end
		end
	end

	if AE.on then task.defer(function() pcall(AE.queue) end) end
end)

local PREFS = { file = cfgFolder .. "/__prefs.json" }
pcall(function()
	if cfgEnsure() and fileExists(PREFS.file) then
		local ok, j = pcall(readfile, PREFS.file)
		local d = ok and jsonDec(j)
		if type(d) == "table" and type(d.loadMode) == "string" then SETTINGS.CfgLoadMode = d.loadMode end
	end
end)
function cfgSys.SetLoadMode(m)
	SETTINGS.CfgLoadMode = (m == "Toggles only") and "Toggles only" or "Everything"
	if cfgEnsure() then
		local j = jsonEnc({ loadMode = SETTINGS.CfgLoadMode })
		if j then pcall(writefile, PREFS.file, j) end
	end
end

pcall(function()
	local autoN = cfgSys.GetAuto()
	if autoN and cfgSys.Load(autoN) and SETTINGS.AutoLoadNotify ~= false then
		task.delay(1, function() pcall(notif, 'AutoLoaded "' .. autoN .. '"', 3, T.Accent, "success") end)
	end
end)

-- ── Auto-persist: transparent session save/load ───────────────────────────────
-- Every time set(path, v) is called in the UI scope, it schedules a debounced
-- write to UILibConfigs/__session.json (2 s after last change).
-- On every script launch we auto-load that file so state survives round teleports.
getgenv()._gravSaveSession = function()
	pcall(cfgSys.Save, "__session")
end
-- Load __session ONLY when no named AutoLoad config is set.
-- If AutoLoad is set it already ran above and we must not overwrite it.
pcall(function()
	if not cfgSys.GetAuto() and cfgEnsure() and fileExists(cfgFolder .. "/__session.json") then
		cfgSys.Load("__session")
	end
end)

end

		fxRows[key] = GF:AddToggle(label, {

	fxToggle("underlines", "line")
	fxToggle("animations", "slide")
	GF:AddLabel("saved per layout")
	layoutUIHooks[#layoutUIHooks + 1] = function(name)
		for key, h in pairs(fxRows) do
			if h and h.silent then pcall(h.silent, FX[key] ~= false) end
		end
		if ddLayout and ddLayout.Get and ddLayout.Get() ~= layoutOut(name) then
			guard = true
			pcall(ddLayout.Set, layoutOut(name))
			guard = false
		end
	end

	local GG = newGroupbox(LR, "glows", 2)
	local glowUI = {}
	local function glowRow(label, k)
		glowUI[k] = {}
		glowUI[k].t = GG:AddToggle(label, {
			Default = GLOW.on(k),
			Callback = function(v) GLOW.set(k, v) end,
		})
		glowUI[k].c = GG:AddColorPicker(label .. " colour", {
			Default = GLOW.color(k) or T.Accent,
			Callback = function(c) GLOW.setColor(k, c) end,
		})
	end
	glowRow("header line glow", "head")
	glowRow("checkbox glow", "check")
	glowRow("screen edge glow", "edge")
	local edgeSl = GG:AddSlider("edge glow strength", {
		Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = tonumber(SETTINGS.GlowEdgeSize) or 50,
		Callback = function(v) SETTINGS.GlowEdgeSize = v; GLOW.refresh("edge") end,
	})
	GG:AddButton("glow colours follow theme", { Callback = function()
		for _, k in ipairs({ "head", "check", "edge" }) do
			GLOW.setColor(k, nil)
			if glowUI[k].c and glowUI[k].c.silent then pcall(glowUI[k].c.silent, T.Accent) end
		end
	end })

	local GB = newGroupbox(LL, "UC brand", 2)
	local spinDD = GB:AddDropdown("UC rotation", {
		Values = { "Off", "Horizontal", "Vertical" },
		Default = SETTINGS.BrandSpin or "Off",
		Callback = function(v) if type(v) == "string" then brand.setSpin(v) end end,
	})
	GB:AddLabel("spins in place")

	cfgApplyHooks[#cfgApplyHooks + 1] = function()
		for _, k in ipairs({ "head", "check", "edge" }) do
			local u = glowUI[k]
			if u.t and u.t.silent then pcall(u.t.silent, GLOW.on(k)) end
			if u.c and u.c.silent then pcall(u.c.silent, GLOW.color(k) or T.Accent) end
		end
		if edgeSl and edgeSl.silent then pcall(edgeSl.silent, tonumber(SETTINGS.GlowEdgeSize) or 50) end
		if spinDD and spinDD.silent then pcall(spinDD.silent, SETTINGS.BrandSpin or "Off") end
	end
end

local kbLines = {}
local kbSig = "\0"

refreshKeybindsHUD = function()
	if not KbHud then return end
	if hudBatch > 0 then return end
	local actives = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(activeReg) do
		local ok, v
		if entry.getState then
			ok, v = pcall(entry.getState)
		elseif entry.handle and entry.handle.Get then
			ok, v = pcall(function() return entry.handle.Get() end)
		end
		if ok and v then
			local lbl = entry.label
			if entry.getKey then
				local okk, k = pcall(entry.getKey)
				if okk and k then lbl = lbl .. "  [" .. tostring(k.Name or k) .. "]" end
			end
			actives[#actives + 1] = lbl
		end
	end

	KbHud.Visible = SETTINGS.KeybindsHUD
	local sig = table.concat(actives, "\1")
	if sig == kbSig then return end
	kbSig = sig

	for _, l in ipairs(kbLines) do pcall(function() l:Destroy() end) end
	kbLines = {}

	if kbSettingsList then
		for _, ch in ipairs(kbSettingsList:GetChildren()) do
			if ch:IsA("TextLabel") or ch:IsA("TextButton") then ch:Destroy() end
		end
	end

	if not SETTINGS.KeybindsHUD then return end
	if #actives == 0 then
		local line = create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
			Font = F_MONO,
			Text = "n/a",
			TextColor3 = T.FontSub,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			LayoutOrder = 1,
			ZIndex = 32,
		}, KbBody)
		kbLines[#kbLines + 1] = line
		return
	end

	for i, label in ipairs(actives) do
		local line = create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
			Font = F_MONO,
			Text = "> " .. label,
			TextColor3 = T.Accent,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			ZIndex = 32,
		}, KbBody)
		regAccent(line, "TextColor3")
		kbLines[#kbLines + 1] = line

		if kbSettingsList then
			create("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
				Font = F_MONO,
				Text = "> " .. label,
				TextColor3 = T.Accent,
				TextSize = 11,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				LayoutOrder = i,
				ZIndex = 14,
			}, kbSettingsList)
		end
	end
end
refreshKeybindsHUD()

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.4)
		if not (KbHud and KbHud.Parent) then break end
		refreshKeybindsHUD()
	end
end)

	if WatermarkFrame then WatermarkFrame.Visible = on end

local function refreshFloatingLayoutStyle()
	if not (KbHud and WatermarkFrame) then return end
	KbHud.BackgroundColor3, WatermarkFrame.BackgroundColor3 = T.Background, T.Background
	KbStroke.Color, WmStroke.Color = T.Line, T.Line
	local kr = KbHud:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	local wr = WatermarkFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if kr then kr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) end
	if wr then wr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) end
	WatermarkLbl.Font = F_MONO
	WatermarkLbl.TextSize = TS_SMALL
	local title = KbHud:FindFirstChild("_kbTitle", true)
	if title then
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextColor3 = T.Font
	end
	local rule = KbHud:FindFirstChild("_kbHeaderLine", true)
	if rule then rule.BackgroundColor3 = T.Line end
	local accentRule = KbHud:FindFirstChild("_kbAccentLine", true)
	if accentRule then accentRule.Visible = FX.line ~= false end
	for _, d in ipairs(KbHud:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d ~= title then
			d.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
			d.TextSize = 11
			d.TextColor3 = d.Text == "n/a" and T.FontSub or T.Accent
		end
	end
	local pip = WatermarkFrame:FindFirstChild("_wmAccent")
	if pip then pip.Visible = true end
end
layoutUIHooks[#layoutUIHooks + 1] = function() refreshFloatingLayoutStyle(); syncFloatingHUD() end
refreshFloatingLayoutStyle()
syncFloatingHUD()

hook(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
	wmFps = wmFps * 0.92 + (1 / math.max(dt, 0.0001)) * 0.08
end)

syncFloatingHUD()

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.5)
		if not (WatermarkFrame and WatermarkFrame.Parent) then break end
		if SETTINGS.Watermark then
			local ping = 0
			pcall(function()
				local stats = game:GetService("Stats")
				local item = stats.Network and stats.Network.ServerStatsItem and stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
				if item and item.GetValueInt then ping = item:GetValueInt() end
			end)
			local okTime, tm = pcall(os.date, "%H:%M:%S")
			WatermarkLbl.Text = wmName .. " | " .. math.floor(wmFps + 0.5) .. " fps | " .. ping .. " ms | " .. (okTime and tm or "00:00:00")
		end
	end
end)
end

menuBtn = create("TextButton", {
	Name = "MenuToggle",
	BackgroundColor3 = T.Background,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -21),

regAccent(menuImg, "ImageColor3")

local mbDrag, mbDragInput, mbStartPos, mbStartInput
menuBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		mbDrag = true
		mbStartInput = i.Position
		mbStartPos = menuBtn.Position
		local ec
		if i.Changed then
			ec = i.Changed:Connect(function()
				if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					mbDrag = false
					if ec then ec:Disconnect() end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end)
menuBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		mbDragInput = i
	end
end)
hook(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
	if i == mbDragInput and mbDrag then
		local d = i.Position - mbStartInput
		menuBtn.Position = UDim2.new(mbStartPos.X.Scale, mbStartPos.X.Offset + d.X, mbStartPos.Y.Scale, mbStartPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
	end
end)

local mbDownAt, mbMoved, mbDownPos
menuBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		mbDownPos = i.Position
		mbMoved = false
		mbDownAt = os.clock()
	end
end)
menuBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
	if (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and mbDownPos then
		if (i.Position - mbDownPos).Magnitude > 6 then mbMoved = true end
	end
end)
menuBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if mbDownPos and not mbMoved and (os.clock() - (mbDownAt or 0)) < 0.5 then
			menuShown = not menuShown
			applyMenuVisibility()
		end
		mbDownPos = nil
	end
end)

function resizeAllWindows()
	for _, w in ipairs(allWindows) do
		if w and w.Main then
			local W, H = computeSize()
			if w._size then W, H = w._size.X, w._size.Y end
			if w._layout then pcall(w._layout, W, H) end
		end
	end
end

end

	if not NOTIF_POS[pos] then return Lib end
	SETTINGS.NotifPos = pos
	placeNotifHolder()
	syncFlag("Settings.NotifPos", pos)
	return Lib
end)

hook(UIS.InputBegan, function(key, processed)
	if processed then return end
	if not SETTINGS.Keybinds then return end
	if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
	if bindingKey then return end

	if SETTINGS.MenuKey and key.KeyCode == SETTINGS.MenuKey then
		menuShown = not menuShown
		applyMenuVisibility()
		return
	end

	local kw = keyedWindows[key.KeyCode]
	if kw then kw:Toggle() end

	for i = 1, #keybinds do
		local b = keybinds[i]
		if b then
			if b.key then
				if b.key == key.KeyCode then pcall(b.fn) end
			elseif b.get then
				local ok, cur = pcall(b.get)
				if ok and cur == key.KeyCode then pcall(b.fn, key.KeyCode) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

	end
end)

-- ── LuaHooks AC bypass (setmetatable intercept) ──────────────────────────────
-- Intercepts getrenv().setmetatable to neutralise the LuaHooks AC pattern-
-- match check.  Runs once; guards against re-entry with __LH_SetmtBP flag.
do
    if getgenv and getgenv().__LH_SetmtBP ~= game
       and hookfunction and newcclosure and getrenv then
        getgenv().__LH_SetmtBP = game
        local _ok = pcall(function()
            local _oldSetmt
            local _l1 = { hits = 0 }
            getgenv().__LH_L1 = _l1
            local _rg, _rl, _ty = rawget, rawlen, type
            _oldSetmt = hookfunction(getrenv().setmetatable, newcclosure(function(t, mt)
                if _ty(mt) == "table" and _rg(mt, "__mode") == "kv"
                   and _ty(t) == "table" and _rl(t) == 4
                   and _ty(_rg(t, 1)) == "table"
                   and _rg(t, 2) == 1
                   and _rg(t, 3) == "String"
                   and _ty(_rg(t, 4)) == "userdata" then
                    _l1.hits = _l1.hits + 1
                    return _oldSetmt({ 1, 2, 3 }, {})
                end
                return _oldSetmt(t, mt)
            end))
        end)
        if not _ok then getgenv().__LH_SetmtBP = nil end
    end
end

local Lib = getgenv().UILib

if not Lib then

    return
end

-- ── Config helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function get(path)
    if not (cfg and cfg.Data) then return nil end
    local d = cfg.Data
    for _, k in ipairs(path) do
        if type(d) ~= "table" then return nil end
        d = d[k]
    end
    return d
end

-- debounced auto-persist: fire 2 s after last change
local _apTimer = nil
local function _scheduleAutoPersist()
    if _apTimer then pcall(task.cancel, _apTimer); _apTimer = nil end
    _apTimer = task.delay(2, function()
        _apTimer = nil
        local f = getgenv()._gravSaveSession
        if type(f) == "function" then pcall(f) end
    end)
end

local function set(path, v)
    if not cfg then return end
    cfg:Set(path, v)
    _scheduleAutoPersist()
end

-- ── Element helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- _gh: shared hook table (cfgApplyHooks lives in a different Lua scope)
local function _ghInsert(fn)
    local gh = getgenv()._gravHooks
    if type(gh) == "table" then gh[#gh+1] = fn end
end

local function toggle(G, label, path, def, ord)
    local flag    = table.concat(path, ".")
    local default = def ~= nil and def or false
    local handle = Lib:CreateToggle(G, label, {
        Default  = default,
        Callback = function(v) set(path, v) end,
        Order    = ord,
    })
    if handle then
        -- Register in flagsReg: values are saved in data.flags and restored by
        -- applyCfgFlags on every config load (named configs AND startup __session).
        -- regFlag also does an immediate auto-apply from cfgSys.lastData.flags when
        -- this element is registered, so new __sessions restore values without needing
        -- a separate post-build replay pass for this element.
        Lib.RegisterFlag(Lib, flag, handle, "toggle")
        if handle.Set then
            -- Backward-compat hook: syncs from gc.Data for old configs that have
            -- gameData but predate the flagsReg registration of gameplay elements.
            _ghInsert(function()
                local v = get(path)
                if type(v) == "boolean" then pcall(handle.Set, v) end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function slider(G, label, path, mn, mx, def, dec, ord)
    local flag    = table.concat(path, ".")
    local default = def
    local handle = Lib:CreateSlider(G, label, {
        Min      = mn, Max = mx, Default = default,
        Decimals = dec or 0,
        Callback = function(v) set(path, v) end,
        Order    = ord,
    })
    if handle then
        Lib.RegisterFlag(Lib, flag, handle, "slider")
        if handle.Set then
            _ghInsert(function()
                local v = get(path)
                if type(v) == "number" then pcall(handle.Set, v) end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function dropdown(G, label, path, values, def, ord)
    local flag    = table.concat(path, ".")
    local default = def ~= nil and def or values[1]
    local handle = Lib:CreateDropdown(G, label, {
        Values   = values, Default = default,
        Callback = function(v) set(path, v) end,
        Order    = ord,
    })
    if handle then
        Lib.RegisterFlag(Lib, flag, handle, "dropdown")
        if handle.Set then
            _ghInsert(function()
                local v = get(path)
                if type(v) == "string" then pcall(handle.Set, v) end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function colorpick(G, label, path, def, ord)
    local flag    = table.concat(path, ".")
    local default = def or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local handle = Lib:CreateColorPicker(G, label, {
        Default  = default,
        -- Store Color3 directly — Graviton's renderers read colors as Color3
        -- (e.g. ColorSequence.new(weather.Color) needs a Color3, not a table)
        Callback = function(c) set(path, c) end,
        Order    = ord,
    })
    if handle then
        -- Register as "color" kind.  applyCfgFlags encodes Color3→{r,g,b} on save and
        -- decodes {r,g,b}→Color3 on load.  regFlag's auto-apply uses handle.silent for
        -- color kind (see regFlag) so the callback is NOT fired at startup, keeping
        -- gc.Data free of Color3 until the ReactiveStore observer is live.
        Lib.RegisterFlag(Lib, flag, handle, "color")
        if handle.Set then
            _ghInsert(function()
                local c = get(path)
                if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
                    pcall(handle.Set, c)
                elseif type(c) == "table" and type(c[1]) == "number" then
                    pcall(handle.Set, Color3.new(
                        math.clamp(c[1], 0, 1),
                        math.clamp(c[2] or 0, 0, 1),
                        math.clamp(c[3] or 0, 0, 1)
                    ))
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function keybind(G, label, path, def, ord)
    local flag    = table.concat(path, ".")
    local default = def or Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
    local handle = Lib:CreateKeybind(G, label, {
        Default  = default,
        -- Callback stores the KeyCode name as a string in gc.Data so it survives JSON.
        -- handle.Get() returns the EnumItem; serializeCfg converts it to string name.
        -- applyCfgFlags converts the string name back to EnumItem before calling Set.
        Callback = function(k) set(path, k and k.Name or nil) end,
        Order    = ord,
    })
    if handle then
        Lib.RegisterFlag(Lib, flag, handle, "keybind")
        if handle.Set then
            _ghInsert(function()
                local v = get(path)
                local k = (type(v) == "string" and Enum.KeyCode[v]) or Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
                pcall(handle.Set, k)
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function textbox(G, label, path, ph, ord)
    local default = ""
    -- Note: Lib:CreateTextBox returns raw Instance, not a libHandle — no Set hook needed
    Lib:CreateTextBox(G, label, {
        Placeholder = ph or "",
        Text        = default,
        Callback    = function(v) set(path, v) end,
        Order       = ord,
    })
end

local function sec(name, fn)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    if not ok then warn("[GravitonUI] section '" .. name .. "' error: " .. tostring(err)) end
end

local function spoofBlock(G, ns, fields)
    for _, f in ipairs(fields) do
        local ep = {ns[1], ns[2], f.field, "Enabled"}
        local vp = {ns[1], ns[2], f.field, "Value"}
        if f.kind == "tog" then
            toggle  (G, f.label.." Override", ep, false)
        elseif f.kind == "drop" then
            toggle  (G, f.label.." Override", ep, false)
            dropdown(G, f.label, vp, f.opts, f.opts[1])
        elseif f.kind == "pct" then
            toggle  (G, f.label.." Override", ep, false)
            slider  (G, f.label, vp, 0, 100, 0, 1)
        elseif f.kind == "num" then
            toggle  (G, f.label.." Override", ep, false)
            slider  (G, f.label, vp, 0, 99999, 0, 0)
        elseif f.kind == "text" then
            toggle  (G, f.label.." Override", ep, false)
            textbox (G, f.label, vp, "Value")
        end
    end
end

local BG_ASSET_ID = "rbxassetid://17863655173"

local W = Lib:CreateWindow({
    Title    = "Graviton",
    MenuKey  = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
})
W:SetVisible(true)

-- ── Mobile open/close button ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Only created on touch devices. Draggable pill; tap toggles menu visibility.
pcall(function()
    local UIS_m = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    if not UIS_m.TouchEnabled then return end

    local _mOpen = true  -- tracks current menu state

    local mobGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    mobGui.Name            = "GravMobileHUD"
    mobGui.ResetOnSpawn    = false
    mobGui.DisplayOrder    = 10001
    mobGui.IgnoreGuiInset  = true
    mobGui.ZIndexBehavior  = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    local _ok = pcall(function() mobGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if not _ok then
        mobGui.Parent = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    -- pill button
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name               = "GravToggle"
    btn.Size               = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 32)
    btn.Position           = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 14)
    btn.AnchorPoint        = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3   = Color3.fromRGB(22, 14, 38)
    btn.BorderSizePixel    = 0
    btn.Text               = "GRAVITON"
    btn.TextColor3         = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
    btn.TextSize           = 10
    btn.Font               = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.AutoButtonColor    = false
    btn.ZIndex             = 10
    btn.Parent             = mobGui

    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local _st = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    _st.Color     = Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 200)
    _st.Thickness = 1.5

    -- drag tracking
    local _drag, _dragStart, _posStart = false, nil, nil
    local _movedPx = 0

    btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            _drag      = true
            _dragStart = inp.Position
            _posStart  = btn.Position
            _movedPx   = 0
        end
    end)
    btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
        if _drag and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local dx = inp.Position.X - _dragStart.X
            local dy = inp.Position.Y - _dragStart.Y
            _movedPx = math.abs(dx) + math.abs(dy)
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(
                _posStart.X.Scale, _posStart.X.Offset + dx,
                _posStart.Y.Scale, _posStart.Y.Offset + dy
            )
        end
    end)
    btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        _drag = false
        -- only toggle if tap (moved < 12 px total)
        if _movedPx < 12 then
            _mOpen = not _mOpen
            pcall(function() W:SetVisible(_mOpen) end)
            if _mOpen then
                btn.Text           = "GRAVITON"
                btn.TextColor3     = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 14, 38)
                _st.Color          = Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 200)
            else
                btn.Text           = "▶  OPEN"
                btn.TextColor3     = Color3.fromRGB(242, 238, 255)
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 200)
                _st.Color          = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- ── Background image (transparent overlay on main window frame) ───────────────
pcall(function()
    if BG_ASSET_ID == "" then return end
    -- Full-screen character overlay — separate ScreenGui so it never touches
    -- Obsidian's own frames and doesn't break any UI elements.
    -- DisplayOrder 9998 puts it above the game world but the semi-transparent
    -- image shows as a ghost layer over the whole screen including the menu.
    local bgGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    bgGui.Name             = "GravBG"
    bgGui.ResetOnSpawn     = false
    bgGui.DisplayOrder     = 9998
    bgGui.ZIndexBehavior   = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    bgGui.IgnoreGuiInset   = true
    local ok = pcall(function() bgGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if not ok then bgGui.Parent = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

    local bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel", bgGui)
    bg.Name                   = "GravBGImg"
    bg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    bg.ImageTransparency      = 0.55   -- adjust: 0 = opaque, 1 = invisible
    bg.Image                  = BG_ASSET_ID
    bg.ScaleType              = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    bg.Size                   = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    bg.Position               = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
    bg.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    bg.Active                 = false
end)

-- ── Dark purple accent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pcall(function() Lib:SetAccent(Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 200)) end)

-- ── Window transparency ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- WindowShell already has BackgroundTransparency=0.35 built into Obsidian.
-- We raise transparency on the inner structural frames so the UI reads as
-- semi-transparent without touching any groupbox/label children.
task.defer(function()
    pcall(function()
        local main = W and W.Main
        if not main then return end
        -- The "Window" frame itself
        main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
        -- Structural children by name (non-recursive — only direct children)
        for _, name in ipairs({"Body", "Sidebar", "Content"}) do
            local f = main:FindFirstChild(name)
            if f and f:IsA("Frame") then
                f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- ── Title "v3" — purple inline glow ─────────────────────────────────────────
-- After Obsidian builds the window, find the title TextLabel, enable RichText,
-- and replace its text with "Graviton v3" where "v3" is purple with a stroke
-- that simulates a glow.
task.defer(function()
    pcall(function()
        local main = W and W.Main
        if not main then return end
        local titleLbl
        for _, desc in ipairs(main:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("TextLabel") and (desc.Text == "Graviton" or desc.Name == "Title") then
                titleLbl = desc
                break
            end
        end
        if not titleLbl then return end
        titleLbl.RichText = true
        -- Bright purple bold "v3" — thin 1px stroke for glow, readable at any font size
        titleLbl.Text = 'Graviton <font color="#3b0080"><b><stroke color="#5a10a8" joins="round" thickness="1" transparency="0.1">v3</stroke></b></font>'
    end)
end)

-- ── Snowfall (inside the Obsidian window) ─────────────────────────────────────
-- W.Main has ClipsDescendants = true, so flakes are masked to the window bounds.
pcall(function()
    local winFrame = W and W.Main
    if not winFrame then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        while winFrame and winFrame.Parent do
            task.wait(0.18 + math.random() * 0.35)
            local sz = math.random(2, 4)
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.BackgroundColor3  = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 + math.random() * 0.45
            f.BorderSizePixel   = 0
            f.Size              = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
            f.Position          = UDim2.new(math.random(), 0, -0.04, 0)
            f.ZIndex            = 50
            Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            f.Parent            = winFrame
            local speed   = 0.035 + math.random() * 0.055
            local sway    = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.006
            local startX  = f.Position.X.Scale
            local elapsed = 0
            task.spawn(function()
                local y = -0.04
                local x = startX
                while f and f.Parent do
                    local dt = task.wait()
                    elapsed  = elapsed + dt
                    y = y + speed * dt
                    x = startX + math.sin(elapsed * 1.4) * sway
                    f.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, y, 0)
                    if y > 1.05 then f:Destroy() break end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end)
