end)

-- ── FOV circles + Crosshair gradient disc (ScreenGui-based) ──────────────────
-- Drawing.new("Circle") does not render as actual circles on all executors.
-- We use Frame + UICorner(UDim.new(1,0)) which is always a perfect circle.
-- FOV ring:  two Frames (glow behind, crisp front) + UIStroke, centred on mouse
-- Gradient:  one Frame + UICorner + UIGradient, fixed at screen centre
local _fovGui, _fovFrame, _fovStroke, _fovGlowFrame, _fovGlowStroke
local _xhGui,  _xhFrame, _xhGrad, _xhCresFrame, _xhCresGrad
do
    local rs     = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UIS2   = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local LPsvc  = game:GetService("Players")

    -- Lazy-create all ScreenGui instances once PlayerGui is available
    local function _ensureGuis()
        if _fovGui and _xhGui then return true end
        local lp = LPsvc.LocalPlayer
        local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return false end

        if not _fovGui then
            _fovGui                 = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            _fovGui.Name            = "__GravFOV"
            _fovGui.IgnoreGuiInset  = true
            _fovGui.ResetOnSpawn    = false
            _fovGui.DisplayOrder    = 999998
            _fovGui.Parent          = pg

            -- glow ring (larger, dimmer — created first so it sits behind)
            _fovGlowFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
            _fovGlowFrame.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            _fovGlowFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            _fovGlowFrame.BorderSizePixel        = 0
            _fovGlowFrame.Visible                = false
            local gc2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
            gc2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            gc2.Parent = _fovGlowFrame
            _fovGlowStroke               = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            _fovGlowStroke.Thickness     = 5
            _fovGlowStroke.Parent        = _fovGlowFrame
            _fovGlowFrame.Parent         = _fovGui

            -- crisp main ring (thin, full-colour)
            _fovFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
            _fovFrame.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            _fovFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            _fovFrame.BorderSizePixel        = 0
            _fovFrame.Visible                = false
            local fc2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
            fc2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            fc2.Parent = _fovFrame
            _fovStroke           = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            _fovStroke.Thickness = 1.5
            _fovStroke.Parent    = _fovFrame
            _fovFrame.Parent     = _fovGui
        end

        if not _xhGui then
            _xhGui                = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            _xhGui.Name           = "__GravXH"
            _xhGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            _xhGui.ResetOnSpawn   = false
            _xhGui.DisplayOrder   = 999997
            _xhGui.Parent         = pg

            -- crescent ring: solid filled circle with UIGradient, sits BEHIND the
            -- fill circle. Fill hides the interior; the outer annular band is the
            -- visible gradient ring. UIGradient on the Frame is the only path that
            -- reliably produces a color gradient in the executor environment.
            _xhCresFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
            _xhCresFrame.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            _xhCresFrame.BackgroundColor3       = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            _xhCresFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0   -- solid; fill circle on top masks center
            _xhCresFrame.BorderSizePixel        = 0
            _xhCresFrame.Visible                = false
            local xcc = Instance.new("UICorner")
            xcc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            xcc.Parent = _xhCresFrame
            _xhCresGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            _xhCresGrad.Parent = _xhCresFrame   -- on the Frame — gradient color works here
            _xhCresFrame.Parent = _xhGui   -- parented BEFORE _xhFrame → renders behind

            -- main circle (on top of crescent)
            _xhFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
            _xhFrame.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            _xhFrame.BackgroundColor3       = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            _xhFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            _xhFrame.BorderSizePixel        = 0
            _xhFrame.Visible                = false
            local xc = Instance.new("UICorner")
            xc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            xc.Parent = _xhFrame

            _xhGrad          = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            _xhGrad.Rotation = 90
            _xhGrad.Parent   = _xhFrame
            _xhFrame.Parent  = _xhGui
        end

        return true
    end

    rs.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not _ensureGuis() then return end

        -- ── aimbot FOV ring ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        if not _fovVisible then
            _fovFrame.Visible     = false
            _fovGlowFrame.Visible = false
        else
            local vp  = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
            local ctr = UIS2.TouchEnabled
                and Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
                or  UIS2:GetMouseLocation()
            local d  = _fovRadius * 2
            local gc = Color3.new(_fovColor.R * 0.45, _fovColor.G * 0.45, _fovColor.B * 0.45)
            _fovGlowFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ctr.X, ctr.Y)
            _fovGlowFrame.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(d + 6, d + 6)
            _fovGlowStroke.Color   = gc
            _fovGlowFrame.Visible  = true
            _fovFrame.Position     = UDim2.fromOffset(ctr.X, ctr.Y)
            _fovFrame.Size         = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
            _fovStroke.Color       = _fovColor
            _fovFrame.Visible      = true
        end

        -- SA FOV ring is managed inside the Silent Aim do-scope below

        -- ── crosshair gradient disc ──────────────────────────────────────────
        -- Spin the gradient 90 °/s regardless of rainbow mode
        _xhCircleRot = (_xhCircleRot + 90 / 60) % 360
        -- Rainbow: both colours drift around the hue wheel together each frame
        if _xhCircleRbOn then
            _xhCircleHue  = (_xhCircleHue + 1/60 * 0.35) % 1
            _xhGradColor1 = Color3.fromHSV(_xhCircleHue, 1, 1)
            _xhGradColor2 = Color3.fromHSV((_xhCircleHue + 0.18) % 1, 1, 0.75)
        end
        if not _xhCircleVis then
            _xhFrame.Visible = false
            if _xhCresFrame then _xhCresFrame.Visible = false end
        else
            local vp4  = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
            local ctr4 = Vector2.new(vp4.X * 0.5, vp4.Y * 0.5)
            local d4   = _xhCircleR * 2
            _xhFrame.Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(ctr4.X, ctr4.Y)
            _xhFrame.Size                   = UDim2.fromOffset(d4, d4)
            _xhFrame.BackgroundTransparency = _xhCircleTrans
            _xhGrad.Color    = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, _xhGradColor1),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, _xhGradColor2),
            })
            _xhGrad.Rotation = _xhCircleRot
            _xhFrame.Visible = true
            -- crescent ring outline: centered on fill circle, slightly larger so
            -- the thin stroke ring forms a clean border around the fill.
            if _xhCresFrame then
                if _xhCresOn then
                    _xhCresFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ctr4.X, ctr4.Y)
                    _xhCresFrame.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(d4 + 8, d4 + 8)
                    _xhCresGrad.Color     = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, _xhCresColor1),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, _xhCresColor2),
                    })
                    _xhCresGrad.Rotation  = _xhCircleRot
                    _xhCresFrame.Visible  = true
                else
                    _xhCresFrame.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ── Silent Aim — ported from Harion_enhancement, Obsidian UI ─────────────────
-- Mirrors Harion exactly: require Utility+EnumLibrary upfront, replace entire
-- cameradata with a new table, hook UseItem.FireServer once.
do
    -- ── state vars ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local saOn       = false
    local saFovV     = 120
    local saHitV     = 100
    local saHsV      = 65
    local saBodyV    = 35
    local saVisV     = false
    local saShowFov  = true
    local saFovColor  = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local saFovColor2 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)  -- second gradient color
    local saFovTransV = 0.5     -- FOV ring transparency (0 = opaque, 1 = invisible)
    local _saGradRot  = 0       -- current gradient angle (degrees)
    local _saGrad, _saGlowGrad  -- UIGradient instances (unused; kept for compat)
    local _saHeartbeat  = nil   -- RBXScriptConnection when AutoFire is running
    local _fcCache      = nil   -- cached FighterController require result
    local _saToggle             -- forward-declared; defined after helpers
    local saTeamCheck = true    -- skip teammates in _getTarget
    local _saAllAround  = false -- 360° world-space targeting, shot from HRP
    local _saAutoFire   = false -- fire without holding MB1
    -- anti-katana
    local akOn         = false
    local _akDeflecting = {}   -- { [userId] = expireTimestamp }
    local _akHooked    = false

    -- ── services ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local _LP      = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _Cam     = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local _UIS     = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local _RS      = game:GetService("RunService")
    local _Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local _RS_rep  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

    -- ── game modules — required upfront exactly as Harion does ───────────────
    local _util, _enums
    pcall(function()
        _util  = require(_RS_rep.Modules.Utility)
        _enums = require(_RS_rep.Modules.EnumLibrary)
    end)

    -- ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local function _getUseItemRemote()
        -- Harion's exact path: RS.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem
        local remotes     = _RS_rep:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local replication = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Replication")
        local fighter     = replication and replication:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
        local useItem     = fighter and fighter:FindFirstChild("UseItem")
        if useItem and useItem:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return useItem end
        -- fallback: recursive search (works if path ever changes)
        return _RS_rep:FindFirstChild("UseItem", true)
    end

    local function _screenPos(hrp)
        local sp, vis = _Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
        return vis, Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
    end

    local function _getAimCenter()
        if _UIS.TouchEnabled then
            local vp = _Cam.ViewportSize
            return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
        end
        return _UIS:GetMouseLocation()
    end

    local function _getTarget(fovRadius, visOnly)
        local myChar = _LP.Character
        local myHRP  = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if _saAllAround then
            -- 360° world-space: pick nearest enemy by world distance, no FOV check
            local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
            for _, plr in ipairs(_Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr == _LP or not plr.Character then continue end
                if saTeamCheck and _LP.Team ~= nil and plr.Team == _LP.Team then continue end
                local char = plr.Character
                local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
                if visOnly then
                    local vis = _screenPos(hrp)
                    if not vis then continue end
                end
                local d = myHRP and (hrp.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
                if d < bestD then best, bestD = char, d end
            end
            return best
        else
            local mp = _getAimCenter()
            local best, bestD = nil, fovRadius
            for _, plr in ipairs(_Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr == _LP or not plr.Character then continue end
                if saTeamCheck and _LP.Team ~= nil and plr.Team == _LP.Team then continue end
                local char = plr.Character
                local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
                local vis, sp2 = _screenPos(hrp)
                if visOnly and not vis then continue end
                local d = (sp2 - mp).Magnitude
                if d < bestD then best, bestD = char, d end
            end
            return best
        end
    end

    -- ── UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    sec("Silent Aim", function()
        local L, R = combatTab("Silent Aim")
        local G = Lib:CreateGroupbox(L, "Silent Aim", 1)
        Lib:CreateToggle(G, "Enable Silent Aim", {
            Default  = false,
            Callback = function(v) _saToggle(v) end,
        })
        Lib:CreateSlider(G, "FOV Radius (px)", {
            Min=10, Max=500, Default=60, Decimals=0,
            Callback = function(v) saFovV = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateToggle(G, "Show FOV Circle", {
            Default  = true,
            Callback = function(v) saShowFov = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateColorPicker(G, "FOV Color", {
            Default  = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            Callback = function(v) saFovColor = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateSlider(G, "FOV Transparency", {
            Min=0, Max=100, Default=50, Decimals=0,
            Callback = function(v) saFovTransV = v / 100 end,
        })
        Lib:CreateSlider(G, "Hit Chance (%)", {
            Min=0, Max=100, Default=100, Decimals=0,
            Callback = function(v) saHitV = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateSlider(G, "Headshot %", {
            Min=0, Max=100, Default=65, Decimals=0,
            Callback = function(v) saHsV = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateSlider(G, "Body %", {
            Min=0, Max=100, Default=35, Decimals=0,
            Callback = function(v) saBodyV = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateToggle(G, "Visible Only", {
            Default  = false,
            Callback = function(v) saVisV = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateToggle(G, "All Around FOV", {
            Default  = false,
            Tooltip  = "360° mode — targets nearest enemy by world distance from any direction. Fires from your HRP. No screen FOV limit.",
            Callback = function(v) _saAllAround = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateToggle(G, "Auto Fire", {
            Default  = false,
            Tooltip  = "Fire continuously without holding Mouse Button 1. Pairs with All Around FOV for full ragebot-style targeting.",
            Callback = function(v) _saAutoFire = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateToggle(G, "Team Check", {
            Default  = true,
            Tooltip  = "Skip players on your own team.",
            Callback = function(v) saTeamCheck = v end,
        })
        -- anti-katana group on right column
        local GK = Lib:CreateGroupbox(R, "Anti-Katana", 1)
        Lib:CreateToggle(GK, "Block shots during deflect", {
            Default  = false,
            Tooltip  = "Tracks katana deflect on all enemies. Holds your shot for the deflect window so bullets don't bounce back.",
            Callback = function(v)
                akOn = v
                if v and not _akHooked then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for _ = 1, 50 do
                            _installKatanaHook()
                            if _akHooked then break end
                            task.wait(0.2)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                if not v then _akDeflecting = {} end
            end,
        })
        -- FOV fill circle (spinning gradient disk centred on crosshair)
        local GF = Lib:CreateGroupbox(L, "FOV Fill Circle", 2)
        Lib:CreateToggle(GF, "Enable Fill", {
            Default  = false,
            Callback = function(v) _xhCircleVis = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateSlider(GF, "Radius", {
            Min=10, Max=300, Default=60, Decimals=0,
            Callback = function(v) _xhCircleR = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateColorPicker(GF, "Centre Color", {
            Default  = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 210),
            Callback = function(v) _xhGradColor1 = v; _xhCircleRbOn = false end,
        })
        Lib:CreateColorPicker(GF, "Edge Color", {
            Default  = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 200),
            Callback = function(v) _xhGradColor2 = v; _xhCircleRbOn = false end,
        })
        Lib:CreateToggle(GF, "Rainbow Gradient", {
            Default  = false,
            Callback = function(v) _xhCircleRbOn = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateSlider(GF, "Transparency", {
            Min=0, Max=100, Default=40, Decimals=0,
            Callback = function(v) _xhCircleTrans = v / 100 end,
        })
        local GCR = Lib:CreateGroupbox(R, "Crescent Outline", 2)
        Lib:CreateToggle(GCR, "Enable Crescent", {
            Default  = false,
            Callback = function(v) _xhCresOn = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateColorPicker(GCR, "Crescent Color 1", {
            Default  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 200),
            Callback = function(v) _xhCresColor1 = v end,
        })
        Lib:CreateColorPicker(GCR, "Crescent Color 2", {
            Default  = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255),
            Callback = function(v) _xhCresColor2 = v end,
        })
    end)

    -- ── SA FOV circle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Hollow ring: Frame (BackgroundTransparency=1) + UIStroke = the visible ring.
    -- NO UIGradient: Roblox forces BackgroundTransparency to 0 when UIGradient is
    -- present on a Frame, producing a solid filled disk instead of a transparent ring.
    -- Animation: UIStroke.Color cycles between saFovColor and saFovColor2 via
    -- math.sin — visibly animated two-color ring, 50 % transparent, works everywhere.
    -- Two concentric rings (main + outer glow) oscillate in opposite phase so the
    -- two colors pulse against each other, giving the "spinning gradient" look.
    local saGui, saFrame, saStroke
    local function _ensureSaGui()
        if saGui and saGui.Parent then return true end
        saGui = nil
        local pg = _LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return false end

        saGui                = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        saGui.Name           = "__GravSAFOV"
        saGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        saGui.ResetOnSpawn   = false
        saGui.DisplayOrder   = 999999
        saGui.Parent         = pg

        -- main ring
        saFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        saFrame.AnchorPoint        = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        saFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        saFrame.BorderSizePixel    = 0
        saFrame.Visible            = false
        local sfc = Instance.new("UICorner")
        sfc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        sfc.Parent = saFrame
        saStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        saStroke.Thickness = 2
        saStroke.Parent = saFrame
        saFrame.Parent = saGui

        return true
    end

    _RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not saOn or not saShowFov then
            if saFrame then saFrame.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        if not _ensureSaGui() then return end

        local vp = _Cam.ViewportSize
        local mp = _UIS.TouchEnabled
            and Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
            or  _UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        local d = _xhCircleR * 2   -- ring visual matches the FOV fill size

        -- main ring — all props every frame; pinned to screen centre, never mouse
        local ctr = Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
        saFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        saFrame.Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(ctr.X, ctr.Y)
        saFrame.Size                   = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
        saFrame.Visible                = true
        saStroke.Color                 = saFovColor
        saStroke.Transparency          = saFovTransV   -- user-controlled 0→1

    end)

    -- ── SA helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Encode a CFrame into the {X,Y,Z,rx,ry,rz} table the server expects.
    local function _encodeCF(cf)
        local rx, ry, rz = cf:ToOrientation()
        return {
            [utf8.char(0)] = cf.X, [utf8.char(1)] = cf.Y, [utf8.char(2)] = cf.Z,
            [utf8.char(3)] = rx,   [utf8.char(4)] = ry,   [utf8.char(5)] = rz,
        }
    end

    -- Cached StartShooting enum — resolved lazily inside hook so hook installs
    -- regardless of whether _enums is ready at install time.
    local _startShootCache = nil
    local function _getStartShootEnum()
        if _startShootCache then return _startShootCache end
        -- try via _enums (already required above)
        if _enums then
            local ok, v = pcall(_enums.ToEnum, _enums, "StartShooting")
            if ok and v then _startShootCache = v; return v end
        end
        -- fallback: direct require of EnumLibrary
        local RS    = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local RSMods = RS:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        if RSMods then
            local ok2, elib = pcall(require, RSMods:FindFirstChild("EnumLibrary"))
            if ok2 and elib then
                local ok3, v3 = pcall(elib.ToEnum, elib, "StartShooting")
                if ok3 and v3 then _startShootCache = v3 end
            end
        end
        return _startShootCache
    end

    -- ── anti-katana: hook Katana.ReplicateFromServer on all instances ─────────
    -- Mirrors Harion's approach: when any enemy katana fires a deflect action,
    -- we stamp their userId with an expiry time.  AutoFire skips shots until expiry.
    local function _installKatanaHook()
        if _akHooked then return end
        local ps   = _LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
        local mods = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local items = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("Items")
        local kScript = items and items:FindFirstChild("Katana")
        if not kScript then return end

        local ok, katana = pcall(require, kScript)
        if not ok or type(katana) ~= "table" then return end

        -- the class may be the module itself or its metatable
        local class = katana
        if type(rawget(katana, "ReplicateFromServer")) ~= "function" then
            local mt = getmetatable(katana)
            if type(mt) == "table" and type(rawget(mt, "ReplicateFromServer")) == "function" then
                class = mt
            else
                return
            end
        end

        if rawget(class, "__gravAKHooked") then _akHooked = true; return end
        class.__gravAKHooked = true

        local origRFS = class.ReplicateFromServer
        class.ReplicateFromServer = function(self, action, ...)
            if akOn and self then
                local aStr = tostring(action):lower()
                local isDeflect = aStr == "startaiming"
                    or aStr == "startblocking"
                    or aStr == "deflect"
                    or aStr == "startdeflect"
                    or aStr:find("deflect", 1, true) ~= nil
                if isDeflect then
                    local userId
                    pcall(function()
                        local cf = rawget(self, "ClientFighter") or self.ClientFighter
                        if cf then
                            -- skip local player's own katana
                            if cf.IsLocalPlayer then return end
                            local p = cf.Player
                            if p then userId = p.UserId end
                        end
                    end)
                    if not userId then
                        pcall(function() userId = self:Get("ObjectID") end)
                    end
                    if userId then
                        local dur = 1
                        pcall(function()
                            if self.Info and self.Info.DeflectDuration then
                                dur = self.Info.DeflectDuration
                            end
                        end)
                        _akDeflecting[userId] = tick() + dur + 0.12
                    end
                end
            end
            return origRFS(self, action, ...)
        end
        _akHooked = true
    end

    -- ── _saToggle — starts/stops the AutoFire Heartbeat loop ─────────────────
    -- Harion-proven approach: fire UseItem directly with proper ObjectID +
    -- StartShooting enum + camdata every Heartbeat.  No hookfunction needed.
    _saToggle = function(v)
        saOn = v
        if v then
            -- already running?
            if _saHeartbeat then return end
            task.spawn(function()
                -- wait for the remote to be available
                local rem
                for _ = 1, 300 do
                    rem = _getUseItemRemote()
                    if rem then break end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
                if not rem then return end

                local _saLastFire = 0
                _saHeartbeat = _RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not saOn then return end

                    -- gate: require MB1 held unless Auto Fire is on
                    if not _saAutoFire and not _UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                        return
                    end

                    -- throttle: don't hammer the server faster than ~20ms between shots
                    local now = tick()
                    if now - _saLastFire < 0.02 then return end

                    -- resolve FighterController (cached across frames)
                    if not _fcCache then
                        local ok, fc = pcall(function()
                            return require(_LP.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
                        end)
                        if ok and fc then _fcCache = fc end
                    end
                    if not _fcCache then return end

                    local localFighter = _fcCache.LocalFighter
                    if not localFighter then return end
                    local item = localFighter.EquippedItem
                    if not item or not item.Get then return end

                    -- StartShooting enum must be resolved
                    local startEnum = _getStartShootEnum()
                    if not startEnum then return end

                    -- find nearest target inside FOV
                    local target = _getTarget(saFovV, saVisV)
                    if not target then return end

                    -- pick hitbox by headshot/body chance
                    local roll = math.random(0, 100)
                    local hitbox
                    if roll <= saHsV then
                        hitbox = target:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead")
                            or target:FindFirstChild("HitboxHeadSmall")
                            or target:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    else
                        hitbox = target:FindFirstChild("HitboxBody")
                            or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    end
                    hitbox = hitbox
                        or target:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if not hitbox then return end

                    -- hit-chance filter
                    if math.random(0, 100) > saHitV then return end

                    -- anti-katana: hold shot if target is in deflect window
                    if akOn then
                        local now2 = tick()
                        local tPlr = _Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
                        local tId  = tPlr and tPlr.UserId
                        if tId then
                            local exp = _akDeflecting[tId]
                            if exp then
                                if now2 < exp then return end
                                _akDeflecting[tId] = nil   -- expired, clean up
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    -- build camdata: camera→hitbox CFrame encoded as the server expects
                    -- all-around: use HRP so shot origin matches actual server position
                    local myHRP2  = _LP.Character and _LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local fromPos = (_saAllAround and myHRP2) and myHRP2.Position or _Cam.CFrame.Position
                    local aimPos  = hitbox.Position
                    local look    = CFrame.new(fromPos, aimPos)
                    local camdata = {
                        [utf8.char(1)] = {
                            [utf8.char(0)] = _encodeCF(look),
                            [utf8.char(1)] = _encodeCF(look),
                            [utf8.char(2)] = hitbox,
                            [utf8.char(3)] = _encodeCF(
                                hitbox.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(aimPos))
                            ),
                        }
                    }

                    -- fire and stamp time — server enforces weapon cooldown on top
                    local ok2 = pcall(function()
                        rem:FireServer(item:Get("ObjectID"), startEnum, camdata, nil)
                    end)
                    if ok2 then _saLastFire = now end
                end)
            end)
        else
            -- SA turned off — disconnect loop and reset FC cache
            if _saHeartbeat then
                _saHeartbeat:Disconnect()
                _saHeartbeat = nil
            end
            _fcCache = nil
        end
    end

end

    -- ── SA Autofire (ragebot section) ────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Silent-aim style autofire: fires UseItem directly at the closest enemy in
    -- world space from the player's HRP. No evasion, no FOV limit, no voidspam.
    -- Independent of the Silent Aim tab — just the ragebot version.
    do
        local _rbSAOn      = false
        local _rbSAHb      = nil
        local _rbFcCache   = nil
        local _rbHsV       = 65
        local _rbBodyV     = 35
        local _rbTeamCheck = true
        local _rbLastFire  = 0
        local _rbStartEnum = nil
        local _rbLP        = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local _rbRS        = game:GetService("RunService")
        local _rbPlayers   = game:GetService("Players")
        local _rbRSrep     = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local _rbCam       = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local _rbEnums
        pcall(function()
            _rbEnums = require(_rbRSrep.Modules.EnumLibrary)
        end)

        local function _rbEncCF(cf)
            local rx, ry, rz = cf:ToOrientation()
            return {
                [utf8.char(0)]=cf.X, [utf8.char(1)]=cf.Y, [utf8.char(2)]=cf.Z,
                [utf8.char(3)]=rx,   [utf8.char(4)]=ry,   [utf8.char(5)]=rz,
            }
        end

        local function _rbGetRemote()
            local r = _rbRSrep:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local rep = r and r:FindFirstChild("Replication")
            local f   = rep and rep:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
            local u   = f and f:FindFirstChild("UseItem")
            if u and u:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return u end
            return _rbRSrep:FindFirstChild("UseItem", true)
        end

        local function _rbGetEnum()
            if _rbStartEnum then return _rbStartEnum end
            if _rbEnums then
                local ok, v = pcall(_rbEnums.ToEnum, _rbEnums, "StartShooting")
                if ok and v then _rbStartEnum = v; return v end
            end
            local ok2, elib = pcall(require, _rbRSrep.Modules.EnumLibrary)
            if ok2 and elib then
                local ok3, v3 = pcall(elib.ToEnum, elib, "StartShooting")
                if ok3 and v3 then _rbStartEnum = v3; return v3 end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function _rbClosestEnemy()
            local myChar = _rbLP.Character
            local myHRP  = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not myHRP then return nil end
            local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
            for _, plr in ipairs(_rbPlayers:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr == _rbLP or not plr.Character then continue end
                if _rbTeamCheck and _rbLP.Team ~= nil and plr.Team == _rbLP.Team then continue end
                local char = plr.Character
                local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
                local d = (hrp.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestD then best, bestD = char, d end
            end
            return best
        end

        local function _rbToggle(v)
            _rbSAOn = v
            if v then
                if _rbSAHb then return end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local rem
                    for _ = 1, 300 do
                        rem = _rbGetRemote()
                        if rem then break end
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    end
                    if not rem then return end
                    _rbSAHb = _rbRS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                        if not _rbSAOn then return end
                        local now = tick()
                        if now - _rbLastFire < 0.02 then return end

                        if not _rbFcCache then
                            local ok, fc = pcall(function()
                                return require(_rbLP.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
                            end)
                            if ok and fc then _rbFcCache = fc end
                        end
                        if not _rbFcCache then return end
                        local localFighter = _rbFcCache.LocalFighter
                        if not localFighter then return end
                        local item = localFighter.EquippedItem
                        if not item or not item.Get then return end

                        local startEnum = _rbGetEnum()
                        if not startEnum then return end

                        local target = _rbClosestEnemy()
                        if not target then return end

                        local roll = math.random(0, 100)
                        local hitbox
                        if roll <= _rbHsV then
                            hitbox = target:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead")
                                  or target:FindFirstChild("HitboxHeadSmall")
                                  or target:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        else
                            hitbox = target:FindFirstChild("HitboxBody")
                                  or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        end
                        hitbox = hitbox or target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if not hitbox then return end

                        -- fire from HRP so server validates from actual character position
                        local myChar2 = _rbLP.Character
                        local myHRP2  = myChar2 and myChar2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local fromPos = myHRP2 and myHRP2.Position or _rbCam.CFrame.Position
                        local aimPos  = hitbox.Position
                        local look    = CFrame.new(fromPos, aimPos)
                        local camdata = {
                            [utf8.char(1)] = {
                                [utf8.char(0)] = _rbEncCF(look),
                                [utf8.char(1)] = _rbEncCF(look),
                                [utf8.char(2)] = hitbox,
                                [utf8.char(3)] = _rbEncCF(hitbox.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(aimPos))),
                            }
                        }
                        local ok2 = pcall(function()
                            rem:FireServer(item:Get("ObjectID"), startEnum, camdata, nil)
                        end)
                        if ok2 then _rbLastFire = now end
                    end)
                end)
            else
                if _rbSAHb then _rbSAHb:Disconnect(); _rbSAHb = nil end
                _rbFcCache = nil
            end
        end

        -- SA Autofire removed
    end

    -- ── UE Counter ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local _ue_enabled  = false
    local _ue_cooldown = 0.2
    local _ue_distance = 100

    local function _ueCounterTick()
        local lp  = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local char = lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, _ue_distance, 0))
        end
    end

    local GUE = Lib:CreateGroupbox(R, "UE Counter", 3)
    Lib:CreateToggle(GUE, "Enable UE Counter", {
        Default  = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            _ue_enabled = v
            if v then
                task.spawn(function()
                    while _ue_enabled do
                        _ueCounterTick()
                        task.wait(_ue_cooldown)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end,
    })
    Lib:CreateSlider(GUE, "Teleport Cooldown", {
        Min      = 0,
        Max      = 1,
        Default  = 0.2,
        Decimals = 2,
        Callback = function(v) _ue_cooldown = v end,
    })
    Lib:CreateSlider(GUE, "Y Distance", {
        Min      = 10,
        Max      = 1000,
        Default  = 100,
        Decimals = 0,
        Callback = function(v) _ue_distance = v end,
    })
end)

-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  FAKE POS  (Sleepy's underground position desync)
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
do
    local _fpPlayers = game:GetService("Players")
    local _fpRS      = game:GetService("RunService")

    local _fpState = {
        Enabled           = false,
        Depth             = 5.8,
        WalkMode          = true,
        SurfaceCamera     = true,
        AutoNoclip        = true,
        VisualizerEnabled = true,
        VisualizerColor   = Color3.fromRGB(0, 162, 255),
        Panic             = false,
        PanicMinX         = -5,
        PanicMaxX         = 5,
        PanicZ            = false,
        HideMeshes        = true,
        AnimationDesync   = true,
        ZeroVelocity      = true,
        CustomPitch       = 0,
        CustomYaw         = 0,
        InvertPitch       = false,
        VirtualCF         = nil,
        LastMoveDir       = Vector3.zero,
        GhostBox          = nil,
        AnimTrack         = nil,
        OriginalParts     = nil,
        HandoffTicks      = 0,
        ClientCF          = nil,
        FakeCF            = nil,
    }

    local function _fpCaptureOriginal()
        local char = _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer and _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        _fpState.OriginalParts = {}
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then
                table.insert(_fpState.OriginalParts, { part = part, transparency = part.Transparency })
                if _fpState.HideMeshes then
                    pcall(function() part.Transparency = 1 end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function _fpRestoreOriginal()
        if not _fpState.OriginalParts then return end
        for _, data in ipairs(_fpState.OriginalParts) do
            if data.part and data.part.Parent then
                pcall(function() data.part.Transparency = data.transparency end)
            end
        end
        _fpState.OriginalParts = nil
    end

    local function _fpPlayAnimDesync()
        local char = _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer and _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        if not _fpState.AnimTrack then
            pcall(function()
                local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://10714003221"
                local track = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
                track:Play(0, 1, 0)
                track.TimePosition = 1.48
                _fpState.AnimTrack = track
            end)
        end
    end

    local function _fpStopAnimDesync()
        if _fpState.AnimTrack then
            pcall(function()
                _fpState.AnimTrack:Stop()
                _fpState.AnimTrack:Destroy()
            end)
            _fpState.AnimTrack = nil
        end
    end

    local function _fpUpdateGhostVisualizer()
        if _fpState.Enabled and _fpState.VisualizerEnabled and _fpState.VirtualCF then
            if not _fpState.GhostBox or not _fpState.GhostBox.Parent then
                local coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
                local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                box.Name         = "_GravFakePosGhost"
                box.Size         = Vector3.new(2, 5, 1)
                box.Color3       = _fpState.VisualizerColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 162, 255)
                box.Transparency = 0.55
                box.AlwaysOnTop  = true
                box.ZIndex       = 5
                box.Adornee      = workspace.Terrain
                pcall(function() box.Parent = coreGui end)
                _fpState.GhostBox = box
            end
            _fpState.GhostBox.CFrame = _fpState.VirtualCF
            _fpState.GhostBox.Color3 = _fpState.VisualizerColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 162, 255)
        else
            if _fpState.GhostBox then
                pcall(function() _fpState.GhostBox:Destroy() end)
                _fpState.GhostBox = nil
            end
        end
    end

    local function _fpSetDesync(source, clientCF, serverCF)
        local genv = getgenv()
        genv.position_desync_source = source
        genv.client_position        = typeof(clientCF) == "CFrame" and clientCF.Position or clientCF
        genv.server_position        = typeof(serverCF) == "CFrame" and serverCF.Position or serverCF
        genv.v2_tp_pos              = (source == "v2" and genv.server_position) or nil
        _fpState.ClientCF = clientCF
        _fpState.FakeCF   = serverCF
    end

    local function _fpClearDesync()
        local genv = getgenv()
        local char = _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer and _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local pos  = hrp and hrp.Position
        genv.position_desync_source = nil
        genv.client_position        = pos
        genv.server_position        = pos
        genv.v2_tp_pos              = nil
        _fpState.ClientCF = nil
        _fpState.FakeCF   = nil
    end

    local function setFakePos(state)
        if _fpState.Enabled == state then return end
        _fpState.Enabled = state
        getgenv().FakePositionEnabled    = state
        getgenv().HideUndergroundEnabled = state

        local char = _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer and _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if state then
            if hrp then _fpState.VirtualCF = hrp.CFrame end
            if _fpState.HideMeshes      then _fpCaptureOriginal()  end
            if _fpState.AnimationDesync then _fpPlayAnimDesync()    end
            pcall(function() _fpRS:UnbindFromRenderStep("_GravFakePosCam") end)
            _fpRS:BindToRenderStep("_GravFakePosCam", 201, function()
                if _fpState.Enabled and _fpState.SurfaceCamera then
                    local cam   = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    local depth = _fpState.Depth or 5.8
                    if cam and depth > 0 then
                        cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, depth, 0)
                    end
                end
            end)
        else
            pcall(function() _fpRS:UnbindFromRenderStep("_GravFakePosCam") end)
            _fpRestoreOriginal()
            _fpStopAnimDesync()
            _fpUpdateGhostVisualizer()
            if hrp and _fpState.VirtualCF then
                pcall(function()
                    if _fpState.ZeroVelocity then
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
                        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end
                    hrp.CFrame = _fpState.VirtualCF
                end)
            end
            _fpState.VirtualCF    = nil
            _fpState.HandoffTicks = 0
            _fpClearDesync()
        end
    end

    getgenv().SetFakePosition      = setFakePos
    getgenv().ToggleFakePosition   = function() setFakePos(not _fpState.Enabled); return _fpState.Enabled end
    getgenv().SetFakePositionDepth = function(d) if type(d) == "number" then _fpState.Depth = d end end

    -- Extra setters so the Ragebot tab (different Lua scope) can drive all FakePos state
    getgenv().SetFakePosWalkMode         = function(v) _fpState.WalkMode = v end
    getgenv().SetFakePosSurfaceCamera    = function(v) _fpState.SurfaceCamera = v end
    getgenv().SetFakePosAutoNoclip       = function(v) _fpState.AutoNoclip = v end
    getgenv().SetFakePosZeroVelocity     = function(v) _fpState.ZeroVelocity = v end
    getgenv().SetFakePosHideMeshes       = function(v)
        _fpState.HideMeshes = v
        if not v then _fpRestoreOriginal() elseif _fpState.Enabled then _fpCaptureOriginal() end
    end
    getgenv().SetFakePosAnimDesync       = function(v)
        _fpState.AnimationDesync = v
        if not v then _fpStopAnimDesync() elseif _fpState.Enabled then _fpPlayAnimDesync() end
    end
    getgenv().SetFakePosVisualizerOn     = function(v)
        _fpState.VisualizerEnabled = v; _fpUpdateGhostVisualizer()
    end
    getgenv().SetFakePosVisualizerColor  = function(c) _fpState.VisualizerColor = c end
    getgenv().SetFakePosPanic            = function(v) _fpState.Panic = v end
    getgenv().SetFakePosPanicMinX        = function(v) _fpState.PanicMinX = v end
    getgenv().SetFakePosPanicMaxX        = function(v) _fpState.PanicMaxX = v end
    getgenv().SetFakePosPanicZ           = function(v) _fpState.PanicZ = v end

    -- ── Main Heartbeat: movement + CFrame desync send ───────────────────────────
    _fpRS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not _fpState.Enabled then return end
        local char = _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer and _fpPlayers.LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end

        if _fpState.HandoffTicks > 0 then
            _fpState.HandoffTicks = _fpState.HandoffTicks - 1
            if _fpState.VirtualCF then
                hrp.CFrame = _fpState.VirtualCF
                _fpSetDesync("handoff", _fpState.VirtualCF, hrp.CFrame)
            end
            return
        end

        if not _fpState.VirtualCF then _fpState.VirtualCF = hrp.CFrame end

        local cam     = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camLook = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        local camYaw  = math.atan2(-camLook.X, -camLook.Z)
        local surfRot = CFrame.Angles(0, camYaw, 0)

        if _fpState.WalkMode then
            local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                local speed    = hum.WalkSpeed
                local deltaPos = moveDir * (speed * dt)
                _fpState.VirtualCF = CFrame.new(_fpState.VirtualCF.Position + deltaPos) * surfRot
            else
                _fpState.VirtualCF = CFrame.new(_fpState.VirtualCF.Position) * surfRot
            end
        else
            _fpState.VirtualCF = CFrame.new(_fpState.VirtualCF.Position) * surfRot
        end

        local depth = _fpState.Depth or 5.8
        local ugPos = _fpState.VirtualCF.Position - Vector3.new(0, depth, 0)

        if _fpState.Panic then
            local minX = math.min(_fpState.PanicMinX, _fpState.PanicMaxX)
            local maxX = math.max(_fpState.PanicMinX, _fpState.PanicMaxX)
            local jx   = minX + math.random() * (maxX - minX)
            local jz   = _fpState.PanicZ and ((math.random() - 0.5) * (maxX - minX)) or 0
            ugPos = ugPos + Vector3.new(jx, 0, jz)
        end

        local pitchAngle = _fpState.InvertPitch and (_fpState.CustomPitch or 0) or 0
        local pitchCF    = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(pitchAngle), math.rad(_fpState.CustomYaw or 0), 0)

        if _fpState.AutoNoclip then
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                    p.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if _fpState.ZeroVelocity then
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end

        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(ugPos) * surfRot * pitchCF
        _fpSetDesync("fake", _fpState.VirtualCF, hrp.CFrame)
        _fpUpdateGhostVisualizer()
    end)

    -- ── Mesh-hide enforcement Heartbeat ─────────────────────────────────────────
    _fpRS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not _fpState.Enabled or not _fpState.HideMeshes then return end
        if not _fpState.OriginalParts then return end
        for _, data in ipairs(_fpState.OriginalParts) do
            local part = data.part
            if part and part.Parent and part.Transparency ~= 1 then
                pcall(function() part.Transparency = 1 end)
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Fake Pos UI moved to Combat → Ragebot tab
end

        Default  = false,
        Callback = function(on)
            if _rbConn then _rbConn:Disconnect(); _rbConn = nil end

                _rbConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                    _rbHue = (_rbHue + dt * 0.35) % 1
