local cosmeticsTab
sec("Cosmetics tab", function() cosmeticsTab = W:Tab("Cosmetics") end)

-- Grab runtime objects exposed by the boot patch
local GC   = getgenv().GravitonCosmetics
local GCC  = getgenv().GravitonCosmeticsConfig
local GCAT = getgenv().GravitonCatalog   -- {Skins={[wep]={names}}, Wraps={}, Charms={}, Finishers={}}
local GWEP = getgenv().GravitonWeapons   -- {wepName, ...}

-- ── Weapon Unlock: deep hook skin-changer (runs once on first enable) ──────────
local _wcInited = false
local function _initWeaponUnlock()
    if _wcInited then return end
    _wcInited = true
    task.spawn(function()
        if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local player = Players.LocalPlayer
        while not player do
            Players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait()
            player = Players.LocalPlayer
        end
            local playerScripts = player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
            local controllers   = playerScripts:WaitForChild("Controllers")
            local UNLOCK_WEAPONS     = true
            local OVERRIDE_FINISHERS = true
            local EnumLibrary = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules:WaitForChild("EnumLibrary", 10))
            if EnumLibrary then EnumLibrary:WaitForEnumBuilder() end
            local CosmeticLibrary = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules:WaitForChild("CosmeticLibrary", 10))
            local ItemLibrary     = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules:WaitForChild("ItemLibrary", 10))
            -- Robust DataController discovery: try the standard path first,
            -- then fall back to searching all controllers for a module that has
            -- a Get/GetWeaponData API (handles match-place layout differences).
            local DataController
            local _dcModule = controllers:WaitForChild("PlayerDataController", 10)
            if _dcModule then
                DataController = require(_dcModule)
            else
                -- Fallback: scan all controller modules for one that looks like DataController
                for _, child in ipairs(controllers:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                        local ok, mod = pcall(require, child)
                        if ok and type(mod) == "table" and type(mod.Get) == "function"
                           and type(mod.GetWeaponData) == "function" then
                            DataController = mod
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                -- Last resort: check Modules folder in ReplicatedStorage
                if not DataController then
                    local altMods = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
                    if altMods then
                        for _, child in ipairs(altMods:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("ModuleScript") and child.Name:lower():find("data") then
                                local ok, mod = pcall(require, child)
                                if ok and type(mod) == "table" and type(mod.Get) == "function" then
                                    DataController = mod
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not DataController then return end  -- cannot hook without controller
            local equipped, favorites = {}, {}
            local constructingWeapon, viewingProfile = nil, nil
            local lastUsedWeapon = nil
            local function cloneCosmetic(name, cosmeticType, options)
                local base = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name]
                if not base then return nil end
                local data = {}
                for key, value in pairs(base) do data[key] = value end
                data.Name = name
                data.Type = data.Type or cosmeticType
                data.Seed = data.Seed or math.random(1, 1000000)
                if EnumLibrary then
                    local success, enumId = pcall(EnumLibrary.ToEnum, EnumLibrary, name)
                    if success and enumId then data.Enum, data.ObjectID = enumId, data.ObjectID or enumId end
                end
                if options then
                    if options.inverted ~= nil then data.Inverted = options.inverted end
                    if options.favoritesOnly ~= nil then data.OnlyUseFavorites = options.favoritesOnly end
                end
                return data
            end
            local saveFile = "unlockall/config.json"
            local function saveConfig()
                if not writefile then return end
                pcall(function()
                    local config = {equipped = {}, favorites = favorites}
                    for weapon, cosmetics in pairs(equipped) do
                        config.equipped[weapon] = {}
                        for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(cosmetics) do
                            if cosmeticData and cosmeticData.Name then
                                config.equipped[weapon][cosmeticType] = {
                                    name = cosmeticData.Name, seed = cosmeticData.Seed, inverted = cosmeticData.Inverted
                                }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pcall(function() makefolder("unlockall") end)
                    writefile(saveFile, HttpService:JSONEncode(config))
                end)
            end
            local function loadConfig()
                if not readfile or not isfile or not isfile(saveFile) then return end
                pcall(function()
                    local config = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(saveFile))
                    if config.equipped then
                        for weapon, cosmetics in pairs(config.equipped) do
                            equipped[weapon] = {}
                            for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(cosmetics) do
                                local cloned = cloneCosmetic(cosmeticData.name, cosmeticType, {inverted = cosmeticData.inverted})
                                if cloned then cloned.Seed = cosmeticData.seed equipped[weapon][cosmeticType] = cloned end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    favorites = config.favorites or {}
                end)
            end
            local function isUnlockable(name, cosmetic)
                if not cosmetic then return false end
                local t = cosmetic.Type
                if t == "Skin" or t == "Charm" or t == "Dance" or t == "Emote" or t == "Wrap" or t == "Wrapping" or t == "Finisher" then
                    return true
                end
                local n = name:lower()
                return (n:find("charm") or n:find("dance") or n:find("emote") or n:find("wrap") or n:find("finisher")) ~= nil
            end
            local originalOwnsCosmetic = CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic
            CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic = function(self, inventory, name, weapon)
                if name:find("MISSING_") then return originalOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon) end
                if isUnlockable(name, CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name]) then return true end
                return originalOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon)
            end
            for _, fnName in ipairs({"OwnsCosmeticNormally", "OwnsCosmeticUniversally", "OwnsCosmeticForWeapon"}) do
                local original = CosmeticLibrary[fnName]
                CosmeticLibrary[fnName] = function(self, inventory, name, weapon)
                    if type(name) == "string" and not name:find("MISSING_") and isUnlockable(name, CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name]) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if original then return original(self, inventory, name, weapon) end
                    return false
                end
            end
            local function getItemTable()
                return (type(ItemLibrary.Items) == "table" and ItemLibrary.Items)
                    or (type(ItemLibrary.Weapons) == "table" and ItemLibrary.Weapons)
                    or nil
            end
            local function isKnownWeapon(name)
                local items = getItemTable()
                return items ~= nil and items[name] ~= nil
            end
            local function stubWeapon(name)
                return {Name = name, Level = 1, XP = 0, Prestige = 0, Experience = 0, Kills = 0}
            end
            local invCache, invCacheFor, invCacheAt
            local originalGet = DataController.Get
            DataController.Get = function(self, key)
                local data = originalGet(self, key)
                if key == "CosmeticInventory" then
                    if invCache and invCacheFor == data and os.clock() - invCacheAt < 0.25 then
                        return invCache
                    end
                    local proxy = {}
                    local sample
                    if data then
                        for k, v in pairs(data) do
                            if CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[k] then proxy[k] = v end
                            if sample == nil then sample = v end
                        end
                    end
                    for name in pairs(CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics) do
                        if proxy[name] == nil then
                            if type(sample) == "number" then proxy[name] = 1
                            elseif type(sample) == "table" then proxy[name] = {}
                            else proxy[name] = true end
                        end
                    end
                    setmetatable(proxy, {__index = function(t, k)
                        if CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[k] then return true end
                        return nil
                    end})
                    invCache, invCacheFor, invCacheAt = proxy, data, os.clock()
                    return proxy
                end
                if key == "FavoritedCosmetics" then
                    local result = data and table.clone(data) or {}
                    for weapon, favs in pairs(favorites) do
                        result[weapon] = result[weapon] or {}
                        for name, isFav in pairs(favs) do
                            result[weapon][name] = isFav
                        end
                    end
                    return result
                end
                if key == "WeaponInventory" and type(data) == "table" then
                    local result = table.clone(data)
                    local items = UNLOCK_WEAPONS and getItemTable()
                    if items then
                        for name in pairs(items) do
                            if type(name) == "string" and result[name] == nil then
                                result[name] = stubWeapon(name)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for weaponName, cosmetics in pairs(equipped) do
                        local entry = result[weaponName]
                        if weaponName ~= "Dances" and type(entry) == "table" then
                            local merged = table.clone(entry)
                            for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(cosmetics) do
                                merged[cosmeticType] = cosmeticData
                            end
                            result[weaponName] = merged
                        end
                    end
                    return result
                end
                return data
            end
            local function reallyOwns(cosmeticName, weaponName)
                local ok, inventory = pcall(originalGet, DataController, "CosmeticInventory")
                if not ok or not inventory then return false end
                if rawget(inventory, cosmeticName) then return true end
                local ok2, owned = pcall(originalOwnsCosmetic, CosmeticLibrary, inventory, cosmeticName, weaponName)
                return ok2 and owned == true
            end
            local originalGetWeaponData = DataController.GetWeaponData
            DataController.GetWeaponData = function(self, weaponName)
                local data = originalGetWeaponData(self, weaponName)
                if not data then
                    if UNLOCK_WEAPONS and isKnownWeapon(weaponName) then
                        data = stubWeapon(weaponName)
                    else
                        return nil
                    end
                end
                local merged = {}
                for key, value in pairs(data) do merged[key] = value end
                merged.Name = weaponName
                if equipped[weaponName] then
                    for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(equipped[weaponName]) do
                        merged[cosmeticType] = cosmeticData
                    end
                end
                return merged
            end
            pcall(function()
                local LootLibrary = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules:WaitForChild("LootLibrary", 10))
                local originalReward = LootLibrary.GetNextWeaponLevelReward
                if originalReward then
                    LootLibrary.GetNextWeaponLevelReward = function(self, ...)
                        local ok, result = pcall(originalReward, self, ...)
                        if ok then return result end
                        return nil
                    end
                end
            end)
            local FighterController
            pcall(function() FighterController = require(controllers:WaitForChild("FighterController", 10)) end)
            if hookmetamethod then
                local remotes     = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                local dataRemotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Data")
                local equipRemote    = dataRemotes and dataRemotes:FindFirstChild("EquipCosmetic")
                local favoriteRemote = dataRemotes and dataRemotes:FindFirstChild("FavoriteCosmetic")
                local replicationRemotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Replication")
                local fighterRemotes     = replicationRemotes and replicationRemotes:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
                local useItemRemote      = fighterRemotes and fighterRemotes:FindFirstChild("UseItem")
                if not useItemRemote and remotes then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(remotes:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant:IsA("BaseRemoteEvent") and descendant.Name:lower():find("useitem") then
                            useItemRemote = descendant
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                -- Also discover EquipWeapon / SetLoadout style remotes dynamically
                local weaponRemotes = {}
                if dataRemotes then
                    for _, child in ipairs(dataRemotes:GetChildren()) do
                        local ln = child.Name:lower()
                        if child ~= equipRemote and child ~= favoriteRemote
                           and (ln:find("equip") or ln:find("weapon") or ln:find("loadout") or ln:find("select")) then
                            weaponRemotes[child] = child.Name
                        end
                    end
                end
                -- ── Weapon picker remotes (PickWeapons, PickWeaponsAheadOfTime) ──────
                -- These fire a TABLE of {[slotIndex]=weaponName}, not a single string.
                -- Pre-registered for a pure table-lookup in _ncCb (no Instance calls).
                local pickerRemotes = {}
                local duelsRemotes  = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Duels")
                if fighterRemotes then
                    local pw = fighterRemotes:FindFirstChild("PickWeapons")
                    if pw then pickerRemotes[pw] = "PickWeapons" end
                end
                if duelsRemotes then
                    local pwaot = duelsRemotes:FindFirstChild("PickWeaponsAheadOfTime")
                    if pwaot then pickerRemotes[pwaot] = "PickWeaponsAheadOfTime" end
                end
                -- Tracks the player's most recently desired loadout so we can
                -- re-apply it after a server snap-back via PlayerDataChanged.
                local _desiredLoadout = nil  -- {[slotIndex]=weaponName}
                local _loadoutExpiry  = 0    -- tick() deadline for override
                local oldNamecall
                local _ncCb = function(self, ...)
                    local _ncMethod = getnamecallmethod()
                    if _ncMethod ~= "FireServer" and _ncMethod ~= "InvokeServer" then
                        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
                    end
                    local args = {...}
                    if useItemRemote and self == useItemRemote then
                        local objectID = args[1]
                        if FighterController then
                            pcall(function()
                                local fighter = FighterController:GetFighter(player)
                                if fighter and fighter.Items then
                                    for _, item in pairs(fighter.Items) do
                                        if item:Get("ObjectID") == objectID then
                                            lastUsedWeapon = item.Name
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    if self == equipRemote then
                        local weaponName, cosmeticType, cosmeticName, options = args[1], args[2], args[3], args[4] or {}
                        local isNone = not cosmeticName or cosmeticName == "None" or cosmeticName == ""
                        local isDance = cosmeticType ~= "Finisher" and (cosmeticType == "Dance" or cosmeticType == "Emote" or (not isNone and (cosmeticName:lower():find("dance") or cosmeticName:lower():find("emote"))))
                        local overrideTable
                        if isDance then
                            equipped.Dances = equipped.Dances or {}
                            overrideTable = equipped.Dances
                        else
                            equipped[weaponName] = equipped[weaponName] or {}
                            overrideTable = equipped[weaponName]
                        end
                        if isNone then
                            overrideTable[cosmeticType] = nil
                            if isDance then
                                if not next(equipped.Dances) then equipped.Dances = nil end
                            elseif not next(equipped[weaponName]) then
                                equipped[weaponName] = nil
                            end
                            task.defer(saveConfig)
                            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
                        end
                        local owned = reallyOwns(cosmeticName, weaponName)
                        local cloned = cloneCosmetic(cosmeticName, cosmeticType, {inverted = options.IsInverted, favoritesOnly = options.OnlyUseFavorites})
                        if cloned then overrideTable[cosmeticType] = cloned end
                        task.defer(function()
                            pcall(function() DataController.CurrentData:Replicate(isDance and "CosmeticInventory" or "WeaponInventory") end)
                            task.wait(0.1)
                            saveConfig()
                        end)
                        if owned then return oldNamecall(self, ...) end
                        return
                    end
                    if self == favoriteRemote then
                        local wName, cName, isFav = args[1], args[2], args[3]
                        local cosmetic = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[cName]
                        if cosmetic then
                            favorites[wName] = favorites[wName] or {}
                            favorites[wName][cName] = isFav or nil
                            saveConfig()
                            task.spawn(function() pcall(function() DataController.CurrentData:Replicate("FavoritedCosmetics") end) end)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    -- ── Dynamic weapon loadout remote interception ─────────────────────
                    -- IMPORTANT: Never call Instance methods (like :IsDescendantOf) inside
                    -- _ncCb — they trigger __namecall recursively and corrupt the return
                    -- value of getnamecallmethod(), breaking the final oldNamecall dispatch.
                    -- We only use the pre-built weaponRemotes table (pure table lookup).
                    if weaponRemotes[self] then
                        local firstArg = args[1]
                        if type(firstArg) == "string" and isKnownWeapon(firstArg) then
                            local ok3, realInv = pcall(originalGet, DataController, "WeaponInventory")
                            local reallyOwned = ok3 and realInv and rawget(realInv, firstArg) ~= nil
                            if not reallyOwned then
                                if _ncMethod == "InvokeServer" then
                                    -- Let the call through; if the server rejects (nil/false), fake success
                                    local ok4, r1, r2, r3 = pcall(oldNamecall, self, ...)
                                    if not ok4 or r1 == nil or r1 == false then
                                        return true
                                    end
                                    return r1, r2, r3
                                else
                                    -- FireServer: let through (server may accept or reject silently)
                                    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    -- ── Weapon picker remote interception ──────────────────────────
                    -- PickWeapons / PickWeaponsAheadOfTime fire {[slot]=weaponName}.
                    -- Let the call through; record the desired loadout for snap-back fix.
                    -- Safe: pure table lookup only — no Instance method calls.
                    if pickerRemotes[self] then
                        local chosenWeapons = args[1]
                        if type(chosenWeapons) == "table" then
                            _desiredLoadout = chosenWeapons
                            _loadoutExpiry  = tick() + 600
                        end
                        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
                    end
                    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
                end
                oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure and newcclosure(_ncCb) or _ncCb)
                -- ── Override LocalFighter:Get to protect LastPickedWeapons from snap-back ──
                -- ReplicateFromServer (called ~60/s) overwrites lf.Data["LastPickedWeapons"]
                -- each tick, so writing to lf.Data is useless.  hookfunction on the
                -- obfuscated LPH method causes stack overflow.
                -- Fix: rawset a Get override DIRECTLY on the lf INSTANCE (instance field
                -- wins over metatable in Lua's lookup), so every Get("LastPickedWeapons")
                -- call returns _desiredLoadout regardless of what Data holds.
                local function _ensureFighterGetOverride()
                    local lf = FighterController and FighterController.LocalFighter
                    if not lf or rawget(lf, "_gv_lpw_patched") then return end
                    local origGet = lf.Get
                    if type(origGet) ~= "function" then return end
                    rawset(lf, "_gv_lpw_patched", true)
                    rawset(lf, "Get", function(self, key, ...)
                        if key == "LastPickedWeapons" and _desiredLoadout and tick() < _loadoutExpiry then
                            return _desiredLoadout
                        end
                        return origGet(self, key, ...)
                    end)
                end
                -- Belt-and-suspenders: also try writing lf.Data directly after
                -- PlayerDataChanged fires (works in the brief window before the
                -- next ReplicateFromServer call overwrites it — mainly useful
                -- if the picker reads the raw Data table rather than :Get()).
                local _playerDataChanged = dataRemotes and dataRemotes:FindFirstChild("PlayerDataChanged")
                if _playerDataChanged then
                    _playerDataChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
                        if not _desiredLoadout or tick() > _loadoutExpiry then return end
                        task.delay(0.1, function()
                            local lf = FighterController and FighterController.LocalFighter
                            if not lf then return end
                            local d = rawget(lf, "Data")
                            if d and type(d) == "table" then
                                pcall(function() d["LastPickedWeapons"] = _desiredLoadout end)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                end
                -- Poll every 2s so a new LocalFighter (new match join) gets patched
                task.spawn(function()
                    while true do
                        pcall(_ensureFighterGetOverride)
                        task.wait(2)
                    end
                end)
            end
            local ClientItem
            pcall(function() ClientItem = require(player.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem) end)
            if ClientItem and ClientItem._CreateViewModel then
                local originalCreateViewModel = ClientItem._CreateViewModel
                ClientItem._CreateViewModel = function(self, viewmodelRef)
                    local weaponName   = self.Name
                    local weaponPlayer = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.Player
                    constructingWeapon = (weaponPlayer == player) and weaponName or nil
                    if weaponPlayer == player and equipped[weaponName] and viewmodelRef then
                        local dataKey     = self:ToEnum("Data")
                        local targetTable = viewmodelRef[dataKey] or viewmodelRef.Data
                        if targetTable then
                            if equipped[weaponName].Skin then
                                targetTable[self:ToEnum("Skin") or "Skin"] = equipped[weaponName].Skin
                                targetTable[self:ToEnum("Name") or "Name"] = equipped[weaponName].Skin.Name
                            end
                            if equipped[weaponName].Charm then
                                targetTable[self:ToEnum("Charm") or "Charm"] = equipped[weaponName].Charm
                            end
                            if equipped[weaponName].Wrap then
                                targetTable[self:ToEnum("Wrap") or "Wrap"] = equipped[weaponName].Wrap
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local result = originalCreateViewModel(self, viewmodelRef)
                    constructingWeapon = nil
                    return result
                end
            end
            local viewModelModule = player.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem:FindFirstChild("ClientViewModel")
            if viewModelModule then
                local ClientViewModel = require(viewModelModule)
                if ClientViewModel.GetCharm then
                    local originalGetCharmFunc = ClientViewModel.GetCharm
                    ClientViewModel.GetCharm = function(self)
                        local weaponName   = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.Name
                        local weaponPlayer = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Player
                        if weaponName and weaponPlayer == player and equipped[weaponName] and equipped[weaponName].Charm then
                            return equipped[weaponName].Charm
                        end
                        return originalGetCharmFunc(self)
                    end
                end
                if ClientViewModel.GetWrap then
                    local originalGetWrapFunc = ClientViewModel.GetWrap
                    ClientViewModel.GetWrap = function(self)
                        local weaponName   = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.Name
                        local weaponPlayer = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Player
                        if weaponName and weaponPlayer == player and equipped[weaponName] and equipped[weaponName].Wrap then
                            return equipped[weaponName].Wrap
                        end
                        return originalGetWrapFunc(self)
                    end
                end
                local originalNew = ClientViewModel.new
                ClientViewModel.new = function(replicatedData, clientItem)
                    local weaponPlayer = clientItem.ClientFighter and clientItem.ClientFighter.Player
                    local weaponName   = constructingWeapon or clientItem.Name
                    if weaponPlayer == player and equipped[weaponName] then
                        local ReplicatedClass = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ReplicatedClass)
                        local dataKey = ReplicatedClass:ToEnum("Data")
                        replicatedData[dataKey] = replicatedData[dataKey] or {}
                        local cosmetics = equipped[weaponName]
                        if cosmetics.Skin  then replicatedData[dataKey][ReplicatedClass:ToEnum("Skin")]  = cosmetics.Skin  end
                        if cosmetics.Charm then replicatedData[dataKey][ReplicatedClass:ToEnum("Charm")] = cosmetics.Charm end
                        if cosmetics.Wrap  then replicatedData[dataKey][ReplicatedClass:ToEnum("Wrap")]  = cosmetics.Wrap  end
                    end
                    local result = originalNew(replicatedData, clientItem)
                    if weaponPlayer == player and equipped[weaponName] and equipped[weaponName].Wrap and result._UpdateWrap then
                        result:_UpdateWrap()
                        task.delay(0.1, function() if not result._destroyed then result:_UpdateWrap() end end)
                    end
                    return result
                end
            end
            ItemLibrary.GetViewModelImageFromWeaponData = function(self, weaponData, highRes)
                if not weaponData then return nil end
                local weaponName = weaponData.Name
                local shouldShowSkin = (weaponData.Skin and equipped[weaponName] and weaponData.Skin == equipped[weaponName].Skin)
                    or (viewingProfile == player and equipped[weaponName] and equipped[weaponName].Skin)
                if shouldShowSkin and equipped[weaponName] and equipped[weaponName].Skin then
                    local skinInfo = self.ViewModels[equipped[weaponName].Skin.Name]
                    if skinInfo then return skinInfo[highRes and "ImageHighResolution" or "Image"] or skinInfo.Image end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local EmoteController
            pcall(function()
                EmoteController = require(controllers:WaitForChild("EmoteController", 10))
                if EmoteController and EmoteController.GetEmotes then
                    local originalGetEmotes = EmoteController.GetEmotes
                    EmoteController.GetEmotes = function(self)
                        local emotes = originalGetEmotes(self)
                        for name, cosmetic in pairs(CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics) do
                            if cosmetic and (cosmetic.Type == "Dance" or cosmetic.Type == "Emote" or name:lower():find("dance") or name:lower():find("emote")) then
                                if not emotes[name] then
                                    emotes[name] = {Name = name, Type = cosmetic.Type, ObjectID = cosmetic.ObjectID, Enum = cosmetic.Enum}
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return emotes
                    end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local ViewProfile = require(player.PlayerScripts.Modules.Pages.ViewProfile)
                if ViewProfile and ViewProfile.Fetch then
                    local originalFetch = ViewProfile.Fetch
                    ViewProfile.Fetch = function(self, targetPlayer)
                        viewingProfile = targetPlayer
                        return originalFetch(self, targetPlayer)
                    end
                end
            end)
            if OVERRIDE_FINISHERS then
                task.spawn(function()
                    local finishersFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Modules:WaitForChild("Finishers", 10)
                    if not finishersFolder then return end
                    local originals = {}
                    local suppress  = false
                    local function isLocalEliminator(eliminator)
                        if eliminator == nil then return false end
                        if eliminator == player then return true end
                        local character = player.Character
                        local t = typeof(eliminator)
                        if t == "Instance" then
                            if character and (eliminator == character or eliminator:IsDescendantOf(character)) then return true end
                            if eliminator:IsA("Player") then return eliminator == player end
                            return false
                        end
                        if t == "number" then return eliminator == player.UserId end
                        if t == "string" then return eliminator == player.Name  end
                        if t == "table" then
                            if eliminator.Player == player then return true end
                            local c = eliminator.Character
                            return character ~= nil and c == character
                        end
                        return false
                    end
                    local function getHeldWeapon()
                        if not FighterController then return nil end
                        local ok, fighter = pcall(FighterController.GetFighter, FighterController, player)
                        if not ok or type(fighter) ~= "table" then return nil end
                        local function nameOf(item)
                            if type(item) == "string" then return item end
                            if type(item) == "table" or typeof(item) == "Instance" then
                                local okName, itemName = pcall(function() return item.Name end)
                                if okName and type(itemName) == "string" then return itemName end
                            end
                            return nil
                        end
                        for _, key in ipairs({"EquippedItem","CurrentItem","ActiveItem","SelectedItem","HeldItem"}) do
                            local okKey, item = pcall(function() return fighter[key] end)
                            if okKey and item then
                                local n = nameOf(item)
                                if n then return n end
                            end
                        end
                        for _, method in ipairs({"GetEquippedItem","GetCurrentItem","GetActiveItem","GetSelectedItem","GetHeldItem"}) do
                            local okMethod, item = pcall(function() return fighter[method](fighter) end)
                            if okMethod and item then
                                local n = nameOf(item)
                                if n then return n end
                            end
                        end
                        return nil
                    end
                    local function pickTarget()
                        local weapon   = getHeldWeapon() or lastUsedWeapon
                        local finisher = weapon and equipped[weapon] and equipped[weapon].Finisher
                        if finisher and finisher.Name and originals[finisher.Name] then
                            return finisher.Name
                        end
                        return nil
                    end
                    local function build(name, ...)
                        if name == "Every Finisher Ever" then
                            suppress = true
                            local ok, result = pcall(originals[name], ...)
                            suppress = false
                            if not ok then error(result, 0) end
                            return result
                        end
                        return originals[name](...)
                    end
                    for _, moduleScript in ipairs(finishersFolder:GetChildren()) do
                        if moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                            local name = moduleScript.Name
                            local ok, class = pcall(require, moduleScript)
                            if ok and type(class) == "table" and type(class.new) == "function" then
                                originals[name] = class.new
                                class.new = function(subject, isFinal, eliminator, ...)
                                    if suppress then
                                        return originals[name](subject, isFinal, eliminator, ...)
                                    end
                                    if isLocalEliminator(eliminator) then
                                        local target = pickTarget()
                                        if target and target ~= name then
                                            local okBuild, object = pcall(build, target, subject, isFinal, eliminator, ...)
                                            if okBuild and object then return object end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    return build(name, subject, isFinal, eliminator, ...)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            loadConfig()
    end)
end

sec("Cosmetics Overview", function()
    local L, R = cosmeticsTab("Overview")

    local GCR = Lib:CreateGroupbox(L, "Cosmetic Runtime", 1)
    -- Enable / disable the whole cosmetics system
    Lib:CreateToggle(GCR, "Enable Cosmetic Changes", {
        Default  = true,
        Callback = function(v)
            if GCC and GCC.SetRuntimeEnabled then
                pcall(function() GCC:SetRuntimeEnabled(v) end)
            end
        end,
    })
    -- fire immediately so Graviton sees it enabled from the start
    -- Boot task: wait for GC/GCC then fire full unlock + reroll
    task.spawn(function()
        local t = 0
        while (not getgenv().GravitonCosmetics or not getgenv().GravitonCosmeticsConfig) and t < 15 do
            task.wait(0.2); t = t + 0.2
        end
        local _GC  = getgenv().GravitonCosmetics
        local _GCC = getgenv().GravitonCosmeticsConfig
        if not _GC or not _GCC then return end
        pcall(function() _GCC:SetRuntimeEnabled(true) end)
        pcall(function()
            _GCC:SetUnlockedTypes({Skin=true, Wrap=true, Charm=true, Finisher=true, Emote=true})
        end)
        pcall(function()
            _GCC:SetUnlockedRarities({
                Common=true, Uncommon=true, Rare=true, Epic=true,
                Legendary=true, Mythical=true, Unobtainable=true,
            })
        end)
        pcall(function() _GC:SetUnlockerEnabled(true) end)
        -- Weapon unlock: deep hook skin-changer (patches CosmeticLibrary + DataController)
        _initWeaponUnlock()
    end)
    -- Use the skin-changer custom loadout
    Lib:CreateToggle(GCR, "Use Custom Loadout", {
        Default  = true,
        Callback = function(v)
            if GC and GC.SetSkinChangerEnabled then
                pcall(function() GC:SetSkinChangerEnabled(v) end)
            end
        end,
    })
    pcall(function() if GC and GC.SetSkinChangerEnabled then GC:SetSkinChangerEnabled(true) end end)
    -- Reroll random cosmetics
    Lib:CreateButton(GCR, "Reroll Random Cosmetics", {
        Callback = function()
            if GC and GC.RerollAll then
                pcall(function() GC:RerollAll() end)
            end
        end,
    })

    local GWU = Lib:CreateGroupbox(L, "Weapon Unlock", 2)
    Lib:CreateToggle(GWU, "Unlock All Weapons", {
        Default  = true,
        Tooltip  = "Hooks CosmeticLibrary + DataController so every weapon and skin is treated as owned.",
        Callback = function(v)
            if v then _initWeaponUnlock() end
        end,
    })

    local GUA = Lib:CreateGroupbox(L, "Unlock All", 3)
    -- Master unlock toggle
    Lib:CreateToggle(GUA, "Unlock All Cosmetics", {
        Default  = true,
        Callback = function(v)
            if GC and GC.SetUnlockerEnabled then
                pcall(function() GC:SetUnlockerEnabled(v) end)
            end
        end,
    })
    pcall(function() if GC and GC.SetUnlockerEnabled then GC:SetUnlockerEnabled(true) end end)
    -- Per-rarity unlock toggles — all on by default
    local RARITIES = {"Common","Uncommon","Rare","Epic","Legendary","Mythical","Unobtainable"}
    local rarityState = {}
    for _, r in ipairs(RARITIES) do
        rarityState[r] = true
    end
    local function pushRarities()
        if GCC and GCC.SetUnlockedRarities then
            local copy = {}
            for k,v in pairs(rarityState) do copy[k] = v end
            pcall(function() GCC:SetUnlockedRarities(copy) end)
        end
    end
    pushRarities()  -- fire immediately so all rarities unlock on script load
    for _, rarity in ipairs(RARITIES) do
        local r = rarity
        Lib:CreateToggle(GUA, r, {
            Default  = rarityState[r],
            Callback = function(v)
                rarityState[r] = v
                pushRarities()
            end,
        })
    end

    local GCO = Lib:CreateGroupbox(R, "Community", 1)
    toggle(GCO, "Share Skins",           {"UserServer","ShareSkins"}, false)
    toggle(GCO, "Show Active Cosmetics", {"UserServer","ShowActive"}, false)

    -- Open skin browser button (right column)
    local GSB = Lib:CreateGroupbox(R, "Skin Browser", 2)
    Lib:CreateButton(GSB, "Open Skin Browser", {
        Callback = function()
            local fn = getgenv().OpenSkinBrowser
            if fn then fn("Skins")
            end
        end,
    })
    Lib:CreateButton(GSB, "Open Wrap Browser", {
        Callback = function()
            local fn = getgenv().OpenSkinBrowser
            if fn then fn("Wraps") end
        end,
    })
    Lib:CreateButton(GSB, "Open Charm Browser", {
        Callback = function()
            local fn = getgenv().OpenSkinBrowser
            if fn then fn("Charms") end
        end,
    })
    Lib:CreateButton(GSB, "Open Finisher Browser", {
        Callback = function()
            local fn = getgenv().OpenSkinBrowser
            if fn then fn("Finishers") end
        end,
    })
end)

-- After all UI sections build, replay any startup config (__session / AutoLoad)
-- through the now-populated flagsReg so handles reflect saved state.
-- Without this, __session loads at startup when flagsReg is empty → no handles updated.
-- _cfgSilentColors: color handles update silently — no callbacks fire, so gc.Data
-- keeps its ColorSequence values (needed by skeleton/tracer at player join init).
getgenv()._cfgSilentColors = true

;(function()

-- ================================================================
--  GRAVITON SKIN BROWSER  ·  Obsidian-native  ·  sidebar layout
-- ================================================================
local _GH = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local _HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
local _TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- ── Persistence ────────────────────────────────────────────────
local SAVE_DIR   = "graviton"
local SAVE_FILE  = SAVE_DIR .. "/skin_choices.json"
local FLAG_FILE  = SAVE_DIR .. "/skin_choices_v2.flag"
local _choices  = {}

local function ensureDir()
    pcall(function()
        if not isfolder(SAVE_DIR) then makefolder(SAVE_DIR) end
    end)
end

local function clearChoices()
    _choices = {}
    pcall(function()
        ensureDir()
        writefile(SAVE_FILE, "{}")
    end)
    local GCX = getgenv().GravitonCosmetics
    if GCX then
        -- Empty table = no choices set → game reverts all weapons to default skins
        if GCX.SetSkinChangerChoices then
            pcall(function() GCX:SetSkinChangerChoices({}) end)
        end
        task.wait(0.08)
        if GCX.RerollAll then
            pcall(function() GCX:RerollAll() end)
        end
    end
end

local function saveChoices()
    pcall(function()
        ensureDir()
        local encoded = _HS:JSONEncode(_choices)
        writefile(SAVE_FILE, encoded)
    end)
end

local function loadChoices()
    ensureDir()
    local GCX = getgenv().GravitonCosmetics
    if not isfile(FLAG_FILE) then
        pcall(function() writefile(FLAG_FILE, "v2") end)
        pcall(function() writefile(SAVE_FILE, "{}") end)
        _choices = {}
        if GCX then
            -- First run: clear to defaults (empty table = no choices = default skins)
            if GCX.SetSkinChangerChoices then
                pcall(function() GCX:SetSkinChangerChoices({}) end)
            end
            task.wait(0.08)
            pcall(function()
                if GCX.RerollAll then GCX:RerollAll() end
            end)
        end
        return
    end
    if not isfile(SAVE_FILE) then return end
    local raw = readfile(SAVE_FILE)
    if not raw or raw == "" then return end
    local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return _HS:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then return end
    _choices = decoded
    if GCX then
        pcall(function()
            if GCX.SetSkinChangerChoices then GCX:SetSkinChangerChoices(_choices) end
        end)
        task.wait(0.08)
        pcall(function()
            if GCX.RerollAll then GCX:RerollAll() end
        end)
    end
end

SkinGui.DisplayOrder = 9997
SkinGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
SkinGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
SkinGui.Enabled = false
local ok_ = pcall(function() SkinGui.Parent = gethui() end)
if not ok_ then pcall(function() SkinGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end) end

local RADIUS = 3
local C = {
    BG      = Color3.fromRGB(4,   3,   7),
    PANEL   = Color3.fromRGB(16,  13,  24),
    CHROME  = Color3.fromRGB(10,  8,   15),
    SIDE    = Color3.fromRGB(7,   5,   12),
    ACC     = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85,  247),
    TILE    = Color3.fromRGB(14,  11,  22),
    TILHOV  = Color3.fromRGB(26,  21,  38),
    TILSEL  = Color3.fromRGB(22,  16,  38),
    TEXT    = Color3.fromRGB(242, 238, 255),

}

-- ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function mk(cls, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(cls)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end
    if parent then o.Parent = parent end
    return o
end
local function corner(r, p) return mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r)}, p) end
local function stroke(col, thick, p)
    return mk("UIStroke", {Color=col, Thickness=thick, ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, p)
end

-- ── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local curSelTile = nil
local allTileData = {}
local curWep  = nil
local curTab  = "Skins"
local tabBtns = {}
local _tabAccBars = {}   -- Name → left-edge Accent bar Frame

local SPECIAL_CHAR = { Unselected="⊘", None="⊗", Random="⇄" }

local function imgId(raw)
    if not raw then return "" end
    if type(raw) == "number" then return "rbxassetid://"..tostring(raw) end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        if raw:match("^rbxasset") or raw=="" then return raw end
        return "rbxassetid://"..raw
    end
    return ""
end

local function updateWarn()
    local GCX = getgenv().GravitonCosmetics
    if GCX then
        local ok, st = pcall(function() return GCX:ExportState() end)
        if ok and st then
            if not st.RuntimeEnabled then
                WarnLbl.Text = "⚠  cosmetics disabled — enable on Overview"
                WarnLbl.Visible = true; return
            elseif not st.SkinChangerEnabled then
                WarnLbl.Text = "⚠  skin changer disabled — enable on Overview"
                WarnLbl.Visible = true; return
            end
        end
    end
    WarnLbl.Visible = false
end

-- ── Tile factory ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Tiles use an overlay layout: image fills the whole tile,
-- name appears as a text overlay on a gradient at the bottom.
local TI_SEL = TweenInfo.new(0.09, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function makeTile(name, img, lo, onApply)
    local F = mk("Frame", {
        Name             = name,
        Size             = UDim2.fromOffset(TILE_W, TILE_H),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.TILE,
        BorderSizePixel  = 0,
        LayoutOrder      = lo,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        ZIndex           = 2,
    })
    corner(RADIUS + 2, F)

    local Stk = mk("UIStroke", {
        Color            = C.OUTLINE,
        Thickness        = 1,
        Transparency     = 0.5,
        ApplyStrokeMode  = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
    }, F)

    local sp = SPECIAL_CHAR[name]
    if sp then
        -- Special tile: just a centered glyph
        mk("TextLabel", {
            Size             = UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text             = sp,
            TextColor3       = C.DIMMER,
            Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize         = 34,
            ZIndex           = 3,
        }, F)
    elseif img ~= "" then
        mk("ImageLabel", {
            Size             = UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image            = img,
            ScaleType        = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            ZIndex           = 3,
        }, F)
    end

    -- Bottom gradient overlay: dark fade so the name text is legible
    local GradFade = mk("Frame", {
        Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
        Position         = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -44),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 3, 7),
        BorderSizePixel  = 0,
        ZIndex           = 4,
    }, F)
    mk("UIGradient", {
        Color    = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(0,0,0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(1,1,1)),
        }),
        Rotation = 90,
    }, GradFade)

    -- Name overlay — bottom of tile, on the gradient
    mk("TextLabel", {
        Size             = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20),
        Position         = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -22),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text             = name,
        TextColor3       = C.TEXT,
        Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize         = 10,
        TextTruncate     = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        TextXAlignment   = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex           = 5,
    }, F)

    -- Selected: Accent bottom bar
    local Bar = mk("Frame", {
        Size             = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 2),
        Position         = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -2),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.ACC,
        BorderSizePixel  = 0,
        Visible          = false,
        ZIndex           = 6,
    }, F)
    corner(RADIUS, Bar)

    -- Selected: checkmark badge top-right
    local Chk = mk("Frame", {
        Size             = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
        Position         = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 4),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.ACC,
        BorderSizePixel  = 0,
        Visible          = false,
        ZIndex           = 6,
    }, F)
    corner(9, Chk)
    mk("TextLabel", {
        Size             = UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text             = "✓",
        TextColor3       = Color3.new(1,1,1),
        Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize         = 9,
        ZIndex           = 7,
    }, Chk)

    local Btn = mk("TextButton", {
        Size             = UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text             = "",
        ZIndex           = 10,
    }, F)

    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if curSelTile then
            local pf,ps,pb,pc = table.unpack(curSelTile)
            _TS:Create(pf, TI_SEL, {BackgroundColor3=C.TILE}):Play()
            ps.Color=C.OUTLINE; ps.Transparency=0.5
            pb.Visible=false;   pc.Visible=false
        end
        _TS:Create(F, TI_SEL, {BackgroundColor3=C.TILSEL}):Play()
        Stk.Color=C.ACC; Stk.Transparency=0
        Bar.Visible=true; Chk.Visible=true
        curSelTile={F,Stk,Bar,Chk}
        onApply(name); updateWarn()
    end)
    Btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if not (curSelTile and curSelTile[1]==F) then
            _TS:Create(F, TI_SEL, {BackgroundColor3=C.TILHOV}):Play()
            Stk.Color=C.OUTLINE; Stk.Transparency=0
        end
    end)
    Btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if not (curSelTile and curSelTile[1]==F) then
            _TS:Create(F, TI_SEL, {BackgroundColor3=C.TILE}):Play()
            Stk.Transparency=0.5
        end
    end)
    return F
end

-- ── Populate grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────
local function clearTiles()
    for _, c in ipairs(TileScroll:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
    end
    curSelTile = nil
    allTileData = {}
end

local function populate(items, applyFn, imgs, _label)
    clearTiles()
    SearchBox.Text = ""
    local SPEC = {"Unselected", "None", "Random"}
    local lo = 1
    for _, sp in ipairs(SPEC) do
        local n = sp
        local t = makeTile(n, "", lo, function()
            local v = (n=="Unselected" and "Unselected") or (n=="None" and "NONE_COSMETIC") or "RANDOM_COSMETIC"
            applyFn(v)
        end)
        t.Parent = TileScroll
        table.insert(allTileData, {name=n, frame=t})
        lo = lo + 1
    end
    if items then
        for _, name in ipairs(items) do
            local img = imgId(imgs and imgs[name])
            local n = name
            local t = makeTile(n, img, lo, function() applyFn(n) end)
            t.Parent = TileScroll
            table.insert(allTileData, {name=n, frame=t})
            lo = lo + 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local q = SearchBox.Text:lower()
    for _, td in ipairs(allTileData) do
        td.frame.Visible = (q == "") or (td.name:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil)
    end
end)
-- Focus highlight: Outline → Accent on focus (Obsidian textbox pattern)
SearchBox.Focused:Connect(function()
    SrchStroke.Color = C.ACC
end)
SearchBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    SrchStroke.Color = C.OUTLINE
end)

-- ── Weapon dropdown ───────────────────────────────────────────
local function buildWepRows(weapons, onChange)
    for _, c in ipairs(WepSF:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end
    end
    local opts = {"All Weapons"}
    if weapons then for _, w in ipairs(weapons) do table.insert(opts, w) end end
    local TI_R = TweenInfo.new(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
    for _, opt in ipairs(opts) do
        local r = mk("TextButton", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 26),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "  "..opt,
            TextColor3 = C.DIM,
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 42,
        }, WepSF)
        corner(RADIUS, r)
        r.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            _TS:Create(r, TI_R, { BackgroundColor3 = C.DDHOV }):Play()
            r.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            r.TextColor3 = C.TEXT
        end)
        r.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            r.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            r.TextColor3 = C.DIM
        end)
        local o = opt
        r.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            curWep = (o == "All Weapons") and "All" or o
            WepBtn.Text = o.."  ▾"
            closeWepDrop()
            if onChange then onChange(curWep) end
        end)
    end
    local h = math.min(#opts * 26, 220)
    WepDrop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, h)
    WepSF.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #opts * 26)
end

WepBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if wepDropOpen then closeWepDrop()
    else WepDrop.Visible = true; wepDropOpen = true end
end)
Win.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and wepDropOpen then
        task.defer(function() if wepDropOpen then closeWepDrop() end end)
    end
end)

-- ── Apply helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────
local _rerollPending = false
local function scheduleReroll(GCX)
    if _rerollPending then return end
    _rerollPending = true
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.3)
        _rerollPending = false
        pcall(function() if GCX and GCX.RerollAll then GCX:RerollAll() end end)
    end)
end

local function applyToWep(GCX, wep, choice)
    local WEP = getgenv().GravitonWeapons
    pcall(function()
        if wep == "All" and WEP and GCX.SetSkinChangerChoices then
            local tbl = {}
            for _, w in ipairs(WEP) do
                tbl[w] = choice
                _choices[w] = choice
            end
            GCX:SetSkinChangerChoices(tbl)
        else
            GCX:SetSkinChangerChoice(wep, choice)
            _choices[wep] = choice
        end
    end)
    saveChoices()
    scheduleReroll(GCX)
end

-- ── Sidebar nav buttons ────────────────────────────────────────
local TABS   = {"Skins", "Wraps", "Charms", "Finishers"}
local TI_TAB = TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function switchTab(tab)
    curTab = tab
    SearchBox.Text = ""
    local WEP0 = getgenv().GravitonWeapons
    curWep = (WEP0 and WEP0[1]) or "All"
    WepBtn.Text = (curWep == "All" and "All Weapons" or curWep).."  ▾"

    -- Sidebar button states: active = PANEL bg + visible AccBar; rest = SIDE bg
    for _, b in ipairs(tabBtns) do
        local sel = b.Name == tab
        _TS:Create(b, TI_TAB, {
            BackgroundColor3 = sel and C.PANEL or C.SIDE,
            TextColor3       = sel and C.TEXT  or C.DIM,
        }):Play()
        local ab = _tabAccBars[b.Name]
        if ab then ab.Visible = sel end
    end

    local GCX  = getgenv().GravitonCosmetics
    local CAT  = getgenv().GravitonCatalog
    local WEP  = getgenv().GravitonWeapons
    local imgs = (CAT and CAT.Images) or {}

    if tab == "Skins" then
        local function loadSkins(wep)
            curWep = wep
            WepBtn.Text = (wep == "All" and "All Weapons" or wep).."  ▾"
            local list
            if wep == "All" then
                list = {}
                if CAT and CAT.Skins and WEP then
                    local seen = {}
                    for _, w in ipairs(WEP) do
                        local sl = CAT.Skins[w]
                        if sl then
                            for _, s in ipairs(sl) do
                                if not seen[s] then seen[s]=true; table.insert(list,s) end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                list = (CAT and CAT.Skins and CAT.Skins[wep]) or {}
            end
            populate(list, function(skinName)
                if GCX then applyToWep(GCX, curWep, {Kind="Skin", Name=skinName}) end
            end, imgs)
        end
        buildWepRows(WEP, loadSkins)
        loadSkins(curWep)

    elseif tab == "Wraps" then
        local list = (CAT and CAT.Wraps) or {}
        buildWepRows(WEP, function(wep) curWep = wep end)
        populate(list, function(skinName)
            if GCX then applyToWep(GCX, curWep, {Kind="Wrap", Wrap={Name=skinName, Inverted=false}}) end
        end, imgs)

    elseif tab == "Charms" then
        local list = (CAT and CAT.Charms) or {}
        buildWepRows(WEP, function(wep) curWep = wep end)
        populate(list, function(skinName)
            if GCX then applyToWep(GCX, curWep, {Kind="Charm", Name=skinName}) end
        end, imgs)

    elseif tab == "Finishers" then
        local list = (CAT and CAT.Finishers) or {}
        buildWepRows(WEP, function(wep) curWep = wep end)
        populate(list, function(skinName)
            if GCX then applyToWep(GCX, curWep, {Kind="Finisher", Name=skinName}) end
        end, imgs)
    end

    updateWarn()
end

-- Build vertical sidebar nav buttons
-- Buttons start at y=42 (below COSMETICS label), each 34px tall
local BTN_Y = 40
for i, tname in ipairs(TABS) do
    local b = mk("TextButton", {
        Name             = tname,
        Size             = UDim2.new(1, -1, 0, 34),   -- -1 to not overlap divider
        Position         = UDim2.fromOffset(0, BTN_Y + (i-1)*34),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.SIDE,
        Text             = tname,
        TextColor3       = C.DIM,
        Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize         = 12,
        TextXAlignment   = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BorderSizePixel  = 0,
        ZIndex           = 3,
    }, Sidebar)
    mk("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0, 18)}, b)
    _tabAccBars[tname] = nil   -- no accent bar
    table.insert(tabBtns, b)
    local t = tname
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchTab(t) end)
    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if curTab ~= t then
            _TS:Create(b, TI_TAB, {BackgroundColor3=C.TILHOV, TextColor3=C.TEXT}):Play()
        end
    end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if curTab ~= t then
            _TS:Create(b, TI_TAB, {BackgroundColor3=C.SIDE, TextColor3=C.DIM}):Play()
        end
    end)
end

-- ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────
getgenv().OpenSkinBrowser = function(tab)
    SkinGui.Enabled = true
    switchTab(tab or "Skins")
end
getgenv().CloseSkinBrowser = function()
    SkinGui.Enabled = false
end

-- Auto-load saved choices once GravitonCosmetics is ready
task.spawn(function()
    local t = 0
    while not getgenv().GravitonCosmetics and t < 10 do
        task.wait(0.25)
        t = t + 0.25
    end
    loadChoices()
end)

end)()
